tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /legs par bshad pa lung rigs kyi rgya mtsho bzhugs/ /smad cha'o/ /
༄༅/ /legs par bshad pa lung rigs kyi rgya mtsho bzhugs/ /smad cha'o/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// legs par bshad pa lung rigs kyi rgya mtsho bzhugs// smad cha'o// (2) mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i dgongs don phyin ci ma log par gtan la 'bebs pa lung rigs kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di ni/ gnyis pa rgyu lam shes la/ 'brel bkod pa'i sgo nas 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ mtshon byed kyi chos rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid rtogs pa ni/ zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ lam shes la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ gzhung gi bstan tshul/ rnam mkhyen las logs su (3) 'chad bya'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ dgos pa'o// dang po gnyis gong du bshad zin/ gsum pa la/ kha cig skabs gnyis pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bo yin na lam shes yin pas khyab zer ba mi 'thad de/ lam shes mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gcig chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir te/ dngos brgyad don bdun bcu dang bcas pa de rgyan gyi brjod bya'i gtso bo yin pa'i phyir/ rang lugs ni/ skabs gnyis pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i lam shes yin na/ rgyu lam shes yin dgos te/ lam shes la (4) rgyu lam shes dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sas bsdus pa'i 'bras dus kyi lam shes gnyis su nges shing*/ phyi ma 'dir bstan bya'i gtso bor byas nas mi ston pa'i phyir te/ de nyid skabs dang por bstan zin cing de'i rgyu ngo shes pa'i phyir du skabs gnyis par lam shes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gal te lam shes chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ skabs gnyis pa bstan bya'i gtso bo dang lam shes kyi gzhi mthun yin pa'i phyir/ rnam mkhyen chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ sangs rgyas rnam kun shin tu ba// zhes pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ de skabs gnyis pa'i rgyan gzhung yin pa'i phyir/ ce na/ dang po la/ rtse sbyor chos can/ rtags kyi rtse sbyor du thal/ rmi (5) lam na yang chos rnams kun// ces sogs kyi skabs nas dngos bstan gyi rtse sbyor yin pa'i phyir/

de'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa dang*/ rtse sbyor gyi gzhi mthun yin pa'i phyir/ khyab rtags khas/ gnyis pa la/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam chos can/ skabs gsum pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i gzhi shes su thal/ thabs ma yin pas ring ba ste// zhes pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ de skabs gsum pa'i rgyan gzhung yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan de theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i bstan bcos ma yin par thal/ rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya'i gtso bor dang theg dman gyi gzhi mthun yod (6) pa'i phyir te/ theg dman gyi lam de rgyan gyi bstan bya'i gtso bor yin pa'i phyir te/ theg dman gyi mthong lam de skabs gsum pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ des na sangs rgyas rnam kun shin tu ba// zhes pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bo yin na skabs gnyis pa'i de yin mi dgos te/ de dag skabs gnyis pa'i zhar byung gi gzhung yin pa'i phyir/ nyon mongs shes bya lam gsum gyi// zhes sogs kyi skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i byang sems kyi rnam dag ni bstan bya'i gtso bo dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag shin tu ba yin pa dang*/ theg dman gyi rnam dag shin tu ba ma yin pa ni zhar byung gi tshul du ston pa'i phyir te/ sa dgu la ni chen po yi// ces pa'i 'tshams sbyar du/ lam (7) shes gnyis kyi skabs su rnam par dag pa smros pa'i zhar la sangs rgyas dang nyan thos la sogs pa'i rnam par dag pa go rim bzhin du shin tu ba dang gcig shos su bshad pa de ji lta bu yin zhe na/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa la/ rgyu mtshan dang*/ dgos pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rnam mkhyen de rgyu lam shes phan 'dogs byed du yod na 'byung la/ de phan 'dogs byed du med na mi 'byung bas de las logs su bzhag pa yin te/ 'bras bu rnam mkhyen thob pa ni rgyu lam shes nyams su len pa la rag las pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa la/ rtsod pa dang*/ de'i lan gnyis/ dang po ni/ rnam mkhyen las logs su lam shes bzhag pa dgos med du thal/ rnam mkhyen 'chad pa'i skabs su (8) mthong lam sgom lam sogs lam shes bstun zin pa'i phyir/ rnam mkhyen thob byed kyi rgyud kyang lam shes bstan mi dgos te/ rnam mkhyen ni shes bya thams cad mngon sum du rtogs pa'i yul can yin kyang gnas lugs kyi don bsgoms pa can gyis thob nus pa'i phyir/ ce na/ gnyis pa ni/ dang po la skyon med de/ rnam mkhyen 'chad pa'i skabs su theg chen gyi mthong lam sgom lam la sogs pa'i lam shes ni rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi ldog pa nas bshad/ 'dir ni de thob par byed pa'i rgyu'i ldog pa nas bshad pas bstan tshul mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yod pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa yang mi 'thad de/ gzhi'i dus su gzhi lam rnam pa'i chos thams cad thos bsam gyis gtan la phab pa'i don de nyid tshul (9) bzhin du nyams su blangs pa las 'bras bu rnam mkhyen sgrub dgos pa'i phyir/ 'grel chen las/ gal te de lta yin na rab tu dga' ba la sogs pa'i sa rnams kyang der smros nas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mthong ba la sogs pa'i lam bstan pa yin pa'i phyir yang ci'i phyir bstan ce na/ brjod par bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi rgyu dang 'bras bu ma lus par thugs su chud pa las ltos te rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ces brjod pa yin pas/ rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyi lam ni/ de las gsungs pa ma yin zhes dgos pa bsal bar bya ba'i phyir/ de nyid las rgyu tsam zhig drangs nas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mthong ba la sogs pa'i lam shes pa nyid du logs shig tu bzhag pa yin no// zhes gsungs so// yang na/ 'khor rnying pa'i brnyas pa spang ba dang gsar pa'i rgyud la sher phyin gyi rtogs pa skyed pa'i phyir du de las (10) logs su bshad pa yin te/

rnam mkhyen gyi mdo bshad zin pa'i rjes su lhag pa'i 'khor rnams la sngar gyi mdo de nyid bshad na bshad bya'i chos yang 'di tsam du zad do snyam nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa la brnyas pa skye bar 'gyur la/ sher phyin gyi mdo ma gsungs na/ 'khor gsar pa rjes su 'dzin pa mi nus pa la dgongs nas lam shes kyi mdo gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ bsdu ba spyir bstan pa dang*/ dka' gnas so so bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ lo chen na re/ lam shes mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gcig po bsdu na rten gyi gang zag dang*/ de'i rgyud la yod pa'i lam shes gnyis su 'dus/ dang po la/ lam shes skye ba'i lus rten/ bsam pa'i rten/ nye bar len pa'i rgyu'i rten/ rang bzhin can gyi rten/ byed las can gyi rten gyi gang zag ste lnga/ gnyis pa la/ shes bya nyan thos/ rang rgyal/ byang sems kyi lam gsum mo// zhes gsungs so// rang lugs ni (11) 'dre ar ltar/ lam shes kyi yan lag dang*/ yan lag can gyi lam shes gnyis su 'dus/ dang po la lam shes ma skyes pa skyed par byed pa'i yan lag dang*/ skyes nas gzhan la phan 'dogs pa'i yan lag gnyis/ dang po la/ gegs nyon mongs mngon gyur pa dang bral ba'i lus rten/ mthun rkyen byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i bsam pa'i rten/ nye bar len pa'i rgyu theg chen gyi rigs sad pa dang gsum dgos te/ 'jig rten na/ ston thog phun sum tshogs pa skyed pa la gegs tsha go sogs dang bral ba'i zhing sa/ lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen chu lud nye bar len pa'i rgyu sa bon drung pa sogs gsum dgos pa bzhin no// dang po ni/ lha rnams rung ba bya ba'i phyir// zhes sogs rtsa 'grel gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ yul nges pa dang*/ ces sogs rtsa 'grel gyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ khyab pa dang ces sogs (12) rtsa 'grel gyi bstan/ gnyis pa la/ lam shes kyi rang bzhin dang*/ de'i byed las gnyis/ dang po ni/

gzhan don du 'khor bar skye ba len pa'i rgyu nyon mongs pa'i bag chags ched du gnyer nas mi spong ba'i rang bzhin can yin la/ de nyid rang bzhin dang ni zhes pa rtsa 'grel gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ lam shes rgyud la skyes pa'i byang chub sems dpas gdul bya 'khor du ma bsdus pa bsdus/ bsdus pa rnams smin/ smin pa rnams grol/ grol ba rnams mthar phyin pa'i lam la 'khor ba'i mdzad pa'i phrin las yin la/ de nyid/ de'i las zhes pa rtsa 'grel gyi bstan/ gnyis pa la/ nyan thos/ rang rgyal/ theg chen gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes gsum ste/ rigs can gsum rjes su bzung ba'i phyir du shes bya lam gsum phyin ci ma log par shes dgos pa'i phyir/ dang po ni/ lam shes nyid kyi tshul la ni/ zhes sogs kyis bstan/ de'i rgyu nges 'byed (13) cha mthun gyis 'phags pa nyan thos lam la ni/ zhes sogs kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ rang rgyal gyi khyad chos khyad gzhi rang rgyal gyi ngo bo/ de ji ltar shes tshul lo// dang po ni/ rang byung bdag nyid rtogs pa'i phyir// zhes sogs kyis bstan/ de la rtsod pa spang pa ni/ gang gang don ni gang gang la// zhes sogs kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ bzung don rtogs pa spong phyir dang*// zhes sogs kyis bstan/ gsum pa la/ theg chen 'phags pas 'dzin pa chos kyis bdag med shes tshul de la/ mngon sum du gsar du mthong ba'i tshul gyis shes pa dang*/ mthong zin rgyun du goms pa'i tshul gyis shes pa gnyis su nges pa'i phyir/ dang po ni/ bden dang bden la bzod pa dang*// ces sogs mdor bstan rgyas bshad kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ sgom lam gyi byed pa dang*/ byed pa can gyi sgom lam gnyis te/ sgom lam gyi gdul bya sgom lam pa (14) spro bas 'jug pa'i phyir du sgom lam gyi 'bras bu dang*/ sgom lam rang gi ngo bo gnyis gsungs pa'i phyir/ dang po ni/ kun nas zhi dang zhes sogs kyis bstan/

gnyis pa la/ zag bcas sgom lam dang*/ zag med sgom lam gnyis ste de la rjes thob dang*/ mnyam bzhag gis bsdus pa'i sgom lam gnyis su nges pa'i phyir/ dang po la/ mos bsngo rjes su yi rang gsum ste/ byang chub sems dpas rjes thob tu bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs par byed dgos la/ mos pas dang por de bsog par byed/ bsngo bas de mi zad par byed/ rjes su yi rang gi de gong 'phel du byed pa'i phyir/ dang po/ mos pa'i ngo bo dbye ba dang bcas pa ni/ mos pa rang gi don dang ni// zhes sogs kyis bstan/ de'i phan yon ni/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa la// zhes sogs rtsa 'grel gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ yongs su bsngo ba khyad par can// ces sogs rtsa 'grel gyis bstan no// gsum pa ni/ thabs (15) dang mi dmigs pa dag gis// zhes sogs kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ sgrub pa bsgom lam dang*/ rnam dag bsgom lam gnyis su yod de/ de la bar chad med lam dang*/ rnam grol lam gnyis su yod pa'i phyir/ dang po ni/ de yi ngo bo nyid mchog nyid// ces sogs kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la lnga las/ dang po ni/ rnam dag bsgom lam gyi rgyu dang rgyu ma yin pa'i rab dbye ni/ sangs rgyas rten dang sbyin sogs dang*// zhes sogs kyis bstan/ gnyis pa de'i ngo bo spyir bstan pa ni/ 'bras bu dag pa gzugs la sogs// zhes sogs kyis bstan/ gsum pa de'i dbye ba ni/ nyon mongs shes bya lam gsum gyi// zhes sogs kyis bstan/ bzhi pa sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag shin tu bar sgrub pa'i tshul ni/ sa dgu la ni chen po yi// zhes sogs kyis bstan/ lnga pa/ de la rtsod pa spong ba ni/ de la klan ka spangs (16) pa yis// zhes sogs kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ rnam mkhyen gyi 'og tu lam shes bshad pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ rnam mkhyen de rgyu lam shes phan byed du yod med kyi rjes su 'gro ldog byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ltar du bshad pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa la gnyis las/ dang po lam shes kyi yan lag ni/ lha rnams rung bar bya ba'i phyir// ces skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ lam shes kyi yan lag la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ dogs gcod dang gsum/ dang po ni/ lam shes dngos su skye ba'i lus rten la sogs pa chos lnga gang rung gis bsdus pa'i lam shes kyi khyad chos so// dbye na/ lam shes ma skyes pa bskyed par byed pa'i lam shes kyi yan lag dang*/ skyes nas gzhan la phan 'dogs pa'i yan lag gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ lam shes kyi yan lag gang zhig lam shes ma thob pa thob par byed pa'i phyir du brtson par byed pa'i rgyu yis (17) bsdus pa/ dbye na/ dngos su skye ba'i lus rten/ de'i bsam pa'i rten/ de'i nye bar len pa'i rgyu rigs dang gsum/ dang po ni/ nyon mongs mngon gyur pa dang bral ba'i chos mchog skad cig tha ma la gnas pa'i byang sems lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ de'i rgyud kyi sems bskyed lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ lam shes kyi rgyur gyur pa'i yid kyi rnam par shes pa gsal rig lta bu/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de'i yan lag gang zhig lam shes kyi ngo bo dang 'bras bu gang rung gis bsdus pa/ dbye na/ lam shes kyi rang bzhin dang*/ de'i byed las gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzhan don du 'khor bar skye ba len pa'i rgyu nyon mongs pa'i bag chags ched du gnyer nas mi spong ba'i theg chen gyi mthong lam sgom lam lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ lam shes kyis bdag rkyen byas pa la brten nas byung ba'i mdzad pa'i 'phrin las lta bu/ gsum pa la/ kha cig lam shes dngos (18) su skye ba'i gang zag gi rgyud la nga rgyal mngon gyur pa med par bshad pa ni/ 'jug shes kyis bsdus pa'i nga rgyal med pa las dgongs pa yin gyi/ nga rgyal gtan med ma yin te/ de'i rgyud la nyon yid 'khor du byung ba'i nga rgyal yod pa'i phyir te/ so skye yin pa'i phyir zer/ mthun rkyen byang chub mchog tu sems ma bskyed pa'i gang zag gi rgyud la lam shes dngos su skye ba yod par thal/

nga rgyal mngon gyur pa dang ma bral ba'i gang zag gi rgyud la lam shes dngos su skye ba yod pa'i phyir/ gal te gtan tshigs ma grub ste/ nyon yid 'khor du byung ba'i nga rgyal de nga rgyal mngon gyur pa ma yin ce na/ shes sgrib rtog pa yin na/ shes sgrib mngon gyur yin pas ma khyab par thal/ nyon sgrib rtog pa yin na/ nyon sgrib mngon gyur pa yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ nyon yid 'khor du byung ba'i nga rgyal chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ nang 'gal dang gzhan (19) yang nyon mongs pa'i bag chags de nyon sgrib yin par thal/ de la mngon gyur pa dang sa bon gnyis su grangs ma nges pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ rang lugs/ spyir so skye thams cad kyi rgyud la/ nyon yid yod par bshad pa ni rags bshad tsam yin la/ dmigs bsal du/ chos mchog skad cig tha ma la gnas pa'i byang sems ni so skye yin kyang nyon yid dang mi ldan te/ de nga rgyal dang bral bar bshad pa'i phyir te/ nga rgyal bcom pa'i rgyud kho na la rtogs pa skye'o ces bshad pa'i phyir/ dper na/ theg dman gyi sems bskyed rnams spyir bstan du rang don yid byed dang ldan par bshad kyang*/ theg chen lam du dngos su 'jug kha ma la dmigs bsal yod pa bzhin no// gnyis pa ni/ lam shes kyi yan lag chos can khyod la dbye na lngar yod de/ lam shes ma skyes pa bskyed par byed pa'i yan lag gsum/ skyes nas gzhan la phan 'dogs par byed pa'i yan lag

(20) gnyis rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ theg pa gsum rnam par bzhag pa ni// zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po la/ mthar thug la ltos te theg pa gsum grub ma grub la/ sems can thams cad sangs rgya mi rgya la/ 'khor ba la mtha' yod med la dpyad/ 'phros don gzhan bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po dngos smra ba'i lugs dgag dbu ma pa'i lugs bzhag de la rtsod pa spang ba'o// dang po la/ 'dod pa brjod pa dang*/ de dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ dngos smra ba rnams na re/ lang gshegs la sogs pa'i mdo las/ mthar thug theg pa gcig tu gsungs pa ni/ drang don dgongs pa can yin te/ de la dgongs gzhi/ dgos pa/ dngos la gnod byed gsum yod pa'i phyir/ dang po ni/ theg pa gsum po de gzhi'i dus su chos dbyings tha dad med par/ lam gyi dus su bdag med rtogs par/ 'bras bu'i dus su rnam grol thob par mtshungs pa la dgongs pa'i phyir/ (21) rgyan las/ chos dang bdag med grol ba dag /mtshungs phyir rigs ni tha dad phyir// ces so// gnyis pa ni/ nyan thos ma nges pa theg chen du kha drang pa dang*/ theg chen ma nges pa theg dman du mi ltung bar theg chen du bzung ba'i phyir yin te/ rgyan las/ kha cig dag na drang phyir dang*// gzhan yang kun tu bzung ba'i phyir// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis ni// ma nges rnams la theg gcig bstan// zhes so// gsum pa dngos la gnod byed yod de/ lhag med myang 'das thob nas theg chen gyi lam du zhugs te sangs rgya ba med pa'i phyir te/ sangs rgya ba la gzhan don du 'khor bar skye ba blang ste tshogs gnyis rdzogs par bya dgos la/ der 'dus byas kyi 'jug pa rgyun chad pa'i phyir/ dgongs 'grel las/ nyan thos kyi rigs kyi gang zag zhi ba bgrod pa gcig pu pa ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad brtson pa dang ldan par gyur kyang byang chub kyi snying po la bzhag ste/ (22) bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par mi nus/

zhes dang*/ bsdu ba las/ de la don dam pa zhes sogs so// zhes so// des na mthar thug theg pa gsum du grub ste/ sems can 'di dag dang por gzhi dus su 'ga' zhig nyan thos kyi rigs can du nges/ 'ga' zhig rang rgyal gyis rigs can du nges/ 'ga' zhig theg chen gyi rigs can du nges pas khams tha dad/ de dang mthun par mos pa yang tha dad/ bar du byang chub gsum sgrub tshul yang tha dad/ mthar thug byang chub gsum sgrub tshul yang tha dad pa'i phyir/ rgyan las/ khams rnams dang ni mos pa dang*// sgrub pa tha dad dbye ba dang*// 'bras bu tha dad mthong ba'i phyir// rigs yod dang ni nges pa yin// zhes so// gnyis pa la/ lung dang rigs pa'i gnod byed gnyis/ dang po ni/ lang gshegs las/ theg pa gcig tu nges smras te// theg pa rnam bzhag yod ma yin// byis pa (23) rnams ni yongs drang phyir// theg pa tha dad nges bshad do// zhes so// gnyis pa la/ dngos stobs rigs pas gnod pa dang*/ khas blangs na'ang 'gal gyis gnod pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ theg dman la mthar thug gi myang 'das med par thal/ mthar thug gi myang 'das thob pa la sgrib gnyis kyi gnyen po chos dbyings sgom dgos la/ theg dman gyis chos thams cad bden pas stong pa'i chos dbyings sgom par mi nus pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ theg dman gyi theg pa las logs su theg chen gyi theg pa bstan pa dgos med du thal ba dang*/ 'dus byas rang bzhin gyis grub par khas blangs pa dang yang 'gal lo// gal te skyon med de/ theg dman la theg chen gyis bsgom bya'i chos dbyings las rigs tha dad pa'i chos dbyings sgom rgyu gzhan yod pa'i phyir/ ce na/ mi 'thad de/ chos dbyings la rigs mi 'dra ba'i dbye ba med pa'i phyir te/ (24) 'phags pa bden pa gnyis la 'jug pa las/ chos dbyings tha dad med pa'i phyir theg pa la ni tha dad med do// zhes dang*/ klu sgrub kyis/ chos kyi dbyings la dbyer med phyir// gtso bo'i theg pa dbyer ma mchis// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/

dngos smra ba chos can/ sgrib gnyis spangs pa'i mthar thug gi myang 'das med par thal/ sgrib pa gnyen po'i stobs kyis spong mi nus pa'i phyir te/ de bden grub yin pa'i phyir/ des na theg dman la mthar thug gi myang 'das med de/ de ni rang don chos skus bsdus pa'i phyir te/ rgyud blar/ gang phyir de ni chos sku de bzhin gshegs// de ni 'phags pa'i bden pa don dam mya ngan 'das// de phyir nyid dang zer bzhin yon tan dbyer med pa// sangs rgyas nyid las ma gtogs mya ngan 'das pa med// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ mthar thug theg chen gyi theg pa gcig pur nges te/ mthar thug sems can thams cad theg (25) chen gyi lam du zhugs te sangs rgya bar nges pa'i phyir/ 'di'i sgrub byed 'og tu 'chad/ gsum pa la/ lung dang 'gal ba'i rtsod pa spong ba dang*/ rigs pa dang 'gal ba'i rtsod pa spong ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ mthar thug theg pa gsum du grub ste/ blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo las/ gsum po 'di dag ni nges par 'byin pa'i theg pa yin te/ nyan thos kyi theg pa dang*/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang*/ theg pa chen po'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zer na/ skyon med de/ de ni mthar thug la ltos te drang don dgongs pa can gyi mdo yin pa'i phyir ro// de la dgongs gzhi/ dgos pa/ dngos la gnod byed gsum yod pa'i phyir/ dang po ni/ gnas skabs theg pa tha dad pa gsum yod pa la dgongs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis dub pa'i sems can rnams gnas skabs su dman pa'i myang 'das la bkod nas (26) mthar thug theg pa chen po la kha drang pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ dper na/ ded dpon thabs la mkhas pas lam ring pos dub pa'i mgron po dbugs dbyung ba'i phyir du/ bar skabs su grong khyer yid 'ong sprul nas slar yang rim gyis nor bu rin po che'i gling du phyin par byed bzhin no// de yang 'jug par/

de phyir mkhas pas rin po che'i gling du chas pa'i skye tshogs kyi// ngal ba nyer sel grong khyer yid 'ong bar du rnam par bkod pa ltar// khyod kyi theg pa 'di ni slob ma nye bar zhi ba'i tshul la yid// sbyar zhing rnam par dben la'ang blo sbyangs rnams la logs su gsungs// zhes dang*/ dam chos pad dkar las/ drang srong chen pos theg pa gsum bstan pa// rnam 'dren rnams kyi thabs la mkhas pa ste// bkri ba'i don du theg pa gsum bstan to// zhes so// gsum pa dngos la gnod byed ni/ sngar bshad pa'i lung rigs rnams yin cing*/ gzhan yang pad dkar las/ theg pa gcig (27) ste gnyis pa yod ma yin// gsum pa nam yang yod min 'jig rten na// skyes bu mchog rnams thabs kyis theg pa gang*// sna tshogs nye bar ston pa mdzad ma gtogs// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gal te lhag med myang 'das thob nas theg chen gyi lam du zhugs te sangs rgya ba med de/ der 'dus byas kyi 'jug pa rgyun chad pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ lhag bcas myang 'das dang*/ lhag med myang 'das la khyad par med par 'gyur ro// zhe na/ mi 'thad de/ lhag med myang 'das kyi don 'dus byas kyi 'jug pa rgyun chad pa'i 'gog bden tsam la mi 'dod pa'i phyir te/ lhag bcas myang 'das la gnas pa'i nyan thos dgra bcom pas/ las nyon gyis 'phangs pa'i zag bcas kyi phung po dor nas dag pa'i zhing du zag med kyi lus blangs pa'i dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog bden la lhag med myang 'das su 'dod pa'i phyir/ (28) de 'dra ba'i gang zag theg chen lam du ma 'jug pa yang ma yin te/ de zag med kyi ting nge 'dzin la yun ring du mnyam par bzhag pa las sangs rgyas kyi 'od zer gyis sad par bya ste/ sems can gyi sdug bsngal bsal 'dod kyi snying rje/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi mdzad spyod la dmigs pa'i dad pa gnyis dang ldan pa'i sgo nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i phyir te/

lang gshegs las/ ting nge 'dzin gyi lus thob nas// bskal pa'i bar du mi sad do// dper na skyes bu myos pa ni// myos 'gyur med na sangs pa ltar// de bzhin de dag ra'i sku// sangs rgyas chos zhes bya ba thob// ces dang*/ byang chub sems 'grel las/ nyan thos de dag ji srid du// sangs rgyas rnams kyis ma bskul ba// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir// gnyis pa la/ dgag bzhag gnyis/ dang po ni/ mkhas pa red mda' ba na re/ sems can thams cad sangs rgya nges ma yin te/ rigs pa dang lung gnyis kyis gnod (29) pa'i phyir/ ji ltar gnod na/ sems can thams cad sangs rgya ba'i rgyu tshogs grangs tshang du thal/ 'dod na/ de rgyu tshogs gnyis dang ldan par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ sangs rgya ba la rgyu tshogs gnyis bsags pa sngon du 'gro dgos pa'i phyir/ sangs rgya ba la 'gal rkyen gyi gegs med par thal/ 'dod na/ sgrib pa dang bral bar thal lo// de thams cad rkyen 'khor lo bzhi ldan du thal ba dang*/ de thams cad sangs rgyas zin pa'i dus srid par thal ba dang*/ sa bon yin na myu gu skyed nges yin pas khyab par thal/ sems can yin na sangs rgya nges yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ lung gi gnod de/ lha yi rgyal pos char phab kyang*// zhes dang*/ rgyud blar/ gang zhig yid ni chos la sdang ba de la thar pa ga la yod// ces sogs zer na/ dang po la/ sangs rgya nges kyi gang zag yin na/ de'i rgyu tshogs grangs tshang yin dgos par thal/ khyab 'brel de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod (30) na/ ma 'ongs pa na/ theg chen gyi lam du zhugs nas sangs rgya nges kyi lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rgyu tshogs gnyis dang ldan par thal/ de'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ gnyis pa yang nges khegs/ gsum pa de la/ sangs rgya nges kyi sems can yin na/ rkyen 'khor lo bzhi dang ldan pas khyab par thal/ khyab 'brel de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgya bar nges shing da lta dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis ma zin pa'i gang zag chos can/

der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bdag rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi zin pa'i gang zag tu thal/ de'i phyir/ khyab ste/ bshes spring las/ mthun par gyur pa'i yul na gnas pa dang*// skyes bu dam pa la ni brten pa dang*// bdag gi legs smon sngon yang bsod nams bgyis// 'khor lo chen po bzhi ni khyod la mnga'// zhes so// bzhi pa de la/ dngos (31) po thams cad zhig zin pa'i dus srid par thal/ de thams cad 'jig nges yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dngos po thams cad zhig zin pa'i dus de dngos po yin par thal/ de yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ zhig zin par thal/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dngos por med par thal la/ lnga pa la/ sa bon min na myu gu bskyed pa'i nus pa 'gal rkyen gyis 'joms mi nus pas khyab par thal/ sems can yin na rang rgyud kyi sangs rgyas kyi rigs 'gal rkyen gyi 'joms mi nus pa'i khyab pa'i phyir/ lung des mi gnod de/ gnas skabs sangs rgya bar dka' ba tsam la dgongs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sems can thams cad sangs rgya nges yin te/ lung dang rigs pa gnyis kyis grub pa'i phyir/ dang po ni/ ye shes snang ba rgyan gyi mdo las/ tha na log pa nyid du nges pa'i rgyud du gyur pa'i sems can rnams (32) kyi lus la'ang de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'od zer phog pas de dag la phan thogs par 'gyur zhing*/ ma 'ongs pa'i rgyu yang dag par skyed pas dge ba'i chos rnams kyi rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ zla ba sgron me'i zhus pa'i mdo las/ 'gro ba 'di dag ma lus sangs rgyas 'gyur// 'di ni snod min sems can 'ga' yang med// ces so// gnyis pa ni/ sems can thams cad sangs rgya nges yin te/ de'i rgyud la rgyu'i gtso bo rigs kyis khyab/ 'gal rkyen sgrib pa spang du rung*/ mthun rkyen sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las 'jug tu rung ba'i phyir/

dang po yin te/ dri ma dang bcas pa'i sems kyi chos dbyings kyis sems can thams cad la khyab pa'i phyir te/ rgyud blar/ rdzogs sangs sku ni 'phro phyir dang*// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yin te/ dri ma ni sems dang 'bral rung gi glo bur ba yin pa dang*/ de spong byed kyi (33) gnyen po yod pa dang*/ gnyen po la nan tan gyi sgo nas 'jug pa yod pa dang*/ sgrib pa spangs pa'i spangs pa las slar ldog pa mi srid pa'i phyir/ dang po yin te/ sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba nam mkha' lta bu la/ dri ma ni glo bur du byung ba'i sprin lta bu yin te/ rgyud blar/ rang bzhin gyis ni ma grub dang*// khyab dang glo bur ba nyid kyis// nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa de// sprin dang 'dra bar brjod pa yin// zhes dang*/ rnam 'grel las/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ste// dri ma rnams ni glo bur ba// zhes so// gnyis pa yin te/ 'phags rgyud kyi mnyam rjes gnyis kyis sgrib gnyis sa bon dang bcas pa 'joms pa'i phyir te/ rgyud blar/ sgrib pa gnyis dang bral ba yi// rgyu ni ye shes gnyis yin te// mi rtog pa dang de yi ni// rjes thob de ni ye shes 'dod// ces so// gsum pa yin te/ sangs (34) rgyas thob phyir du grangs med gsum du tshogs gnyis bsog pa'i rnam grol don gnyer gyi gang zag yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa yin te/ zag med bar chad med lam gyis spang bya'i sa bon spangs zin pa na/ sgrib pa slar skye ba'i rgyu med pa'i phyir/ dper na/ rtsa ba bcad pa'i shing gi yal ga bzhin no// rtsa rtags gsum pa yin te/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las 'jug rung du gzigs nas 'khor ba ji srid bar gzhan don mdzad pa dang*/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las sgrol bar dam bcas pa mthar phyin par mdzad pa dang*/ 'phrin las 'jug pa'i thabs mkhyen cing mkhyen pa ltar mdzad pa'i thugs rje dang ldan pa'i phyir/

dang po yin te/ rgyud blar/ gzhan gyi dbang gis nges 'byung dang*// bdag dang sems can mtshungs gzigs dang*// mdzad pa yongs su ma rdzogs phyir// 'khor ba srid du mdzad mi (35) 'chad// ces so// gnyis pa yin te/ sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// dang po'i dam bca' mthar phyin mdzad// ces so// gsum pa yin te/ 'jug pa las/ bder gshegs gang phyir khyod la mkhyen rab thabs dang thugs rje lhan cig pa// mda' dang gang phyir bdag gis sems can sgrol zhes khyod kyis zhal bzhes te// zhes so// gsum pa la/ dgag bzhag spang gsum/ dang po la/ a bha ya ka ra'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ dar ṭīka pa na re/ 'khor ba'i thog mtha' med kyang phyi mtha' yod do// 'khor ba ni/ smon pa med cing bri ba dang bcas pa yin pa'i phyir dang*/ 'khor ba stongs pa'i dus srid pa'i phyir/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas zin pa'i dus srid pa'i phyir te/ de thams cad sangs rgya nges yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang de yod par thal/ 'khor ba zad pa yod pa'i phyir te/ (36) de zad pa'i skyes bu yod pa'i phyir/ yang de yod par thal/ byang sems tshogs lam pa'i 'khor ba la mtha' yod pa'i phyir te/ sangs rgya nges kyi byang sems tshogs lam pa yod pa'i phyir/ zer/ dang po la/ smon pa med cing bri ba dang bcas pa'i chos yin na/ mtha' dang ldan pas khyab par thal/ sgrub byed de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ shar phyogs kyi nam mkha' la 'dom gang gzhal ba'i tshe/ shar phyogs kyi nam mkha' chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas zin pa'i dus kyi longs sku yod par thal/ 'dod na de 'dra'i longs sku chos can/ longs sku ma yin par thal/ 'khor nges par byang sems 'phags pa dang mi ldan pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las rgyun chad pa'i dus srid par thal/ de sems can la mi 'jug pa'i dus srid pa'i phyir te/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas

(37) zin pa'i dus srid pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ gzhi grub na 'khor ba yod pas ma khyab par thal/ 'khor ba tshad mas mi dmigs pa yod pa'i phyir te/ 'khor ba med pa'i lam yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa la/ 'khor ba la thog mtha' yod par thal/ skyes bu lha byin gyi tshe 'di'i 'khor ba la thog mtha' yod pa'i phyir te/ tshe 'di'i rnam smin gyi phung po 'phen pa'i ma rig pa'i rten 'brel yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa/ rang lugs ni/ 'khor ba la mtha' med de/ thog mtha' yang med/ phyi mtha' yang med pa'i phyir/ dang po yin te/ sems can gyi rgyud kyi sems gsal rig gi rigs 'dra thog ma med pa nas gnas pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yin te/ lung rigs gnyis kyi grub pa'i phyir lung ni/ mdzod 'grel du/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba re res sems can grangs med pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das kyang sems can rnams yongs su gtugs pa med (38) de/ nam mkha' bzhin no// zhes so// rigs pa yod de/ 'khor ba stong pa'i dus mi srid pa'i phyir te/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis nam mkha' ma zhig gi bar du sems can gyi don mdzad par dam bcas pa don yod pa'i phyir te/ rgyud blar/ rgyu mtha' yas dang sems can zad med dang*// brtse dang 'phrul dang mkhyen dang phun tshogs ldan// chos kyi dbang phyug 'chi ba'i bdud 'joms dang*// ngo bo med cing 'jig rten mgon po rtag /ces dang*/ 'jug par/ rgyal ba ji srid 'jig rten mtha' dag mchog tu rab zhi bar// 'gro ba min zhing nam mkha' rnam 'jig 'gyur min de srid du// shes rab yum gyis bskyed pa khyod la thugs brtse'i ma ma yis// tshul lugs byed pas rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ba ga la mnga'// zhes so// gzhan yang 'khor ba la mtha' med de/ 'khor ba'i thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid kyi stong gzhi'i chos can (39) du bshad pa'i phyir te/ 'jug pa las/ thog ma dang po tha ma mtha'// de dag med pas 'khor ba ni// thog ma tha ma med par brjod// ces so// gal te dus gsum po de mi dmigs par thal/

de mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi stong gzhi'i chos can du bshad pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ zhe na/ 'dus byas de dngos po stong pa nyid kyi stong gzhi'i chos can du bshad na/ de dngos po ma yin pas khyab par thal/ khyod kyi thal 'gyur la khyab pa yod pa'i phyir/ khyab pa sgrig 'tshams la khas/ de dag gis ni/ sdud pa las/ rkyen rnams tshogs nas las kyi 'khrul 'khor rab tu 'byung*// shes rab pha rol phyin la zad med 'phel ba med// ces pa'i don bshad pa yin no// gsum pa la/ gal te 'khor ba la phyi mtha' yod de/ bzhi brgya pa las/ yul la bdag med mthong nas ni// srid pa'i sa bon ldog par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ (40) rigs gter las/ sa bon thog ma yod min yang*// mes bsregs pa na phyi mtha' mthong*// de bzhin 'khor ba thog med kyang*// bdag med mthong nas phyi mtha' 'grub// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ zer na/ skyon med de/ gang zag sgos tshan pa 'ga' zhig gi 'khor ba la phyi mtha' yod pa la dgongs kyi/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas zin pa'i dus srid pa la dgongs pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa la/ theg dman dgra bcom pa theg chen lam gyi ma mtha' gang nas 'jug dpyad pa dang*/ zhugs pa'i gang zag skye 'phags gang yin dpyad pa'o// dang po la kha cig dang por theg chen gyi mthong lam nas dngos su 'jug pa'i 'dod/ kha cig nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa yod na mthong lam nas dngos su 'jug cing*/ med na tshogs lam nas dngos su 'jug ces zer/ mi 'thad de/ theg chen gyi mthong lam du dngos su 'jug (41) kha ma'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa chos can/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i gang zag tu thal/ lam shes dngos su skye ba'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khyab ste/ de yang byang chub tu sems bskyed pa kho na yin pas yul so sor nges pa yin no// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsag pa sngon du ma song ba'i sangs rgyas 'phags pa yod par thal/

theg chen gyi tshogs sbyor sngon du ma song ba'i sangs rgyas 'phags pa yod pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ khyab ste/ tshogs sbyor sa dang po dang bcas pa grangs med gcig gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar la grangs med gcig dag pa sar grangs med gcig tu tshogs bsags pa las/ sangs rgyas thob par dgos par bshad pa'i phyir/ rang lugs ni/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam 'jug ste/ sangs rgya ba la theg chen gyi lam lnga rim (42) gyis bgrod dgos pa'i phyir te/ chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i rnam mkhyen thob pa la de rtogs zin bsgom par byed pa'i sgom lam sngon du 'gro dgos/ de thob pa la de mngon sum du gsar du rtogs pa'i mthong lam sngon du 'gro dgos/ de thob pa la de bsgom byung gi sgo nas don spyi'i tshul du rtogs pa'i sbyor lam sngon du 'gro dgos/ de thob pa la chos kyi bdag med thos bsam gyi sgo nas don spyi'i tshul du rtogs pa'i tshogs lam sngon du 'gro dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ mkhas pa snga ma'i lugs brjod pa dang*/ ṭī ka mdzad pa'i dgongs pa gnyis/ dang po la mkhas pa kha cig theg dman dgra bcom pa'i rtogs pa sngon du song ba'i theg chen tshogs sbyor ba ni/ theg chen 'phags pa yin te/ 'phags pa gang zhig theg chen gyi skyes bu yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig de mi 'thad de/ theg chen gyi mthong lam rang rgyud (43) la ma thob pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang 'phags pa yin te/ bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i skyes bu yin pa'i phyir te/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i skyes bu yin pa'i phyir te/ nyon sgrib zad par spangs pa'i skyes bu yin pa'i phyir/ yang de yin te/ chos dkon mchog rgyud la ldan pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ nyon sgrib spangs pa'i 'gog bden rgyud la ldan pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ so skye yin par mi 'thad de/ de chos can/ 'jig rten pa thal ba dang*/

'phags lam ma thob par thal/ so skye yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ kun btus las/ so so'i skye bo ni gang zhe na/ 'phags pa'i chos rnams ma thob pa la so so'i skye bo zhes gdags so// zhes dang*/ mdzod las/ lam ma thob pa so so yi// skye bor 'dod do de thob dang*// zhes so// kha cig so skye (44) yin te/ theg chen gyi so skye yin pa'i phyir te/ theg chen gyi skyes bu gang zhig theg chen gyi 'phags lam thob ma myong ba'i phyir dang*/ chos kyi bdag med don spyi'i tshul du rtogs pa'i skyes bu yin pa'i phyir/ de rtogs pa gang zhig mngon sum du ma rtogs pa'i phyir/ zhes zer/ gnyis pa la/ lung drang ba/ lung don la log rtog dgag pa/ lung don phyin ci ma log par bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ ṭī ka las/ 'o na nyan rang theg chen gyi tshogs lam du zhugs pa la sngar gyi rtogs pa ji ltar ldan ce na/ sngar dgra bcom thob pa ni nyon mongs spangs zin pas/ de'i gnyen po la 'bad mi dgos pa'i phyir/ sngar gyi bdag med rtogs pa res 'ga' mngon du 'gyur ba srid kyang phal cher dbang ldan gyi tshul du gnas la/ theg chen gyi rtogs rigs rnams mngon gyur du ldan no// rgyun zhugs dang phyir 'ong sogs theg chen la (45) zhugs pa ni sngar gyi nyon mongs kyi lhag ma spang dgos pas/ sngar gyi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa dang*/ chos nyid don spyi'i tshul du bsgom pa gnyis ka gang zag gcig gi rgyud la lhan cig tu 'jug pa ma yin te/ theg chen gyi thar pa cha mthun ni/ chos nyid kyi don spyi'i yul can yin la gcig shos ni bdag med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor mngon sum yin pa'i phyir ro// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa la/ kha cig mtha' gcig tu 'phags pa yin pa dgongs pa yin te/ de'i rgyud la gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor mngon sum ldan pa'i phyir te/ de dbang ldan gyi tshul du ldan pa'i phyir zer/

kha cig theg chen slob pa 'phags pa'i rtogs pa sngon du song ba ni 'phags pa yin te de'i rgyud la gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab mngon gyur du ldan pa'i phyir te/ des nyon mongs pa'i lhag ma spong dgos pa'i phyir/ dgra bcom gyi rtogs pa sngon du song ba ni so skye yin zer/ kha cig spyir so skye yin kyang*/ de'i rgyud la bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab yod pa ni dmigs bsal yin zer/ lugs dang po mi 'thad de/ des gang zag gi (46) bdag med mngon sum du ma rtogs pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyud la de mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab med pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de'i rgyud la de mngon gyur du yod par 'gyur/ gnyis pa mi 'thad de/ rgyun zhugs tsam gyi rtogs pa sngon du song ba'i theg chen gyi tshogs lam chos can/ chos kyi bdag med don spyi'i tshul du rtogs par thal/ theg chen gyi thar pa cha mthun yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ theg chen gyi thar pa cha mthun ni/ chos nyid la don spyi'i yul can yin la/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa thal/ 'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na bdag med don spyi'i tshul du rtogs par thal/ chos kyi bdag med don spyi'i tshul du rtogs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ de 'dra'i gang zag chos can/ khyod kyi rgyud la gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa dang*/ chos kyi bdag med don spyi'i tshul du rtogs pa gnyis lhan cig tu yod par thal/ khyod kyi rgyud kyi thar pa cha (47) mthun de chos nyid la don spyi'i yul can yin cing*/ khyod kyi rgyud la gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ṭī ka dang dngos su 'gal/ lugs gsum pa yang mi 'thad de/ theg dman 'phags pa'i rtogs pa sngon du song*/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen thar pa cha mthun chos can/

khyod la 'dzin stangs tha dad pa gnyis yod par thal/ khyod la gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs dang*/ chos nyid don spyi'i tshul du rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ rtags chos can dang bcas pa khas/ gzhan yang*/ de chos can/ rtog pa dang rtog med kyi shes pa'i gzhi mthun dang*/ chos nyid la rtog pa dang gang zag gi bdag med la rnal 'byor mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ rtags dang po der thal/ chos nyid don spyi'i tshul du 'dzin pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir te/ (48) theg chen gyi thar pa cha mthun yin pa'i phyir te/ ma khyab na/ ṭī ka khas len pa la dngos 'gal ma yin nam/ rang lugs ni/ theg dman 'phags pa'i rtogs pa sngon du song ba'i theg chen tshogs lam pa la/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rtogs pa mngon gyur ram dbang ldan gang du ldan zhe na/ dgra bcom gyi rtogs pa sngon du song ba'i theg chen tshogs lam pa la theg chen gyi mthong lam ma skyes pa'i snga rol du/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rtogs pa res 'ga' mngon du 'gyur ba'i skabs srid kyang*/ phal cher sa bon nus ldan gyi tshul du gnas te/ des nyon mongs pa'i gnyen po gang zag gi bdag med bsgom pa la 'bad mi dgos pa'i phyir te/ des nyon mongs pa spangs zin pa'i phyir/ 'o na/ res 'ga' mngon du 'gyur ba'i dus gang zhe na/ de 'dra'i gang zag gis rang don yid byed kyi theg (49) dman gyi bsam pa la yang dang yang du goms par byas pa'i stobs kyis theg dman du ltung srid la/ de yang theg dman gyi lam lnga rim gyis bgrod dgos pa ma yin te/ sngar gyi dgra bcom gyi rtogs pa mngon du byed nus pa'i phyir/ rgyan las/ de gnyis yang dang yang du ni// rang sems kun tu 'byung ldan pas// mya ngan 'das la mngon dga'i phyir// rtogs pa bul ba yin par 'dod// ces so// gal te/

rgyun zhugs dang phyir 'ong tsam gyi rtogs pa sngon du song ba'i theg chen tshogs lam pa la gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab mngon gyur du ldan par thal/ des nyon mongs kyi gnyen po gang zag gi bdag med sgom lam pa la 'bad dgos pa'i phyir te/ des nyon mongs pa'i lhag ma spong dgos pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ des de spong dgos kyang*/ de'i rgyud la gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab mngon gyur du (50) mi ldan te/ de'i rgyud la chos nyid don spyi'i tshul du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi thar pa cha mthun mngon gyur du ldan pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ blo de gnyis gang zag gcig gi rgyud la lhan cig tu 'jug pa mi srid pa'i phyir/ mkhyen pa gcig nyid la chos nyid don spyi'i tshul du rtogs pa dang*/ gang zag bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs tha dad pa gnyis mi srid pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i don no// des na dgongs pa so skyer gnas te/ theg chen gyi so skye yin pa'i phyir te/ chos nyid don spyi'i tshul du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi skyes bu yin pa'i phyir/ gal te/ de chos can/ so skye ma yin par thal/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i phyir te/ nyon sgrib zad par spangs pa'i phyir de chos can/ 'phags pa'i spangs rtogs thob pa la ma nyams pa'i gang zag ma yin par thal/ so skye yin pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ dang po la (51) gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i mkhyen pa yin na/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du gsar du rtogs pa sngon du 'gro dgos par thal/ nyon sgrib zad par spangs pa'i spangs pa yin na/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa dang lhan cig tu nges par gnas dgos pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod kyis ma nges/

gzhan yang*/ rnam mkhyen skad cig dang po chos can/ ngo bo nyid sku mngon sum du gsar du mthong ba'i lam sngon song du thal/ de mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ 'dod na/ slob lam na ngo bo nyid sku mngon sum du rtogs pa yod par thal lo// gnyis pa la/ de chos can/ dgra bcom gyi spangs rtogs thob la ma nyams pa'i gang zag ma yin par thal/ slob pa (52) yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ gzhan yang*/ dgra bcom gyi rtogs pa sngon du song ba'i chos nyid la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i sbyor lam chos can/ rang yul gyi gtso bo mngon sum du rtogs par thal/ rnal 'byor mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ chos nyid la mngon sum du thal/ 'dod pa gang zhig chos nyid 'dzin stangs kyi yul du byed pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ srid zhi la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes su thal/ 'khor 'das bar gsum bden med du rtogs pa'i gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir te/ bden med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ khams gsum la 'dod chags dang bral ba'i theg dman dgra bcom pa dang*/ phyi rol pa'i ston pa rdzogs byed chos can/ khyod sogs sems can thams cad mthar thug sangs rgya ba la/ gnas skabs rgyu lam shes sgom dgos te/ khyod sogs dri bcas kyi skye bo thams cad

(53) mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ theg pa gsum gyi rnam bzhag ston pa'i mdo chos can/ mthar thug la ltos te/ nges don mtshan nyid pa'i mdo ma yin te/ de la ltos te drang don dgongs pa can gyi mdo yin pa'i phyir/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ni/ zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ skabs 'dir bstan gyi nyon mongs pa de nyon mongs mtshan nyid pa dang*/ btags pa pa gang yin spyad pa la/ mkhas pa snga ma'i lugs brjod/ mi 'thad pa'i cha dgag rang lugs bzhag pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ mkhas pa 'dre ar na re/ 'dir bstan gyi nyon mongs de nyon mongs btags pa pa yin te/ byang 'phags kyi snying rje/ sems bskyed/ smon lam gsum gyis zin pa'i dge rtsa la/ de'i ming gis btags nas bstan pa'i phyir te/ de la de'i ming gis 'dogs pa'i (54) rgyu mtshan/ brtags pa'i dgos pa/ dngos la gnod byed kyi chos gsum yod pa'i phyir/ dang po yin te/ nyon mongs mtshan nyid pas rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag 'khor bar sbyor ba bzhin du/ des kyang byang sems 'phags pa 'khor bar skye ba'i rgyu byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yin te/ gzhan don du 'khor bar skye ba don du gnyer ba'i byang chub sems dpas de ched du gnyer nas bzung dgos par rtogs pa'i ched yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa yin te/ nyon mongs kyi gnyen por gyur pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir te/ blo gros rgya mtsho'i zhus pa'i mdo las/ 'khor ba'i rgyu dge ba'i rtsa ba dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i nyon mongs pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ bsod nams kyi tshogs yongs su tshol bas mi ngoms pa dang*/ bsam bzhin du srid par skye ba yongs su 'dzin pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang phrad pa don du gnyer ba dang*/ sems can yongs su smin pa'i phyir (55) mi skyo ba dang*/ dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa la brtson pa dang*/ sems can gyi bya ba ci yod pa la 'grus pa dang*/ chos la chags pa'i bsam pa dang ma bral ba dang*/

pha rol tu phyin pa'i kun tu sbyor bas rnams mi 'dor ba ste/ blo gros rgya mtsho gang dag gi byang chub sems dpa' kun tu sbyor bar byed kyang*/ nyon mongs pa'i skyon gyi ma gos pa dge ba'i rtsa ba dang mtshungs ldan pa'i nyon mongs pa 'di dag go /zhes so// legs bshad gser phreng pa na re/ 'dir bstan gyi nyon mongs de nyon mongs btags pa pa yin te/ byang sems 'phags pa 'khor bar skye ba len pa'i skye ba la de'i ming gis btags nas bstan pa'i phyir/ zer/ dar ṭīka pa na re/ 'dir bstan gyi nyon mongs mtshan nyid pa de/ de'i nyon mongs pa'i bag chags la 'dogs pa'i phyir/ byang sems 'phags pas gzhan don du 'khor bar skye ba'i rgyur 'dir bstan gyi (56) nyon mongs dgos pa ma yin te/ de grogs su med kyang ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du 'khor ba skye ba len nus pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang ched du gnyer nas mi spong ba'i rgyu mtshan yod do// des 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i tshul bzung nas/ bu stong bskyed pa la sogs pa'i grogs su 'dir bstan gyi nyon mongs pa dgos pa'i phyir/ zhes zer/ gnyis pa ni/ dang po mi 'thad de/ byang sems 'phags pas bsams bzhin du srid par skye ba tshad med par 'dzin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ nyon mongs pa'i bag la nyal ched du gnyer nas mi spong bar bshad pa 'brel med du thal/ byang sems 'phags pas gzhan don du 'khor bar skye ba len pa'i rgyur gyur pa'i nyon mongs pa'i bag la nyal gzhi ma grub pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ 'dod na 'grel chen las/ ma rig pa dang*/ lta ba'i bag la nyal 'joms kyi 'dod sred kyi bag la nyal mi 'joms te/ bsams bzhin du srid pa (57) skye ba len pa'i phyir/ zhes pa dang 'gal/ gzhan yang*/ byang sems 'phags pas/ 'dir bstan gyi nyon mongs pa ched du gnyer nas spong mi spong dgos pa dpyod mi dgos par thal/ de byang 'phags kyi mkhyen pa la 'jog rigs pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa la/ 'khor ba ji srid bar sems can gyi don byed par zhugs pa nyid kyis nyon mongs pa rnam pa thams cad spangs pa ma yin/ zhes pa dang*/ 'dod sred kyi bag la nyal mi 'joms te/ bsams bzhin du srid pa skye ba len pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i gzhung gnyis kyi rtags chos 'brel med du thal/ 'dir bstan nyon mongs pa de/ byang 'phags gzhan don du 'khor bar skye ba len pa'i rgyu ma yin pa'i phyir te/ de des 'khor bar skye ba blangs pa'i skye ba la 'jog rigs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa yang mi 'thad de/ nyon mongs pa'i bag chags ni nyon sgrib spangs pa'i dgra bcom sogs (58) kyi rgyud la yang yod pa'i phyir/ 'di'i dgag sgrub rgyas par skabs dang por bshad zin to// khas blangs dang 'gal ba'i gnod byed yang yod de/ byang sems 'phags pas 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i tshul bzung nas/ bu stong bskyed pa'i ched du nyon mongs pa'i bag chags ched du gnyer nas mi spong ba ma yin par thal/ de grogs su med kyang gzhan don du bu stong bskyed pa sogs nus pa'i phyir/ 'dir bstan gyi nyon mongs pa nyon mongs pa'i bag la nyal yin cing*/ de yang nyon mongs pa mtshan nyid pa yin/ zhes spyi don du bshad kyang*/ gsungs rgyun gyi dgongs pa ma yin no// 'thad pa ni/ nyan thos dgra bcom pas 'dir bstan gyi nyon mongs zad par spangs par thal/ de nyon mongs mtshan nyid pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dgra bcom gyi rtogs pa sngon du song ba'i byang sems 'phags pa gzhan don du 'khor bar skye ba len pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo dang mi (59) ldan par thal/ 'dir bstan gyi nyon mongs byang sems 'phags pa gzhan don du 'khor bar skye ba len pa'i rgyu'i gtso bor bshad cing*/ des de spangs pa'i phyir/ byang sems 'phags pas gzhan don du 'khor bar skye ba blangs pa'i skye ba de rang rgyu las nyon gyi dbang gis byung ba'i skye bar thal lo// gsum pa rang lugs la/

nyon mongs pa'i sgra/ 'jug tshul/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ 'dir bstan gyi nyon mongs ngos bzung ba/ zhar la yang srid du skye ba len tshul gyi dbye ba bshad pa'o// dang po la/ nyon mongs pa'i sgra 'jug pa'i yul de la/ mngon gyur/ sa bon/ bag chags gsum yod/ dang po ni/ sems rgyud rab tu ma zhi bar byed pa'i sgo nas rang yul gyi dmigs rnams 'dzin byed kyi rig pa'o// mtshan gzhi/ rtsa nyon/ nye nyon/ de dag dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i sems (60) sems byung mtha' dag go /gnyis pa ni/ sems rgyud la nyon mongs pa'i rigs 'dra snga mas bzhag pa'i nus pa gang zhig rkyen dang phrad na nyon mongs pa phyi ma skyed pa'i rigs gnas/ dbye na/ nyon mongs pa dang lhan cig tu 'jug pa'i sa bon dang*/ rang dus su nyon mongs pa 'gags zin pa'i sa bon gnyis/ dang po ni/ ma rig pa rigs 'dra snga mas phyi ma skyed bzhin pa'i nus pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ mnyam bzhag la gnas bzhin pa'i nyan thos 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa'i sa bon lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ sems rgyud la nyon mongs pa'i rigs 'dra snga mas bzhag pa'i gnas ngan len gyi dri ma phra zhing phra ba gang zhig rkyen dang phrad kyang nyon mongs pa'i rigs 'dra phyi ma 'byung ba'i nus pa gtan med pa/ nyon mongs pa'i bag chags/ de'i gnas ngan len/ ma rigs bag chags kyi sa rnams ming gi rnam grangs so// de yang dang po (61) gnyis ni nyon sgrib mtshan nyid pa yin la/ phyi ma btags pa pa yin te/ de'i ming gi 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan/ btags pa'i dgos pa/ dngos la gnod byed kyi chos gsum tshang ba'i phyir/ dang po yin te/ nyon mongs pa mtshan nyid pas/ rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag 'khor bar skye ba'i rgyu byed pa bzhin du/ 'dis kyang byang sems 'phags pa dang*/ theg dman dgra bcom pa'i 'khor bar yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus len pa'i rgyu byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yin te/ byang sems 'phags pas 'khor bar skye ba len pa dang lhag bcas myang 'das la gnas pa'i nyan thos dgra bcom pas lhag med myang 'das mngon du bya ba'i phyir du/

yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus len pa'i rgyur nyon mongs pa'i bag chags ched du gnyer nas bzung dgos par shes pa'i ched yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ de nyon mongs mtshan (62) nyid pa yin na/ nyan thos dgra bcom pas de spangs par thal/ de nyon mongs mtshan nyid pa yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa de dgra bcom mtshan nyid pa ma yin par 'gyur te/ des khams gsum na spyod pa'i nyon mongs pa ma spangs pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ 'bum ṭīka las/ dgra bcom pas nyon mongs kun spangs kyang ma rig pa'i bag chags ma spangs la/ zhes pa dang 'gal/ gzhan yang nyan thos dgra bcom pas ma rig pa'i bag chags ma spangs la/ zhes pa dang 'gal/ nyan thos dgra bcom pas ma rig bag chags kyi sas rkyen/ zag pa med pa'i las kyis rgyu byas pa las byung ba'i yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus len pa spangs par thal/ des nyon mongs pa'i bag chags spangs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gtsang ba dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ bde ba dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos (63) sku thob par thal/ 'dod pa de'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rgyud blar/ yid kyi rang bzhin phung po dang*// de rgyu log phyir gtsang ba nyid// ces dang*/ 'grel par/ de la dgra bcom pa dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ dbang thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni nye ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi rten du gyur pa ma rig pa'i bag chags kyi sa ma spangs pas nyon mongs pa'i dri ma dri nga ba'i bag chags thams cad dang ldan pa'i phyir/ gtsang ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa rab kyi mthar phyin pa mi 'thob bo// zhes so// des na/ de nyon mongs btags pa pa yin te/ rgyud bla'i 'phrin las kyi skabs su/ nyon mongs shes bya'i sprin gyi drwa ba sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rje'i rlung gis rnam par gtor// zhes pa'i rgyas bshad du/ de sgrib mtha' yas nyon mongs dang*// nye ba'i nyon mongs bag chags so// dus kun tu ni de 'joms pa'i// rkyen ni thugs rje

(64) chen po yin// zhes rtsa nyon dang*/ nye nyon gnyis nyon mongs mtshan nyid pa dang*/ de'i bag chags shes sgrib kyi mtshan gzhir bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sngar bshad pa'i nyon mongs pa dang po gnyis/ 'dir bstan gyi nyon mongs ma yin te/ 'dir bstan gyi nyon mongs pa ni byang sems 'phags pas gzhan don du 'khor bar skye ba len pa'i rgyu byed la/ des las nyon gyi dbang gis 'khor bar skye ba spangs zin pa'i phyir te/ 'phags pas 'chi dang na ba dang*// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na gsum pa'i steng nas 'jog de la yang*/ thabs mkhas khyad par can gyis ma zin pa'i byang chub kyi gegs byed pa'i nyon mongs pa'i bag chags dang*/ snying rje la sogs pa thabs mkhas khyad par can gyis zin pa'i sgo nas byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs su gyur pa'i nyon mongs pa'i bag chags gnyis las/ dang po 'dir bstan gyi nyon mongs pa ma yin (65) te/ de byang sems 'phags pas ched du gnyer nas spong ba yod pa'i phyir/ cig char nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa spong ngo*// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'dir bstan gyi nyon mongs pa yin te/ de byang sems 'phags pas gzhan don du tshogs bsog pa'i yan lag tu ched du gnyer nas 'dzin pa'i phyir te/ 'od srung gis zhus pa'i mdo las/ ji ltar grong khyer skye bo'i mi gtsang lud// de ni bu ram shing pa'i zhing la phan// de bzhin byang chub sems dpa'i nyon mongs lud// de ni sangs rgyas chos rnams bskyed la phan// zhes dang*/ blo gros rgya mtsho'i zhus pa'i mdo las/ de la byang chub sems dpa' ni thabs la mkhas pa dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba'i stobs bskyed pas bsams bzhin du khams gsum du kun tu sbyor te/ des na dge ba'i rtsa ba dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i nyon mongs pa zhes bya'o// ji srid du khams gsum (66) par kun tu sbyor bas yin gyi sems nye bar nyon mongs pa ni ma yin no// zhes dang*/

thogs med kyis/ thabs chen rnams dang ldan pa la// srid pa'ang zhi ba'i bdag nyid de// nyon mongs byang chub yan lag gyur// de srid rgyal sras bsam mi khyab// ces so// des na nyon mongs pa'i bag chags la thabs mkhas khyad par can gyis zin ma zin gnyis yod pa'i dbang gis/ byang sems 'phags pas ched du gnyer nas spong mi spong gnyis yod 'thad de/ 'grel chen las/ ma rig pa dang lta ba'i bag la nyal 'joms kyi sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro// de yang ma rig pa dang lta ba'i bag la nyal spong bar bshad pa dang*/ 'dod sred kyi bag la nyal mi spong bar bshad pa dang*/ phan tshun mtshon pa'i dpe tsam yin gyi/ de ltar nges par ma yin te/ thabs mkhas khyad par can gyis zin pa'i ma rig pa dang lta ba'i bag la nyal yang ched du gnyer (67) nas mi spong la/ des ma zin na/ 'dod sred kyi bag la nyal yang ched du gnyer nas spong ba yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la gang gis skye ba len pa'i rgyu dang*/ ji ltar skye ba len pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ theg dman slob pa dang*/ so skye rnams ni las nyon gnyis kyi dbang gis skye ba len te/ des sa bon ma spangs pas mi 'dod bzhin du 'khor bar skye 'chi byed pa'i phyir/ theg dman dgra bcom pa dang*/ byang sems 'phags pa ni ma rig bag chags kyis dang*/ zag pa med pa'i las kyi rgyu la brten nas 'khor bar skye ba len te/ dang pos lhag med myang 'das thob phyir du/ gnyis pas gzhan don du tshogs bsog pa'i phyir du yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus len dgos shing*/ rgyu las nyon gnyis zad par spangs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ theg dman slob pa'i dang*/ so so skye bo rnams (68) nyon mongs pas kun nas bslangs nas zag bcas kyi las bsags te/ 'khor ba skye rga'i rten 'brel gnyis 'grub par byed pa bzhin du/ theg dman dgra bcom pa dang*/ byang sems 'phags pas kyang*/ ma rig bag chags kyi sas rkyen zag pa med pa'i las kyis rgyu byas te/

yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus len pa dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur pa'i 'chi 'pho byed par bshad pa yin no// ma rig bag chags kyis ni nyon mongs pa'i bag chags tsam la bshad/ zag med kyi las ni yang srid kyi rgyu byed pa'i snying rje sems bskyed la sogs pa'i dge rtsa/ yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus ni 'gro ba rigs drug skye gnas bzhi/ khams gsum gang rung gis bsdus pa ma yin cing*/ yid las byung ba'i zag med kyi lus sprul pa lta bur snang ba la bshad de/ 'bum ṭīka las/ 'gro ba'am/ skye gnas sam/ srid pa gang (69) du yang mi bgrang zhing yid las byung ba'i lus sprul pa lta bu lha'i sprul pa nyid ni ma yin no// zhes so// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ gdul bya'i sems can dag pa'i blo ngor sku'i snang ba nub pa la mya ngan las 'das pa dang*/ gdul bya sems dag pa'i blo ngor sku'i snang ba shar ba la sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa'i tha snyad 'dogs pa tsam yin gyi/ srog 'gags pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa dang*/ khams gsum gang rung du gsar du skye ba bzhes pa la sogs pa ni med do// rgyud blar/ ji ltar bai ḍūr sa gzhi gtsang ma la// lha dbang lus kyi gzugs brnyan 'char ba ltar// de bzhin 'gro sems sa gzhi gtsang ma la// thub pa'i dbang po'i sku yi gzugs brnyan 'char// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i byang sems mthong lam pa chos can/ gzhan don du

(70) 'khor ba skye ba len pa'i rgyur gyur pa'i nyon mongs pa'i bag chags ched du gnyer nas mi spong ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ gdul bya'i 'khor bar ji srid bar sems can gyi don byed par zhugs pa'i rgyal sras 'phags pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yan lag can gyi lam shes la/ nyan thos/ rang rgyal/ theg chen gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes dang gsum/ dang po ni/ lam shes nyid kyis tshul la ni// zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po la/ shes bya lam gsum ngos bzung ba dang*/ de ji ltar du shes tshul/ yul can lam shes/ mdo bstan bcos las ji ltar du bstan tshul lo// dang po la/ dgag bzhag gnyis/ dang po la/ khyab ches pa dgag pa dang*/ khyad chung ba dgag pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'dre ar na re/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs/ shes bya nyan thos kyi lam/ nyan thos kyi lam (71) don gcig de bzhin du bzung ba chos kyi bdag med sogs la'ang 'gre/ des na nyan thos kyi lam yin na nyan thos kyi rgyud la yod pas ma khyab ste/ byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs de nyan thos kyi lam yin pa'i phyir te/ shes bya nyan thos kyi lam yin pa'i phyir/ gal te ma khyab na/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam chos can/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyud la yod par thal/ de'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ ngan song pa'i rgyud kyi dge ba'i las lam chos can/ bde 'gro'i rgyud la yod par thal/ de'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod pa'i rten gyi bsam gtan dang po'i snyoms 'jug chos can/ bsam gtan dang po'i rgyud la yod par thal/ de'i snyoms 'jug yin pa'i phyir/ zhes zer/ mi 'thad de/ sdug bsngal chos bzod la gnas pa'i byang sems (72) kyi rgyud kyi gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs chos can/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam du thal/ nyan thos kyi lam dang mthong lam gyi gzhi mthun yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khyod rgyud ldan gyi gang zag de nyan thos mthong lam pa thal lo// des sgom lam sogs la 'gre/

sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs chos can/ theg dman gyi theg par thal/ theg dman gyi lam dang theg pa'i gzhi mthun yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mthar thug theg dman gyi theg pa grub par thal/ sgrib gnyis zad par spangs pa'i theg dman gyi theg par grub pa'i phyir/ yang theg dman gyi bgrod bya'i lam du thal lo// gnyis pa la kha cig shes bya nyan thos kyi lam yin na/ nyan thos kyi rgyud kyi lam yin dgos te/ byang chub sems dpas shes par bya ba'i nyan thos kyi lam yin na/ (73) de yin dgos pa'i phyir te/ byang chub sems dpas rtogs par bya ba'i nyan thos kyi lam yin na/ de yin dgos pa'i phyir/ zer/ mi 'thad de/ byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud la bskyed par bya ba dang*/ rtogs rigs gong 'phel du bya ba'i shes bya nyan thos kyi lam gzhi ma grub par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ lam thams cad bskyed par bya zhing lam thams cad shes par bya'o zhes pa dang 'gal lo// nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs yin na/ nyan thos kyi rgyud kyi rtogs rigs yin dgos par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ theg chen gyi mthong lam de/ theg pa gsum gyi rtogs rigs tshang ba'i lam ma yin par 'gyur/ 'dod na/ theg pa gsum char 'thob pa'i rgyu zhes pa dang 'gal/ gnyis pa/ rang lugs la/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ dogs gcod gnyis/ dang po ni/ (74) gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs dang*/ shes bya nyan thos kyi lam don gcig de la/ nyan thos/ rang rgyal/ theg chen gyi rgyud la yod pa'i shes bya nyan thos kyi lam gsum/ de bzhin du bzung ba chos kyi dang*/ shes bya rang rgyal gyi lam don cig de la yang rang rgyal dang*/ theg chen gyi rgyud la yod pa gnyis/ 'dzin pa chos kyi dang*/ shes bya theg chen gyi lam/ theg chen gyi lam/ theg chen gyi rtogs pa rnams don gcig nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs dang*/

shes bya nyan thos kyi lam don gcig pa ma yin te/ nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs yin na/ shes bya nyan thos kyi lam yin pas khyab kyang*/ shes bya nyan thos kyi lam yin na/ de yin pas mi khyab pa'i phyir/ de yang nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs kyi mtshan gzhi ni/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs tsam yin/ des rang rgyal la yang rigs 'gre/ gnyis pa dogs (75) gcod la/ kha cig shes bya nyan thos kyi lam dang*/ shes bya theg chen gyi lam 'gal te/ nyan thos kyi lam dang theg chen gyi lam 'gal ba'i phyir/ de bzhin du/ nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs dang theg chen gyi rtogs rigs 'gal te/ nyan thos kyi rtogs pa dang theg chen gyi rtogs pa 'gal ba'i phyir/ zer/ byang sems mthong lam pa'i rgyud kyi gang zag gi bdag med dang*/ 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med gnyis ka rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ yin par thal/ 'dzin pa'i chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs yin pa'i phyir/ 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa dang*/ bzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa 'gal bar thal/ de'i rtogs (76) rigs 'gal ba'i phyir te/ shes bya'i lam 'gal ba'i phyir/ lugs gnyis pa ni/ rang lugs su khas len/ de la kho na re/ de gnyis mi 'gal bar thal/ de gnyis kyi gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir te/ de gnyis kyi mtshan gzhi gnyis kyi gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir te/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs ni/ nyan thos kyi de'i mtshan gzhi/ 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs ni theg chen gyi de'i mtshan gzhi gang zhig rtogs rigs de gnyis kyi gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ byang sems mthong lam pa'i rgyud kyi gang zag gi bdag med dang*/ 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs chos can/

theg chen gyi rtogs rigs ma yin par thal/ nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs yin pa'i phyir/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs yin pa'i phyir/ (77) khyab ste/ de de'i mtshan gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ thun mong ba dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa gnyis mi 'gal bar thal/ de gnyis kyi mtshan gzhi mi 'gal ba'i phyir te/ sangs rgyas pa'i dad pa'i stobs de dang po dang*/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs de gnyis pa'i mtshan gzhi gang zhig de gnyis mi 'gal ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas pa'i dad pa'i stobs chos can/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen du thal/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ de de'i mtshan gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa rnams rim bzhin khas/ gnyis pa la/ gzhan rgyud la yod pa'i shes tshul dang*/ rang rgyud kyi shes tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi rtogs pa'i chos kyi spyan gyis gang zag gzhan (78) rgyud kyi gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs kyi ngo bo/ dmigs rnam/ skye tshul mngon sum du shes par 'dod dam/ des rang dang rgyud tshod mnyam pa man chad kyi 'phags pa'i gang zag gi dbang po'i dbye ba thams cad mngon sum du shes nus pa'i phyir/ mdo las/ 'dod chags dang bcas pa'i sems la/ 'dod chags dang bcas pa'i sems su ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so// zhes sogs dang*/ 'grel par/ 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad rtogs pa dang*// zhes dang*/ mdzod las/ nyan thos mthong bas skad cig gnyis// rigs te bse ru lta bu gsum// sangs rgyas sbyor ba med pa kun// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ rjes thob dang*/ mnyam bzhag du shes tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ byang sems 'phags pas rjes thob tu gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs rang rgyud la nyams su myong (79) ba'i sgo nas mngon sum du shes par byed/

gnyis pa ni/ byang sems 'phags pas mnyam bzhag du gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs bden med du mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis shes par byed de/ rnam pa mi dmigs sgo nas ni// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa la/ dgag bzhag gnyis/ dang po la/ kha cig byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs/ nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes yin gyi/ bden med kyi rnam pa can ma yin te/ slob lam du bden gnyis cig char du rtogs pa med pa'i phyir/ rnam pa mi dmigs sgo nas ni// zhes gsungs pa yang*/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi sa zin pa tsam la dgongs pa min/ zer/ mi 'thad de/ byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs (80) pa'i mkhyen pa chos can/ khyod lam shes ma yin par thal/ khyod kyi lam bden med du ma rtogs pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na/ nyan thos kyi lam dang*/ lam shes kyi gzhi mthun yod par 'gyur/ yang de chos can/ srid zhi la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes su thal/ lam shes yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dus gsum bden med du rtogs par thal/ 'dod pa de'i phyir/ khyab ste/ dus rnams mnyam pa nyid shes phyir// shes rab pha rol phyin par 'dod// ces so// rang lugs ni/ gdul bya nyan thos kyi rigs can rjes su bzung ba'i phyir du/ nyan thos kyi lam gyi tshul ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs nas/ rtogs rigs kyi yon tan yar ldan du skyed pa la mkhas pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa/ de'i mtshan gzhi/ theg chen gyi 'phags lam mtha' dag go /bzhi pa la/ dgag bzhag gnyis/ dang po la lo chen na re/ 'dir (81) shes bya nyan thos kyi lam dngos su bstan/ yul can lam shes shugs la bstan cing*/ bstan bya'i gtso bo ni yul can lam shes yin gsung ngo*// de mi 'thad de/ 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i shes bya nyan thos kyi lam de nyan thos rang rgyud pa'i lam la byed dam/

theg chen 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi shes bya nyan thos kyi lam la byed/ dang po ltar na/ rnam pa mi dmigs sgo nas ni// zhes pa nas/ 'di'i thad kyi mdor/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la byed pas zhes sbyor ba nyams len rnam mkhyen yid byed dang ldan pa'i lam gsungs pa mi 'thad par thal lo// gnyis pa ltar na/ lam shes dngos su bstan pa dang 'gal/ 'dre ar na re/ 'dir yul can lam shes dngos su bstan nas/ shes bya nyan thos kyi lam shugs la bstan zhes gsungs pa mi 'thad de/ 'dir byang 'phags (82) kyi rgyud kyi gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs dngos su bstan nam ma bstan/ dang po ltar na/ 'dir shes bya nyan thos kyi lam dngos su ma bstan pa dang 'gal/ gnyis pa ltar na/ nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes dngos su bstan pa dang 'gal/ gnyis pa/ rang lugs la/ 'dir bstan gyi mdo bstan bcos gnyis ka las/ lam gnyis ka dngos su bstan te/ bden bzhi mi rtag la sogs bcu drug mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs dang*/ lam de nyid bden med du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i lam gnyis dngos su bstan pa'i phyir/ de yang*/ lam shes nyid kyi tshul la ni// 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dag gi /nyan thos lam 'di zhes pa rtsa 'grel gyis/ shes bya nyan thos kyi lam dngos su bstan/ rnam pa mi dmigs sgo nas ni// nyan thos lam 'di shes par bya// zhes pas/ rnam pa mi dmigs (83) sgo nas zhes sogs kyis// yul can lam shes dngos su bstan// mdo las/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pas de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ gzugs ni mi rtag par yid la bya'o// zhes pa nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bya'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sbyor ba rnam mkhyen yid byed/ dngos gzhi mi dmigs pa/ rjes dge rtsa rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba ste/

khyad chos gsum ldan du gsungs pa ni/ yul can lam shes dngos su bstan pa yin la/ mi rtag pa dang*/ sdug bsngal ba dang*/ zhes sogs gsungs pa ni/ shes bya nyan thos kyi lam dngos su bstan/ shes bya nyan thos kyi lam la yang*/ nyan thos dang byang sems kyi rgyud la yod pa gnyis las/ dang po shugs la bstan cing*/ phyi ma dngos su bstan pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/ rang theg pa chen po'i mthong lam chos (84) can/ nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes yin te/ gdul bya nyan thos kyi rigs can rjes su bzung ba'i phyir du/ nyan thos lam gyi dmigs rnam gyi tshul ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs nas/ rtogs rigs kyi yon tan yar ldan du skyed pa la mkhas pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ rang rgyal lam gyi khyad chos dang*/ khyad gzhi rang rgyal gyi lam ji ltar shes tshul gnyis/ dang po ni rang byung bdag nyid rtogs pa'i phyir/ ces skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ rang rgyal la/ rten gyi gang zag bgrod byed kyi lam/ de dag gi khyad chos bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ mtshan gzhi/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po la dgag bzhag gnyis/ dang po ni/ mkhan chen pa la sogs pa na re/ rang rgyal yin na mi slob pa yin pas khyab ste/ lung rigs gnyis kyis grub pa'i phyir/ dang po yin te/ (85) sher phyin gyi mdo las/ rgyun du zhugs pa dang*/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang*/ phyir mi 'ong ba dang*/ dgra bcom pa dang*/ rang byang chub dang*/ zhes nyan thos la 'bras bu bzhir dbye ba bshad nas/ rang rgyal la dbye ba ma mdzad pa'i phyir dang*/ bzang spyod las/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras// rang rgyal rnams dang slob dang*/ zhes nyan thos la slob dang mi slob gnyis su bshad/ rang rgyal la de ltar ma bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ rigs gter las/ 'phags pa gsum gyi mngon sum gsum// slob dang mi slob sgo nas lnga// de dag snang bcas snang med kyi// dbye ba gnyis gnyis rnam pa bcu// zhes nyan thos la slob dang mi slob kyi rnal 'byor gnyis/

de bzhin theg chen la'ang gnyis bshad/ rang rgyal la de ltar ma bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yin te/ bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal yin na/ mi slob pa yin dgos pa gang zhig rgyu mtshan de chos spyod la yang mtshungs pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ de yin (86) na/ bskal pa brgyar tshogs gnyis bsags pa sngon du 'gro dgos pa'i phyir te/ mdzod las/ bse ru bskal pa brgya yi rgyus// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na/ de grangs med gsum la sangs rgyas// zhes pa nges/ sangs rgyas yin na bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs gnyis bsags pa sngon du song bas khyab pa ma bstan par thal lo// gzhan yang de yin dgos te/ rang sangs rgyas yin na/ rang byung gi bsnyen pa rdzogs pas khyab pa'i phyir te/ me tog phreng rgyud las/ ji ltar gnas pa mkhyen pa na// 'dren pa rang rgyal rang byung gi'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan du na/ rang rgyal gyi lam la gnas pa'i gang zag yin na rang rgyal yin pas khyab par thal ba dang*/ rang rgyal gyi rigs can yin na rang rgyal yin pas khyab par thal/ 'dod na/ byang sems tshogs lam pa chos can/ sangs rgyas su thal/ de'i lam la gnas pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir dang*/ de'i rigs can yin pa'i

(87) phyir/ khyab pa khas/ zer/ de la dam bca' mi 'thad pa dang*/ sgrub byed mi 'thad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang don du theg dman gyi myang 'das don du gnyer ba'i rang rgyal med par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rang sangs rgyas kyang ste mya ngan las 'das par 'dod pa rnams zhes pa dang dngos su 'gal/ bse ru dang ni nyi shu'o// zhes pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i mtshon bya don gyi dge 'dun dkon mchog de/ theg chen mi slob pa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog du thal/ de'i skabs nas bstan pa'i mtshon byed dpe'i rang sangs rgyas de mi slob pa kho na yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de sangs rgyas dkon mchog tu thal/ 'dod pa de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dge 'dun la sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi khongs su gtogs pa nyid kyis dgra bcom pa ma gtogs pa/ zhes pa dngos su 'gal/ dbang po rtul dang rnon po dag /ces sogs kyi skabs su/ dgra bcom 'bras gnas kyi ming can gyi (88) dge 'dun dkon mchog dngos su bstan rigs par thal/ de rang ngos bstan gyi mtshon bya don gyi dge 'dun dkon mchog dang*/ mi slob pa'i gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir/ srid pa tha mal pa'i dus su slob dpon gzhan gyi gdams ngag bstan pa la mi ltos par rang rgyal gyi byang chub mngon du byed nges kyi rang sangs rgyas med par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rang byung bdag nyid rtogs pa'i phyir// gzhan gyis bstan yang mi dgos la// zhes dang*/ 'grel par/ rang sangs rgyas rnams ni sngon thos pa la sogs pa mngon par 'du byas nas gzhan gyis bstan pa la mi ltos par bdag nyid kyis rang gi byang chub mngon par rtogs par 'gyur te/ zhes pa dang dngos su 'gal/ rang rgyal gyi rigs ma gnas pa'i sgo nas/ rnam grol don gnyer gyi theg 'bring gi gang zag med par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ kun btus las/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa gang zhe na/ rang sangs rgyas kyi chos nyid nges pa'am ma nges pa la gnas pa dang*/

rang bzhin gyi (89) dbang po 'bring po dang*/ bdag rnam par thar pa'i phyir smon lam btab pa dang*/ zhes pa dang dngos su 'gal/ gnyis pa ni/ lung gi sgrub byed dang po la/ rang sangs rgyas kyi slob lam yang med par thal/ sher phyin gyi mdo las/ rigs dang*/ brgyad pa dang*/ mthong ba dang*/ bslab pa dang*/ 'dod chags dang bral ba dang*/ byas pa rtogs pa dang*/ nyan thos kyi sa dang*/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sa dang*/ zhes nyan thos la sa bdun bshad nas/ rang rgyal la bya ba ma mdzad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ rang rgyal la dge 'dun dkon mchog yang med par thal/ mdo'i gleng gzhir/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa 'chad pa'i skabs su/ nyan thos dang*/ theg chen gyi dge 'dun dkon mchog bshad nas rang rgyal gyi dge 'dun ma bshad pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ de dag snang bcas snang med kyi// zhes pa'i gzhung des/ 'phags rgyud kyi mnyam bzhag ye shes yin na/ kun rdzob dngos yul du mi byed pa'i snang med rnal (90) 'byor mngon sum yin pas khyab par bstan par thal/ slob dang mi slob sgo nas lnga// zhes pa'i gzhung des rang rgyal yin na/ mi slob pa yin pas khyab par bstan pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de'i khyab pa yod par thal/ 'dod pa gang zhig gzhung 'di bstan don tshad mas grub pa'i gzhung yin pa'i phyir/ rigs pa'i sgrub byed dang po la// de grangs med gsum la sangs rgyas// zhes pa des sangs rgyas yin na/ bskal pa grangs med gsum gyis tshogs gnyis bsags pa sngon du song bas khyab pa ma bstan par thal/ myur bar srid pa gsum gyi mthar// zhes pa des/ brtson 'grus 'bar ba dang ldan pa'i nyan thos yin na/ tshe gsum du tshogs gnyis bsags pa sngon du song bas khyab pa ma bstan pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ gnyis pa la/ mthong lam pa yin na ye shes khong du chud pa'i bsnyen par rdzogs pas khyab par thal/ rang rgyal yin na/ rang byung gi bsnyen par rdzogs pas khyab pa'i phyir/ kha cig dbu ma

(91) pa'i skabs su/ tshogs na spyod pa'i rang sangs rgyas khas mi len te/ de la bse ru lta bus khyab pa'i phyir te/ rgyan 'dir bse ru lta bu'i rang sangs rgyas kho na gsungs kyi/ tshogs na spyod pa'i rang sangs rgyas ma gsungs pa'i phyir/ nyan thos kyi rtogs pa sngon du song ba'i rang rgyal ma grub pa dang*/ grogs gzhan dang lhan cig gnas pa'i sgo nas byang chub bgrod pa'i rang rgyal gzhi ma grub par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa rang lugs ni/ rang rgyal slob pa yod de/ sngar bshad pa'i lung rigs rnams kyis grub pa dang*/ ṭī ka las/ srid pa tha ma pa'i dus su/ byang chub bgrod pa'i rang rgyal bshad pa dang*/ gnyis pa la/ rmi lam dang zhes sogs kyi skabs kyi rang rgyal sgom lam pa yod par gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ kha cig rigs can gsum gyi nang nas rang bzhin gyi dbang po 'bring po'i gang zag dang*/ bzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i theg dman gyi gang zag zer na/ dang po la/ rang rgyal (92) dgra bcom pa chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ rigs can gsum gyi nang tshan du thal/ 'dod pa gang zhig rigs can gzhan gnyis gang rung ma yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ theg dman mthong lam pa'i skyon brjod pa yang yod/ rang lugs ni/ bzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pas rab tu phye ba'i theg 'bring gi gang zag gsum pa la/ lam gyi sgo nas dang*/ mtshan gzhi'i sgo nas dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ rang rgyal tshogs lam pa sogs lnga/ gnyis pa la bse ru lta bu dang*/ tshogs na spyod pa'i rang rgyal gnyis/ 'di dag la khyad chos spyir bshad/ mtshan nyid bsdus te bstan/ 'phros don dogs gcod dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rigs dang*/ dbang po dang*/ grogs dang*/ lam bgrod tshul gyi khyad par bzhi yod/ dang po bse ru lta bu ni/ thog ma nyid nas rang rgyal nyid du rigs nges pa'i rigs can yin la/ gcig shos ni de las gzhan (93) pa/ gnyis pa ni/

bse ru lta bu dbang rnon/ tshogs spyod dbang rtul lta bu'o// gsum pa ni/ bse ru lta bu rang nyid gcig pur gnas te/ gtso bor 'phags lam bgrod/ tshogs spyod ni/ grogs gzhan dang lhan cig gnas pa'i sgo nas gtso bor 'phags lam bgrod/ bzhi pa ni/ bse ru lta bu'i rigs nges pa dang*/ dbang po rno ba'i stobs kyis rang rgyal gyi 'phags lam myur du bgrod nus la/ tshogs spyod de las gzhan pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ tshogs spyod las dbang po rno ba'i rang rgyal gang zhig dang po nyid nas rang rgyal du rigs nges pa sngon du song ba'i sgo nas grogs gzhan la ltos med du rang rgyal gyi byang chub mngon du byed nus/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ bse ru lta bu las dbang po rtul ba'i rang rgyal gang zhig grogs gzhan dang lhan cig gnas pa'i sgo nas rang rgyal gyi byang chub bgrod pa dang*/ bgrod zin pa gang rung gi rigs gnas/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ nyan thos kyi (94) sngon du ma song ba'i tshogs spyod dang*/ song ba'i de gnyis/ de la yang*/ nyan thos so skye tsam sngon du song ba'i tshogs spyod dang*/ 'phags pa sngon song gi de gnyis/ gsum pa la/ nyan thos rang rgyal kyi lam du 'jug tshul la/ gang zag gar 'jug pa dang*/ lam gang nas 'jug pa gnyis/ dang po la/ bye brag tu smra ba'i/ sems tsam pa'i/ dbu ma pa'i lugs dang gsum/ dang po ni/ nyan thos kyi sbyor lam rtse mo thob nas theg chen gyi lam du 'jug pa yod cing*/ bzod pa thob nas med de/ theg chen gyi gang zag ni gzhan don du tshogs rdzogs pa'i phyir du ngan song du skye ba len dgos la/ bzod pa thob nas ngan song du skye ba len pa mi srid pa'i phyir te/ mdzod las/ bzod thob ngan song mi 'gro'o// zhes so// bzod pa thob pa'i nyan thos rang rgyal gyi lam du 'jug par bzhed/ mdzod las/ gnyis slob rigs las bzlog nas ni// sangs rgyas su 'gyur gzhan gsum yang*// zhes so//

(95) bzod pa 'bring thob pa man chad 'jug pa yod kyi/ bzod chen thob nas 'jug pa med de/ bzod chen gyi 'jug thogs de ma thag du chos mchog chos mchog gi de ma thag tu 'phags lam bskyed nus pa gang zhig 'phags lam thob nas lam gzhan du mi 'jug pa grub mtha' yin pa'i phyir/ dang po yin te/ bzod chen dang*/ chos mchog skad cig ma re rer nges pa'i phyir/ mdzod las/ chen po 'dod rtogs sdug bsngal yul// de ni skad cig gcig de bzhin// chos mchog thams cad phung po lnga// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ rgyun zhugs dang phyir 'ong thob pa rang rgyal lam du 'jug pa yod cing*/ phyir mi 'ong thob nas der 'jug pa med de/ rang rgyal slob pas bskal pa brgyar tshogs bsags pa sngon du btang ste/ skye ba phyi ma smon lam gyi dbang gis 'dod khams su skye ste/ byang chub mngon du byed par bshad cing*/ phyir mi 'ong thob nas 'dod pa las nyon gyi dbang gis skye (96) ba len pa med pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ phyir mi 'ong thob nas kyang rang rgyal lam du 'jug pa yod de/ 'dod nyon dgu pa spangs pa'i ma nges pa'i rigs can gyi nyan thos sgom lam pa rang rgyal dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang phrad pa'i dbang gis bzung ba chos kyi bdag med la thos bsam byed srid pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ dngos smra ba'i lugs dang*/ dbu ma pa'i lugs gnyis/ dang po ni/ nyan thos rang rgyal gyi lam du 'jug pa'i tshe/ sngar bgrod zin pa'i lam gyi lhag ma nas 'jug pa yin gyi/ sngar bgrod zin gyi lam mngon du byed mi dgos te/ nyan rang la dbang po tsam gyi khyad par yod kyi/ spangs rtogs la bzang ngan gyi khyad par med pa'i phyir/ dper na/ nyan thos kyi tshogs lam chen po thob pa'i gang zag dbang po sbyangs ba las rang bzhin gyi dbang po 'bring po'i rigs can du 'gyur te/ sbyor lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du byas pa'i tshe/ nyan thos rang rgyal gyi lam du zhugs pa'i tha snyad 'dogs pa yin no// gnyis pa la

(97) kha cig sems tsam pa ltar du khas len pa mi 'thad de/ dbu ma pa'i lugs la nyan rang gnyis la spangs rtogs bzang ngan gyi khyad par yod pa'i phyir/ gzhan du na/ bzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa mthar thug pa la bzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs zin sgom pa gcig sngon du 'gro mi dgos par thal/ rang rgyal dgra bcom gyi 'bras bu thob pa la rang rgyal gyi slob lam bzhi rim gyis bgrod mi dgos pa'i phyir/ gal te ma khyab ste/ spyir rang rgyal la bzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa yod kyang*/ nyan thos kyi rtogs pa sngon song la de med pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ spyir theg chen la 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa dang*/ theg dman gyi rtogs pa sngon song la de rtogs pa med pa'i khyad par 'thad par thal/ sgrub byed de 'thad pa'i phyir/ shes bya rang rgyud kyi lam yin na/ bzung rtog spong nus kyi khyad par dang ldan pas ma khyab par thal/ de yin na/ bzung ba chos (98) kyi bdag med rtogs pas mi khyab pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bzung don rtog pa spong phyir dang*// zhes dang*/ 'grel par/ bzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i don gyi rnam par rtogs pa dag go rim bzhin du spangs ba dang ma spangs ba zhes pa dang*/ dngos su 'gal lo// des na nyan thos rang rgyal gyi lam du 'jug pa'i tshe/ rang rgyal gyi tshogs lam nas 'jug dgos te/ rang rgyal gyi mi slob lam du bzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs pa mthar thug thabs la bzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs zin rgyun ldan du bsgom par byed pa'i sgom lam sngon du 'gro dgos pas sogs pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ bzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i theg pa 'bring po'i mngon rtogs so// dbye na/ rang rgyal gyi bgrod byed kyi lam dang*/ bgrod bya'i lam gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rang rgyal gyi byang chub tu bgrod par byed pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i theg 'bring gi mngon rtogs/
