mtshan gzhi (99) rang rgyal gyi slob lam bzhi lta bu/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang rgyal gyi byang chub tu bgrod zin pa'i theg 'bring gi mngon rtogs/ mtshan gzhi/ rang rgyal dgra bcom pa'i mngon rtogs lta bu/ gsum pa la/ lam bgrod tshul gyi/ tshogs bsags pa dus kyi/ 'bras bu yon tan gyi/ sdangs rtogs kyi/ rten gyi/ 'bras bu 'jog tshul gyi khyad par dang drug dang po la/ bye brag tu smra ba'i/ sems tsam pa'i/ dbu ma pa'i lugs dang gsum/ dang po la/ bse ru lta bu dang*/ tshogs na spyod pa'i lam bgrod tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ tshogs lam gyi gnas skabs su bskal pa brgyar tshogs bsags/ srid pa tha ma pa'i dus su bsam gtan bzhi rim gyis bgrod de/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rab mtha' la brten nas/ drod nas zad mi skye shes pa'i byang chub kyi bar stan thog gcig la mngon du byed de/ mdzod las/ ston dang bse ru byang chub bar// bsam gtan (100) mtha' rten gcig la kun// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/ grogs gzhan dang lhan cig tu gnas pa'i sgo nas srid pa tha ma pa'i dus su slob dpon gzhan gyis gdams ngag bstan pa la ma ltos par rang byang chub mngon du byed pa'i tshul gyis bgrod/ de yang sngon bsam gtan lnga brgya dka' thub drag pos gdungs bzhin pa'i gnas skabs su/ rang rgyal dang 'grogs pa'i spre'u gcig gis skyil mo krung 'cha' ba sogs ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog pa'i spyod lam bstan pa na/ de rnams kyis kyang de'i spyod lam dang mthun par bsgoms pas rang byung thob par gyur to// zhes sngon gyi gtam rgyud la bshad/ de dag ni nyi 'og pa'i lugs yin gyi/ kha che bye brag smra bas/ bse ru lta bur kho nar bzhed// gnyis pa la/ lung drang pa dang*/ lung gi don bsdus te bstan pa/ lam bgrod tshul dngos bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ kun btus las/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa gang zhe na/ (101)

rang sangs rgyas kyi chos nyid nges pa'am/ ma nges pa la gnas pa dang*/ rang bzhin gyis dbang po 'bring dang*/ bdag rnam par thar par bya ba'i phyir smon lam btab pa dang*/ yid byung ba dang*/ 'dod chags dang bral ba dang*/ rnam par grol bar bya ba'i bsam pa can dang*/ bdag nyid mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par bya ba'i bsam pa can dang*/ nyan thos kyi sde snod nyid la dmigs nas chos kyi rjes su mthun pa'i chos sgrub pa dang*/ nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun par sngon ma bskyed pa'am/ nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa sngon bskyed pa/ sngon 'bras bu ma thob pa'am/ sngon 'bras bu thob pa'am/ gang yang rung ste/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba med par bdag nyid kyis lam mngon du byas nas/ bse ru lta bur gyur te/ gcig pur gnas pa'am/ rang rgyal lta bur gyur te/ tshogs dang spyod pa gang sdug bsngal gyi mthar phyin par thob pa'o// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ lung don de dag kyang bsdu na/ gang la gnas pa rigs kyi khyad par/ (102) lam thabs shes kyi khyad par/ dmigs pa rten gyi khyad par/ lam bgrod tshul gyi khyad par dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ rang rgyal du rigs nges pa'i bse ru lta bu dang*/ ma nges pa'i tshogs na spyod pa gnyis yod tshul ni/ rang sangs rgyas kyi chos nyid nges pa'am ma nges pa la gnas pa zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa la/ shes rab kyi khyad par ni/ rang bzhin gyi dbang po 'bring dang*// zhes pas bstan/ thabs kyi khyad par ni/ bdag rnam par thar pa'i phyir// zhes sogs kyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ nyan thos kyi zhes sogs kyis bstan/ bzhi pa la/ bse ru lta bu'i lam bgrod tshul dang*/ tshogs na spyod pa'i de gnyis/ dang po ni/ nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa sngon ma bskyed pa'am/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba med par bdag nyid kyis lam mngon du byas nas bse ru lta bur 'gyur te/ gang sdug bsngal gyi mthar phyin pa thob pa'o// zhes pas bstan/
gnyis pa ni/ gzhung lhag ma rnams kyis bstan/

(103) gsum pa la/ bse ru lta bu dang*/ tshogs na spyod pa'i lam bgrod tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang rgyal du rigs nges pa'i gang zag 'ga' zhig tshogs lam gyi gnas skabs su sangs rgyas mnyes par byed pa la sogs pa bskal pa brgya'i bar du tshogs bsags/ mkhas par bya ba'i dngos po drug la mkhas par bya ste/ 'chi 'pho khar smon lam gsum btab nas de'i skye ba phyi ma la srid pa tha ma'i dus su sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis slob dpon gyis gdams ngag bstan pa la mi ltos par 'khor ba spangs pa'i rnam grol lam mngon du byed/ dngos po drug ni/ phung po lnga/ khams bco brgyad/ skye mched bcu gnyis/ rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis/ las rgyu 'bras kyi rab dbye/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi ste/ don tshan drug go /smon lam gsum ni/ sangs rgyas dang nyan thos mi bzhugs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams su skye bar gyur cig der yang slob dpon gzhan la ltos med du rang (104) nyid kyis byang chub mngon du byed nus par gyur cig byang chub thob nas kyang gdul bya la lus kyi sgo nas snying brtse bar byed kyi/ ngag gi sgo nas snying brtse bar ma gyur cig ces pa'o// gnyis pa la/ nyan thos sngon du ma song ba dang*/ de sngon song gi tshogs na spyod pa'i lam bgrod tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang rgyal ma nges pa'i rigs can 'ga' zhig tshogs lam gyi gnas skabs su grogs skyes bu dam pa la brten pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos nyan pa dang*/ tshul bzhin yid la byed pa'i sgo nas bskal pa brgyar tshogs bsags/ mkhas par bya ba'i dngos po drug la mkhas par byas/ 'chi 'pho khar smon lam gsum btab nas skye ba phyi mar smon lam gyi dbang gis slob dpon gzhan gyi gdams ngag la ltos med du rang byang chub mngon du byed/ gnyis pa ni/ nyan thos rigs ma nges pa 'ga' zhig dbang po sbyangs te rang bzhin gyi dbang po 'bring por gyur pa'i tshe/

bskal pa brgyar tshogs bsags/ mkhas par bya (105) ba'i dngos po drug la mkhas par byas te/ 'chi 'pho khar smon lam gsum btab nas skye ba phyi ma la smon lam gyi dbang gis slob dpon gzhan gyis gdams ngag la ltos med du rang byang chub mngon du byed pa'o// 'di la nyan thos so skye tsam sngon du song ba dang*/ 'phags pa sngon du song ba gnyis phyi ma la yang rgyun zhugs tsam dang*/ phyir 'ong tsam sngon du song ba gnyis so// gsum pa la kha cig dbu ma pa'i skabs su yang sems tsam pa'i lam bgrod tshul 'di kho na ltar khas len pa ni mi 'thad de/ 'di ni nyan rang gnyis spangs rtogs khyad par med pa'i sems tsam pa'i lugs yin pa'i phyir dang*/ rgyan rtsa 'grel gyi skabs su/ nyan rang gnyis la spangs rtogs la khyad par bshad pa'i phyir/ des na theg pa chen po'i lam dang*/ cha 'dra ba'i bgrod tshul gyis lam bgrod par byed de/ rang rgyal gyi tshogs sbyor mthong lam dang bcas par bskal pa brgya'i sum char tshogs bsags/ mkhas par bya ba'i dngos (106) po drug la mkhas par byed/ rang rgyal gyi sgom lam chung ngu skor gsum/ 'bring skor gsum gyi skabs su bskal pa brgya'i sum char tshogs bsags pa'o// dngos po drug la mkhas pa'i rtogs pa gong 'phel du byed/ rang rgyal gyi sgom lam chen po skor gsum gyi gnas skabs su bskal pa brgya'i sum char tshogs bsags te/ sngon gyi smon lam gyi stobs kyis slob dpon gzhan gyi gdams ngag la ltos med du 'khor ba spangs pa'i rnam grol rang nyid kyi mngon du byas pa'i sgo nas bgrod pa yin no// dper na/ theg pa chen por/ tshogs sbyor sa dang po dang bcas par bskal pa grangs med gcig sa gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar grangs med gcig dag pa sar bskal pa grangs med gcig tshogs bsags te/ rgyun mthar gzhan gyi gdams ngag la ltos med du rnam mkhyen mngon du byed par bshad pa bzhin no// rtsa bar/

rang byung bdag nyid rtogs pa'i phyir// gzhan gyi bstan yang mi dgos la// zhes pa dang*/ 'grel par/ rang (107) sangs rgyas rnams ni sngon thos pa la sogs pa mngon par 'du byas pas gzhan gyi bstan pa la mi ltos par/ bdag nyid kyis rang gi rang gis byang chub mngon par rtogs par 'gyur te/ de'i phyir de dag la sangs rgyas la sogs pas bstan mi dgos so zhes bya ba ni khyad zhugs pa nyid gcig yin no zhes pa'i don legs par bshad pa yin no// lam bgrod tshul 'di ni rgyan rtsa 'grel du theg pa chen po'i lam gyi ngo bo/ dbye ba/ spangs rtogs kyi rnam bzhag sogs dngos su bshad nas/ theg dman gyi de dag shugs bstan gyi tshul gyis bshad pa las shes par bya ba yin no// deng sang theg pa che chung gi gzhung lugs mi 'dra ba'i khyad par khong du ma chud par phan tshun bsres te 'gal spong byed pa ni ngal ba don med par snang ngo*// gnyis pa la/ kha cig bse ru lta bu la bskal pa brgya'i bar du tshogs bsags dgos kyang*/ tshogs na spyod pa la de ltar mi dgos zer ba dang*/ kha cig dang po nyid nas rang rgyal (108) lam du zhugs pa la de ltar dgos kyang*/ nyan thos sngon song la de ltar bsags mi dgos zhes 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/ shes byed kyi lung rigs gang yang med pa'i phyir/ des na rang rgyal thams cad kyi bskal pa brgya'i bar du tshogs bsags dgos par mtshungs te/ bse ru bskal pa brgya yi rgyus// zhes pa 'dis tshogs spyod la mtshon pa dang*/ rigs gter las/ tshe gsum bskal pa brgya dang ni// grangs med gsum gyi de mthar phyin// zhes dang*/ drin bsab las/ rang sangs rgyas rnams ni bskal pa chen po brgyas mthar phyin par 'gyur ro// mdzod 'grel las/ bskal pa chen po brgyar byang chub pa'i tshogs dag la spyad pas bse ru lta bur 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'di'i bskal pa yang bskal chen du go bar bya'o// gsum pa la/

gnas pa'i/ rgyu'i chos ston pa'i khyad par dang gsum/ dang po ni/ bse ru lta bu'i sku gnas pa gcig pur gnas shing*/ tshogs na spyod pa grogs du ma dang lhan cig tu gnas/ (109) gsung gi gnas pa gnyis ka yang gtso cher smra ba bcad dam po la gnas/ thugs kyi gnas pa rten 'brel zab mo rtogs pa dang*/ rnam thar sgo gsum yid la byed cing gnas so// gnyis pa ni/ mngon shes kyi brtags ste gzhan don du 'gyur na grong dang grong khyer la sogs par bsod snyoms la rgyu bar bshad cing*/ rdzu 'phrul gyi sgo nas gdul bya ma dad pa dad par byed/ dad pa rnams mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi lam la 'god par bshad/ gsum pa ni/ mngon shes kyis gdul bya rnams kyi/ dbang po'i dbye bar shes par byas te/ sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis gdul bya rang rang gi bsam pa dang mthun par lus kyi rigs byed kyi sgo nas chos bstan pas ji ltar 'dod pa'i rtogs pa skyed nus pa yin te/ gang gang don ni gang gang la// zhes sogs rtsa 'grel du bshad pa ltar ro// 'di yang gtso che ba'i dbang du byas pa yin cing*/ rang sangs rgyas yin na sgra bcas su chos mi ston pas khyab par nges pa ma (110) yin no// bzhi pa ni/ sems tsam pa dang*/ dbu ma pa'i lugs gnyis/ dang po ni/ sems tsam pa man chad kyis nyan rang spangs rtogs khyad med du bzhed/ byang sa las/ rang sangs rgyas rnams ni nyan thos ji lta ba bzhin du rig par bya ste/ nyan thos rnams dang lam gyi rang bzhin mtshungs pa'i phyir ro// zhes so// gnyis pa la/ slob dpon legs ldan 'byed la sogs pa'i lugs la/ nyan rang spangs rtogs khyad med du bzhed de/ rtog ge 'bar ba las/ gang zag la bdag med par tsam goms par byas nas 'bras bu dman pa 'dod pas dman pa'i khyad par thob par yod de/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas bzhin no// zhes dang*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas de dag gis ni nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba tsam spangs kyang nyon mongs pa'i bag chags kyang ma yin la/

shes bya'i sgrib pa gnyis ka'i ngo bo nyid kyang ma yin pas/ zhes so// 'phags pa byams pa rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i lugs la/ nyan rang la spangs rtogs kyi khyad par (111) yod de/ nyan thos dgra bcom pas/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa mthar thug cing*/ nyon sgrib spong ba'i nus pa dang ldan/ rang rgyal dgra bcom gyis gzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa mthar thug cing*/ shes sgrib gzung rtog spong ba'i nus pa dang ldan pa'i phyir te/ gzung don rtog pa spong phyir dang*// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ lnga pa ni/ rang rgyal 'dod pa'i rten can du nges pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ kha cig de ltar du yin te/ rang rgyal srid pa tha ma pa'i dus su 'dod pa la 'dod chags dang ma bral ba gcig dgos pa'i phyir te/ gzugs med la 'dod chags dang ma bral ba gcig dgos pa ni gang zhig rang rgyal gcig char ba yin pa'i phyir/ zer ba mi 'thad de/ rang rgyal sgom lam pa dang bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi thob pa'i gzhi mthun med par thal/ de yin na 'dod pa la 'dod chags dang ma bral bas khyab pa'i phyir/ sgrub byed kyang mi 'thad de/ (112) rang rgyal cig char ba yin pa 'og nas 'gog pa'i phyir/ kha cig rang rgyal 'dod pa'i rten can du nges te/ rang rgyal gyi srid pa tha ma'i dus su/ rten 'brel lugs 'byung lugs ldog du bsgom pa'i sgo nas 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sems par byed la/ de'i dmigs rten/ dur khrod la sogs pa'i rus pa dgos pa'i phyir/ zer/ rang lugs ni/ smon lam gyi dbang gis rang rgyal 'dod pa'i rten can du nges te/ kun btus su/ de smon lam gyi stobs can yin te/ smon lam gyi dbang gis 'dod pa'i khams nyid du skye ste/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba med na rang rgyal bar 'gyur ro// drug pa la/ kha cig rang rgyal la 'bras bu bar ma gnyis med cing*/ thog mtha' gnyis yod de/ rang rgyal cig char yin pa'i phyir/

zer/ 'o na/ rang rgyal cig char yin pa'i don de dang cig char ba'i gzhi mthun yod pa la byed dam/ de yin na/ cig char ba yin pas khyab pa la byed/ dang po ltar na/ nyan thos la yang 'bras bu bar pa gnyis (113) bzhag tu med par thal/ de cig char ba yin pa'i phyir te/ de dang de'i gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ltar na/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi thob pa'i rang rgyal sgom lam pa chos can/ gzugs med la 'dod chags dang bral bar thal/ 'dod pa la 'dod chags dang bral ba'i cig char ba yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig 'bras bu bzhi ka bzhag rung ste/ mthong spangs nyon mongs spangs shing 'dod nyon drug pa ma spangs pa'i rang rgyal ni rgyun zhugs/ 'dod nyon drug pa tsam spangs pa'i rang rgyal ni phyir 'ong*/ 'dod nyon dgu pa tsam spangs pa'i rang rgyal ni phyir mi 'ong*/ rang rgyal dgra bcom dgra bcom 'bras gnas yin pa'i phyir/ zer/ 'o na/ rang rgyal gyi khams la mthong ba'i sa/ bslabs pa'i/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i/ byas pa rtogs pa'i sa yang 'thad par thal/ rang rgyal la 'bras gnas bzhi ka 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dman pa sa brgyad kyi skabs su/ sa dang po bdun las logs su rang rgyal (114) gyi sa smros pa mi 'thad par thal lo// rang lugs la/ 'bras gnas bzhi po rang rgyal la mi 'jog ste/ sher phyin gyi mdor/ de dag nyan thos kho na la sbyar nas/ rang rgyal la zung du smros pa'i phyir te/ gzhi shes kyi 'dres rkang rgyas bshad kyi skabs su rgyun du zhugs pa dang*/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang*/ phyir mi 'ong ba dang*/ dgra bcom pa dang*/ rang byang chub pa zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rang rgyal sgom lam pa chos can/ nyan thos sgom lam pa las lam bgrod tshul gyi sgo nas khyad du 'phags pa yin te/ srid pa tha ma pa'i dus su slob dpon gzhan gyis gdams ngag bstan pa la ma ltos par rang rgyal gyi byang chub mngon du byed nus kyi theg 'bring 'phags pa yin pa'i phyir/

rang rgyal dgra bcom pa chos can/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa las chos ston tshul gyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ rang gi gdul bya la sgra med lus kyi rig byed kyi sgo nas chos ston pas gdul bya'i rgyud la ji ltar 'dod pa'i rtogs (115) pa skye nus kyi theg 'bring dgra bcom yin pa'i phyir dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ gzung don rtog pa spong phyir dang*// zhes skabs su gnyis kyi dang po la/ shes bya rang rgyal gyi lam ngos gzung ba/ de ltar shes pa'i tshul/ yul can lam shes/ mdo bstan bcos las bshad tshul lo// dang po gnyis sngar las dpags te shes par bya shing*/ gsum pa la/ bstan tshul dngos dang*/ de ltar bstan pa'i khyad chos bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la kha cig gzung rtogs spong ba/ 'dzin rtog ma spong ba/ rten rigs kyi khyad chos gsum dang ldan pa'i rang rgyal rang rgyud pa'i lam tsam 'dir dngos su bstan te/ lus rnam bzhag tu bse ru'i lam gang dang*/ zhes dang*/ 'dir/ rten gyi bse ru lta bu'i lam// zhes dang*/ 'grel par/ rang sangs rgyas kyi lam la// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ btags pa'i chos nyid mi 'gal ba// zhes sogs kyi skabs nas dngos bstan gyi sbyor lam de rang rgyal gyi sbyor lam tsam (116) la byed rigs par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ de'i skabs kyi sbyor lam de stong nyid rtogs pa'i rnam pa can du bshad pa'i phyir te/ nang stong nyid la sogs pa yis// gzugs sogs mi 'dzin phyir bzod pa// zhes so// rten gyi bse ru lta bu'i lam// zhes pa'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i rten gyi gang zag de rang rgyal kho na la 'jog rigs pa thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ 'di'i dngos bstan gyi gang zag mdor byang sems la bshad cing*/ mdo dang de'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos bstan don mthun pa gcig dgos pa'i phyir/ rtags pa dang po der thal/ sdud par/

rgyal sras bden la mkhas dang phyir mi ldog pa dang*// dgra bcom dri ma bsal phyir som nyi spangs pa dang*// bzhi pa dge ba'i bshes kyis yongs su zin pa'o// ces so// rang lugs ni/ khyad chos gsum ldan gyi rang rgyal gyi lam bdag med du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i yul can lam shes dngos su bstan cing*/ rang (117) rgyal rang rgyud kyi lam ni shugs la bstan/ 'o na/ 'dir/ 'dzin pa mi spong phyir dang ni// zhes dang*/ mdo las shes rab kyi dbang po bar ma dang ldan pa zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal/ zhe na/ skyon med de/ de dag rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs kyi ldog pa tsam la dgongs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs la/ gzung rtog spong ba'i/ 'dzin rtog mi spong ba'i/ rten gyi khyad par dang gsum/ dang po la mdo drang ba dang*/ mdo'i don bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ mdo las/ lha yi bu dag gzugs ni zab pa ma yin/ phra ba ma yin no zhes pa nas/ rnam par shes pa zab pa ma yin/ phra ba ma yin no// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gzugs kyi rang bzhin zab pa ma yin phra ba ma yin/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ kha cig mdo 'dis/ rang rgyal gyi gzung ba rang bzhin med par rtogs pas shes sgrib gzung rtog rang lam du spong nus par bstan pa yin zer/ (118)

rang rgyal gyis yul bden med du rtogs par thal/ gzung ba rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i phyir/ rang rgyal gyis kun nas nyon mongs gzung rtog dang*/ rnam byang gzung rtog rang lam du spong nus par thal/ rang rgyal dgra bcom pas shes sgrib gzung rtog spangs pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ rang lugs ni/ rang rgyal gyis gzung ba phyi rol gyi don bden med du rtogs pas de la bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin sa bon dang bcas pa rang lam du spong nus pa ni gzung rtog spong ba'i khyad par ro// gal te rang rgyal gyi bden med rtogs par thal/ gzung ba phyi rol gyi don bden med du rtogs pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ khyab pa ma nges te/ gzung ba phyi rol gyi don tshad mas ma grub pa'i phyir te/ sngon po shes pa'i bdag nyid du bshad pa'i phyir te/ sngon po dang de'i blo dag lhan cig dmigs pa nges pa'i phyir/ 'di ni sems tsam kho na yin gyi/ phyi rol gyi don med de/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ mdo drang ba dang*/ (119) de'i don bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ de nas lha'i bu de dag 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ gnas brtan rab 'byor la chos nyan pa rnam pa ji lta bu dag nges par bya snyam pa dang*/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis/ lha'i bu de dag gi sems kyi rnam par rtog pa sems kyis yongs su shes nas lha'i bu de dag la 'di skad ces smras so// lha'i bu dag bdag la chos nyan pa ni/ sgyu ma lta bu dang*/ sprul pa lta bur btsal bar bya ste/ ces so// gnyis pa ni/ yul gzung ba phyi rol gyi don sgyu ma lta bur shes kyang*/ yul can gyi blo la bden 'dzin gyi sgro 'dogs rang lam du gcod mi nus pa ni/ 'dzin rtogs mi spong ba'i khyad par ro// gsum pa la/ lam sa gang zag gi rten dang*/ chos nyid rigs kyi rten gnyis/ dang po la/ mdo drang ba dang*/ de'i don bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang ces pa nas/

lha'i bu bye (120) ba phrag khrig brgya stong phrag du mas gnas brtan rab 'byor la 'di skad ces smras so// btsun pa rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ltar ces pa nas 'di len par byed pa su dag 'byung bar 'gyur/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis nyan thos chen po de dag dang lha'i bu de dag la 'di skad ces smras so// tshe dang ldan pa dag phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams/ bden pa mthong ba'i gang zag gam/ dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa bsam pa yongs su rdzogs pa'am/ sngon gyi rgyal ba la bya ba byas pa'i dbang du byas pas/ sangs rgyas mang po la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa dag gam/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su zin pa'i rigs kyi bu zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes dang*/ sdud par/ rgyal sras bden la mkhas dang*// zhes sogs so// gnyis pa ni/ mdo dang po la/ gang zag drug bshad pa'i dang po ni/ byang sems sbyor lam pa/ gnyis pa ni/ mthong lam skad cig bco lnga la gnas (121) pa'i byang sems/ bar pa gsum ni/ bcu drug pa lam rjes shes thob pa'i byang sems/ de la dgra bcom zhes bya ste/ mthong spangs ma lus par spangs pa'i phyir/ zag pa zad pa zhes bya ste/ khams gsum gyi nyon mongs pa zad par spangs pa'i phyir/ bsam pa yongs su rdzogs pa zhes bya ste/ mthong lam gyi rtogs rigs rdzogs par thob pa'i phyir/ phyi ma rnams kyis ni byang sems tshogs lam pa bstan pa yin no// 'o na/ 'dir sgom lam pa dngos su mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ gzung ba chos kyi bdag med ni gzhan don du mngon sum du shes par bya ba yin gyi/ rtogs zin rgyun ldan du bsgom par mi byed pas dngos su ma bstan te/ nyan thos kyi lam ni byang chub sems dpas yongs su shes par bya ba yin gyi/ bdag gis mngon du bya ba ni ma yin pas bsgom pa'i lam ni ma bstan to zhes pa 'dis/

rang rgyal gyi lam ni byang chub sems dpas yongs su shes par bya ba yin gyi/ mngon (122) du bya ba ni ma yin pas bsgom pa'i lam ni ma bstan to// zhes pa yang mtshon pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la mdo dang*/ de'i don bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ lha rnams kyis mngon par gtor ba'i me tog 'di dag ni bdag gis sngon chad lha'i gnas na yang yod par ma mthong ste/ me tog 'di dag ni sprul pa'o// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ sprul pa'i me tog la rang bzhin gyi skye ba med kyang*/ kun rdzob tu yul dus so sor skye ba snang ba bzhin du/ dri ma dang bcas pa'i sems 'di gsal ba'i chos dbyings kyang gnas skabs su sgrub pa'i rten byed pa'i dpe'i sgo nas mtshon pa'i rten rigs kyi khyad chos so// gnyis pa ni/ shes bya rang rgyal gyi lam chos can/ khyad chos gsum dang ldan te/ gzung rtog spong ba'i rtogs rigs/ 'dzin rtog mi spong ba'i rtogs rigs/ rten rigs kyi khyad par gsum dang ldan pa'i phyir/ theg chen gyi mthong (123) lam chos can/ rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes yin te/ gdul bya rang rgyal lam gyi rigs can rjes su bzung ba'i phyir du/ rang rgyal lam gyi dmigs rnams kyi tshul ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs nas/ rtogs rigs kyi yon tan yar ldan du bskyed pa la mkhas pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ theg chen gyi mthong lam dang*/ sgom lam gnyis/ dang po ni/ bden dang bden la bzod pa dang*// zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po mthong lam la/ lus kyi rten/ bsam pa'i rten/ brtan pa mthong lam gyi rang bzhin no// dang po la/ kha cig khams gong na mthong lam dngos su skye ba med de/ der snyoms 'jug gi bde ba la chags pas 'phags lam 'dren par byed pa'i yid skyo bas drag po dang mi ldan pa'i phyir/ mdzod las/ gsum du'o// gong na mthong lam med/ mi skyo zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/

zer/ lam (124) shes kyi rtogs pa dngos su skye rung du sgrub pa'i phyir du de bzhin gshegs pas sher phyin gyi mdo 'chad pa'i 'khor du lhags pa'i 'dod gzugs kyi lha rnams kyi 'od mog mog por mdzad pa dgos med du thal/ lam shes dngos su skye rung gi gzugs khams kyi lha med pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ 'dod na/ lha rnams rung bar bya ba'i phyir// zhes sogs rtsa 'grel dang 'gal/ kha cig gzugs kyi rten la theg chen gyi mthong lam dngos su skye ba yod kyang*/ theg dman gyi mthong lam dngos su skye ba med de/ mdo las de ltar bshad pa'i phyir/ zer/ rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis de bzhin gshegs pa la chos nyan pa la lhags pa'i gzugs khams kyi lha yin na/ theg chen gyi rigs can sha stag yin dgos par thal/ de lta bu ni theg dman gyi rigs can med pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ gzugs kyi rten la theg dman gyi tshogs sbyor dngos su skye ba yod par thal/ ma grub pa de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de'i rten (125) la theg dman gyi mthong lam dngos su skye ba yod par thal/ gzugs kyi rten can gyi nyan thos sbyor lam pa yod pa'i phyir/ gal te gzugs kyi rten can gyi rgyun zhugs yod par thal/ bcu drug pa lam rjes shes la gnas pa'i gzugs kyi rten can gyis nyan thos yod pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ khyab pa ma nges te/ gzugs kyi rten can gyi mthong lam skad cig bco lnga la gnas pa'i nyan thos ni/ chags bral sngon song gi phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa dang*/ rjes shes la gnas pa ni/ de'i 'bras gnas su 'jog pa'i phyir/ kha cig sngar med gsar du skye ba 'dod pa'i rten can yin kyang*/ thob zin gnas pa gzugs kyi rten la'ang yod zer ba mi 'thad de/ mthong lam skad cig ma bcu drug bar ma chad du rgyun chags su skye ba'i phyir/ rang lugs ni/ rang stobs kyis skye ba/ 'dod pa'i gling gsum du skyes te/ de rang bzhin gyi dbang po rno ba'i phyir/

gzhan stobs kyis gzugs kyi rten la (126) dngos su skye ba yod de/ rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis de bzhin gshegs pa la chos nyan pa la lhags pa'i gzugs kyi lha la lam shes kyi rtogs pa skye ba bshad pa'i phyir/ bsdu na/ theg pa rang lugs kyi sbyor lam chos mchog la gnas pa'i gang zag gi rgyud la dngos su skye ba yin zhing*/ theg pa chen po la gegs rang rgyal mngon gyur pa dang bral ba gcig dgos te/ lam shes dngos su skye ba'i lus rten la de ltar bshad pa gang zhig de dang theg chen gyi mthong lam thob pa dus mnyam pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ kha cig gzugs med kyi sems la brten nas mthong lam dngos su skye ba med de/ de khams 'og ma'i brten la dngos su skye dgos pa'i phyir/ zer/ sdug bsngal chos bzod la gnas pa'i byang sems yin na/ 'gog snyoms ma thob pas khyab par thal/ de dang 'gog snyoms thob pa'i gzhi mthun med pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ 'gog snyoms rang rgyud la skyes ma thag pa'i sdug bsngal chos bzod la gnas pa'i byang (127) sems yod par thal/ ma grub pa gang zhig tshogs sbyor na 'gog snyoms gsar du thob pa med pa'i phyir/ 'dod na srid rtse'i sems la brten nas theg chen gyi mthong lam gsar du skye ba yod par thal/ 'dod pa gang zhig 'gog snyoms sngar med gsar du skye ba srid rtse'i sems la brten dgos pa dang*/ 'phags rgyud kyi 'gog snyoms 'phags lam gyi ngo bor gnas pa'i phyir/ rang lugs ni/ theg dman gyi mthong lam bsam gtan sa drug gang rung la brten cing*/ theg pa chen po snying rje khyad par can gyis zin pa'i bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas gtso bor thob ste/ rgyud blar/ bsam gtan las byung bde ba'i mngal// snying rjes bskyed pa'i ma ma'o// zhes dang*/ rgyan las/ bsam gtan bzhi pa shin tu ngag thob nas// zhes dang*/ de yang byang chub tu sems bskyed pa kho na yin pas yul so sor nges pa yin no// dmigs bsal la/

srid rtse'i sems la (128) brten nas kyang yod de/ sbyor lam skad cig tha ma'i ngo bor gyur pa'i srid rtse'i dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug gis sdug bsngal chos bzod kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i 'gog snyoms kyi dngos kyi sems rten byed pa yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ theg chen gyi mthong lam bye brag tu bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ theg pa rang lugs kyi sbyor lam rdzogs rjes su byung zhing*/ gnas lugs kyi don mngon sum du rtogs pa'i bden pa mngon rtogs/ dbye na/ nyan thos/ rang rgyal/ theg chen gyi mthong lam dang gsum/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i nyan thos kyi bden pa mngon rtogs/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ gzung ba chos kyi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg 'bring gi bden pa mngon rtogs/ dbye na/ gnyis ka la shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug bcu drug yod/ gsum pa la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba/ skad cig tu skye dpyad pa/ lung las bshad (129) pa'i yon tan no// dang po la kha cig chos nyid mngon sum du gsar du mthong ba'i bden pa mngon rtogs dang*/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam rdzogs rjes su byung zhing*/ theg chen gyi sgom lam ma skyes gong gi theg chen skyes bu'i mngon rtogs dang*/ dar ṭīka pa na re/ sbyor lam chos mchog gi 'jug thogs de ma thag tu bden bzhi'i rnam pa bcu drug la dmigs nas stong nyid spros bral du mngon sum du gsar du rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa gang zhig sbyin sogs spyod pa'i rigs mtha' dag gis zin pa ni/ theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid/ rang rgyud ldan gyi stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs ni theg chen gyi mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid/ phyi ma'i mtshan gzhi/ bden bzhi mi rtag la sogs bcu drug mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam lta bu/

zer/ dang po (130) la theg chen gyi mthong lam rnam grol lam chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ theg chen gyi mthong lam bar chad med lam gyis stong nyid mngon sum du mthong zin pa ma yin par thal lo// gnyis pa la/ sa dang po'i rjes thob ye shes chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ sa dang po'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bden pa bden la bzod pa dang*// zhes sogs kyi skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i mthong lam du thal/ 'dod na mnyam bzhag tu thal/ 'dod pa gang zhig 'di'i skabs nas dngos bstan gyi mthong lam la shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug tu grangs nges pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal chos shes chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ kun rdzob bden pa la dngos su dmigs par thal/ bden bzhi'i rnam pa bcu drug la (131) dngos su dmigs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bden gnyis cig char du mngon sum du dmigs par thal/ kun rdzob bden pa la mngon sum du dmigs pa gang zhig don dam bden pa la mngon sum du dmigs pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum khas/ theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod kyis stong nyid mngon sum du mthong zin pa ma yin par thal/ chos shes kyis de mngon sum du gsar du mthong ba'i phyir/ mtshan nyid gnyis pa la bden bzhi mi rtag la sogs bcu drug mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na khyed rgyud ldan gyi gang zag gi rgyud la stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab yod par thal/ 'dod na/ slob lam na bden gnyis cig char du mngon sum du rtogs pa med pa dang 'gal/ rang lugs ni/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas tshe 'di phyi gnyis kyi phan yon chen po dang ldan pa'i theg chen gyi

(132) bden pa mngon rtogs/ dbye na/ yul gyi sgo nas chos bzod la sogs bcu drug ngo bo'i sgo nas bar chad med lam dang rnam grol lam gnyis/ mtshan nyid la/ kha cig mthong spangs shes sgrib dngos su spong ba'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs dang*/ rang rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyis mthong spangs shes sgrib las grol ma thag pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs zer/ dang po la theg chen mthong lam pa de mthong spangs shes sgrib dngos su spong ba'i gang zag ma yin par thal/ theg chen gyi mthong lam de dngos su spong ba'i lam ma yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na de chos can/ theg chen gyi mthong lam bar chad med lam du thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ theg chen gyi mthong lam rnam grol lam skad cig ma gnyis pa chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khyod kyi dngos rgyu dang theg chen gyi mthong lam bar chad med lam gyi gzhi mthun (133) yod par 'gyur ro// rang lugs ni/ mthong spangs shes sgrib kyi spong ba gnyen pos bsdus pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs dang*/ de'i rten gnyen pos bsdus pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs dang po la dbye na/ 'dod pa'i sas bsdus pa'i mthong spangs shes sgrib dang*/ khams gong gi sas bsdus kyi mthong spangs shes sgrib dngos su spong ba'i bar chad med lam gnyis/ gnyis pa la yang des rigs 'gre/ gsum pa la/ mkhas pa snga mas bshad pa'i rnam grangs 'god/ mi 'thad pa'i cha dgag rang lugs bzhag pa'o// dang po la/ skad cig ma gcig tu 'dod pa/ gnyis su 'dod pa/ bzhir 'dod pa/ bcu drug tu 'dod pa'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ kha cig mthong lam la ldog pa'i sgo nas bcu drug rdzas kyi sgo nas skad cig ma gcig tu nges te/ lam shes nyid kyi skad cig ma// zhes dang*/ rigs pa drug cu pa las/ chos shes pa'i

(134) 'og tu ni// 'di la bye brag dbyer yod na// shin tu phra ba'i dngos rnams la// gang gi skye bar rnams brtags pa// rnam pa mi mkhas de yis ni// rkyen las byung ba'i don ma mthong*// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ drang ti la sogs pa na re/ mthong lam thams cad chos bzod dang*/ chos shes kyi rdzas gnyis su 'dus te/ bzod pa phyi ma bdun chos bzod dang rdzas dbyer med/ shes pa phyi ma bdun chos shes dang rdzas dbyer med pa'i phyir/ dar ṭīka pa yang de dang mthun te/ bzod pa brgyad bar chad med lam gyis bsdus pa'i ngo bor rdzas gcig shes pa brgyad rnam grol lam gyis bsdus pa'i ngo bor rdzas gcig zer/ gsum pa ni/ kha cig rdzas bzhir 'dus te/ chos bzod bzhir ngo bo gcig pa nas rjes shes bzhi ngo bo gcig pa'i thugs rjer bzhi pa la thogs med kyis/ slob dpon gyi dbyig gnyen gyi lugs dang gsum/ dang po ni/ theg chen gyi mthong lam rdzas kyi sgo nas skad cig ma bcu drug tu bzhed la/ bcu drug po de bar ma (135) chad du 'byung bar bshad pa'i phyir te/ rgyal sras na las/ skad cig bcu drug bar ma chad du 'byung*// zhes so// bsdu na sdug bsngal mthong spangs/ kun 'byung*/ 'gog pa/ lam mthong spangs kyi gnyen por gyur pa'i mthong lam bzhir 'dus/ dang po la/ skad cig ma bzhi yod cing*/ de yang dang por khams gsum gyi sdug bsngal mthong spangs cig char du dngos su spong ba'i bar chad med lam gcig skye/ de la chos bzod du 'jog de'i rjes su de las grol ba'i rnam grol lam gcig skye/ de la chos shes su 'jog de'i rjes su de nyid stobs dang mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa 'phags pa'i chos rnams kyi rgyud nges par 'dren par byed pa'i ye shes skad cig ma gcig skye/ de la rjes bzod/ de'i rjes su rjes bzod de nyid 'phags pa'i chos rnams kyi rgyur nges par 'dren par byed pa'i ye shes skad cig ma gcig skye/

de la rjes shes su 'jog de nas chos bzod dang*/ chos shes la gzung ba rtogs pa'i mthong lam zhes bya (136) ste/ chos nyid kyi yul can gyi mthong lam yin pa'i phyir/ chos bzod ni sdug bsngal bden pa'i rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos nyid kyi yul can yin/ chos shes ni sdug bsngal mthong spangs las grol ba'i glo bur rnam dag gi yul can yin pa'i phyir/ rjes bzod dang rjes shes la 'dzin pa rtogs pa'i mthong lam zhes bya ste/ ye shes kyi yul can gyi mthong lam yin pa'i phyir te/ rjes bzod ni chos bzod dang chos shes kyi yul can/ rjes shes rjes bzod kyi yul can yin pa'i phyir/ thams cad kyang spros pa'i mtshan ma med pa'i mnyam bzhag yin te/ dang po gnyis chos nyid la mnyam par bzhag pa dang*/ phyi ma gnyis yul can ye shes dang*/ yul stong nyid zung du 'jug pa'i dbyings la mnyam par bzhag pa'i phyir/ des bden pa lhag ma rnams la shes par bya'o// kun btus las/ sdug bsngal la chos shes pa'i bzod pa gang zhe na/ gang gis sdug bsngal mthong bas spong bar bya ba'i nyon mongs pa spong (137) ba dang*/ sdug bsngal la chos shes pa'i bzod pa zhes bya'o// sdug bsngal la chos shes pa gang zhe na/ shes pa gang gis bzod pa'i 'jug thogs su rnam par grol ba mngon du byed pa'o// sdug bsngal la rjes su rtog par shes pa'i bzod pa gang zhe na/ sdug bsngal la chos shes pa'i 'jug thogs su sdug bsngal la chos shes pa'i bzod pa dang*/ sdug bsngal la chos shes pa 'di gnyis 'phags pa'i chos rnams kyi rgyu'o zhes so so rang la mngon sum du gyur pa'i zag pa med pa'i shes rab bo// sdug bsngal rjes su rtogs pa'i shes pa gang zhe na/ shes pa gang gi rjes su rtog par shes pa'i bzod pa de nges par 'dzin pa'o// de bzhin du bden pa lhag ma rnams la yang bzod pa dang*/ shes pa rnams ci rigs su shes par bya'o// de la chos shes pa'i bzod pa dang*/

shes pa rnams kyis ni gzung ba rtogs so// rjes su rtogs pa'i bzod pa dang*/ shes pa rnams kyis ni 'dzin pa rtogs so// bzod pa dang shes pa thams cad (138) la yang mtshan ma med par gnas pa'i rnal 'byor can du rigs par bya'o// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ chos nyid mthong tshul gyi sgo nas skad cig ma gcig yin te/ theg chen gyi mthong lam gyi sdug bsngal bden pa'i rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos nyid mngon sum du mthong ba'i tshe/ bden pa lhag ma rnams kyi chos nyid kyang mngon sum du mthong ba nus pa'i phyir/ 'bras bu'i mngon par rtogs pa la ltos nas kyang skad cig ma gcig yin te/ theg chen gyi mthong lam gyi dus skad cig ma gcig la sdug bsngal shes bya/ kun 'byung spang bya/ 'gog pa mngon du bya rgyu/ lam rgyud la brten byar rtogs nus pa'i phyir/ so so'i mngon par rtogs pa dang nges pa 'dren tshul gyi dbang du byas nas skad cig ma bcu drug yin te/ theg chen gyi mthong lam des bden bzhi la log phyogs su 'dzin pa'i sgro 'dogs bcu drug gcod byed kyis rjes thob kyis bsdus pa'i nges pa bcu drug 'dren pa'i nus pa bcu drug mnyam bzhag gi gnas skabs su rim bzhin du 'byung ba'i (139) phyir te/ 'grel chen las/ bden pa re re la yang phyin ci log rnam par bsal bas so sor rtogs pa'i mngon par rtogs pa las skad cig ma bcu drug kho nas mngon par shes pa yin no// zhes so// bcu drug 'jog tshul yang thogs med dang mthun par bzhed/ 'grel chen las/ de la chos shes pa'i bzod pa dang*/ chos shes pas ni gzung ba rtogs la/ rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa dang*/ rjes su shes pas ni 'dzin pa rtogs pa yin no// zhes/ thogs med kyis bzhed pa ji lta ba bzhin gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ theg chen gyi mthong lam de rdzas kyi sgo nas skad cig ma bcu drug du bzhed cing*/

de yang dang por 'dod pa'i sas bsdus kyi sdug bsngal mthong spangs dngos su spong ba'i bar chad med lam skad cig ma gcig skye/ de la sdug bsngal chos bzod du 'jog de'i rjes su de las grol ba'i rnam grol lam gcig skye/ de la chos shes su 'jog de'i rjes su khams gong gi sdug bsngal (140) mthong spangs dngos su spong ba'i bar chad med lam gcig skye/ de la rjes bzod du 'jog de'i rjes su de las grol ba'i rnam grol lam gcig skye/ de la rjes shes su 'jog des lhag ma rnams la rigs bsgre zhing bzod pa brgyad bar chad med lam dang*/ shes pa brgyad rnam grol lam gyis bsdus pa'i rdzas so so ba yin te/ mdzod las/ 'jig rten pa yi chos mchog las// chos kyi bzod pa zag pa med// 'dod sdug bsngal la de nas ni// de nyid la chos shes de bzhin// sdug bsngal lhag la rjes bzod shes// bden pa gsum la'ang de bzhin no// de ltar bden pa mngon rtogs 'di// sems bcu drug go rnam gsum ste// mthong dmigs bya ba zhes bya'o// de ni chos mchog dang sa gcig /bzod dang shes pa go rim bzhin// bar chad med dang rnam grol lam// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ lugs dang po mtha' gcig tu mthong lam rdzas kyi sgo nas skad cig ma gcig tu 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ mthong spangs spong ba'i phyir du mthong lam gsungs pa don (141) med du thal/ mthong spangs shes sgrib kyi sa bon dngos su spong ba'i theg chen gyi mthong lam bar chad med lam gzhi ma grub pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de las grol ba'i rnam grol lam yod par thal/ 'dod na nang 'gal/ theg chen mthong lam pa yin na/ shin tu dbang rnon yin dgos par thal/ de yin na dus skad cig ma gcig la mthong lam gyi byed pa rdzogs nus yin dgos pa'i phyir/ lugs gnyis pa la/ 'dod pa'i sas bsdus kyi mthong spangs dang*/ khams gong gi sas bsdus kyi mthong spangs la spong dka' sla'i khyad par cung zad kyang med par thal/

'dod pa'i sas bsdus kyi mthong spangs spong bzhin pa'i bar chad med lam yin na/ khams gong gi mthong spangs mtha' dag cig char du spong ba'i bar chad med lam yin dgos pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam shes pa brgyad po de yang ngo bo (142) gcig la ldog pa'i sgo nas phye ba yin par thal/ theg chen gyi mthong lam dbang rtul la yang de ltar yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas dang*/ de'i zhugs pa'i gzhi mthun yod par thal/ lam rjes shes la gnas bzhin pa'i rgyun zhugs dang*/ sdug bsngal chos shes la gnas bzhin pa'i gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir/ lugs gsum pa la/ skad cig dang po bco lnga la gnas bzhin pa'i byang sems la rgyun zhugs zhugs pa dang*/ bcu drug pa la gnas pa'i byang sems la rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas kyi ming gi btags pa mi 'thad par thal/ lam rjes shes la gnas pa'i byang sems yin na/ sdug bsngal rjes shes la gnas pa'i byang sems yin dgos pa'i phyir/ kun 'byung la rjes shes kyi gnas skabs su byams sogs tshad med bzhi ma bsgoms na/ 'gog pa la chos bzod kyi gnas skabs su sems can gyi khams la ltos pa med pa'i dman pa'i myang 'das su ltung bar (143) bshad pa mi 'thad par thal/ 'gog pa la chos bzod yin na/ kun 'byung rjes shes kyi snga logs su byung bas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ 'dod mi nus te/ nyi khri snang ba las/ kun 'byung la rjes su shes pa ni/ yang sems can thams cad la mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ byams pa dang*/ snying rje dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ btang snyoms pa shin tu bsgoms pa'i phyir/ de rnams la mi dang mi ma yin pa la sogs pas glags rnyed par mi 'gyur te/ mthong ba'i lam gyi skad cig ma brgyad pa la byang chub sems dpa'i dgongs pa mtha' yas pa mdzad pa yin gyi/ gzhan du na skad cig ma dgu pa la sems can gyi khams la ltos pa med pa'i 'gog par ltung bar 'gyur ro// zhes so// gsum pa rang lugs la/

tha snyad rnam 'jog par/ don gnas tshad kyi dbang du byas pa/ skad cig ma'i yun tshad ngos gzung ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ skad cig ma bcu drug tu 'dod pa'i (144) phyogs khas len te/ gnas skabs blo yul du 'char bde ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ dbang po'i rim pas skad cig ma'i grangs 'jog pa yin gyi/ mtha' gcig tu nges pa ma yin no// de yang skye ba'i tshul bzhir 'gyur te/ shin tu dbang rnon/ cung zad rno ba/ dbang 'bring*/ dbang rtul gyi rgyud la skye tshul lo// dang po ni/ skad cig ma gcig tu skye ste/ byang sems shin tu dbang rnon gyis chos nyid mngon sum du gsar du mthong ba'i dus kyi skad cig ma de la/ sdug bsngal shes/ kun 'byung spong*/ 'gog pa mngon du byed/ lam bsgoms pa'i mthong lam gyi byed pa rnams rdzogs par nus pa'i phyir/ ldog pa'i sgo nas bcu drug tu 'gyur te/ 'dod pa'i sas bsdus kyi bden bzhi'i gnas lugs mngon sum du shes pa'i cha nas chos shes bzhi/ de la mi skrag pa'i cha nas chos bzod bzhi/ khams gong gi bden bzhi'i gnas lugs mngon sum du rtogs pa'i cha nas rjes shes bzhi/ (145) de la mi skrag pa'i cha nas rjes bzod bzhir 'jog pa'i phyir/ klu sgrub kyis skad cig ma gcig tu bshad pa yang 'di la dgongs so// gnyis pa ni/ byang sems cung zad dbang rnon gyi rgyud la rdzas kyi sgo nas mthong lam skad cig ma gnyis su skye ste/ dang po khams gsum gyi mthong spangs mtha' dag dngos su spong ba'i bar chad med lam gcig skye/ de la ldog pa'i sgo nas bzod pa brgyad du 'jog de'i rjes su de las grol ba'i rnam grol lam gcig skye/ de la ldog pa'i sgo nas shes pa brgyad du 'jog pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ byang sems dbang 'bring gi rgyud la mthong lam rdzas kyi sgo nas skad cig ma bzhi skye ste/ dang po 'dod pa'i sas bsdus kyi mthong spangs mtha' dag dngos su spong ba'i bar chad med lam gcig skye/

de la ldog pa'i sgo nas chos bzod bzhir 'jog de'i rjes su de las grol ba'i rnam grol lam gcig skye/ de la ldog pa'i sgo nas chos shes bzhi/ de'i rjes su khams (146) gong gi mthong spangs mtha' dngos su spong ba'i bar chad med lam gcig skye/ de la ldog pa'i sgo nas rjes bzod bzhi/ de'i rjes su de las grol ba'i rnam grol lam gcig skye/ de la ldog pa'i sgo nas rjes shes bzhir 'jog bzhi pa ni/ byang sems dbang rtul gyi rgyud la rdzas kyi sgo nas skad cig ma bcu drug tu skye la/ de la yang*/ thogs med kyis bshad pa ltar gyi skye tshul dang*/ dbyig gnyen gyis bshad pa ltar gyis skye tshul gnyis/ chos bshes kyis/ de ltar na mthong ba'i lam la dus ji snyed cig thogs zhe na/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i shes rab dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ dang po'i rjes su 'brang bas na dus gcig tu chad pa ci yang med do// de bzhin du spyi'i dus bskal pa grangs med pa gsum zhes bya ba'i dus kyang nges pa can du nam yang mi 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gsum pa la/ spyir skad cig ma la/ dus mtha'i dang*/ bya rdzogs kyi skad cig ma gnyis/ (147) dang po/ se gol gcig tog pa'i yun tshad la drug cu rtsa lngar phye ba'i cha shas gcig lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ bya ba gang dang gang brtsams nas ma grub kyi bar gyi yun tshad lta bu/ 'di'i skad cig ni/ phyi ma'i dbang du byas te/ kun btus su/ sems kyi skad cig bcu drug pa 'di dag ni mthong ba'i lam mo// sems kyi skad cig ni shes bya la shes pa 'byung ba yongs su rdzogs par rig par bya'o// zhes so// bzhi pa la spang bya las grol ba'i/ thob bya thob pa'i yon tan gnyis/ dang po ni/ chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba rnam par dag pa skyes so// zhes gsungs pas so// rdul med pa ni chos bzod la ldan pa'i yon tan te/

des mthong spangs kyi dri ma 'joms par byed pa'i phyir/ dri ma dang bral ba ni/ chos shes la ldan pa'i yon tan te/ de rang gi ngo skal gyi mthong spangs las grol ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ mdo las/ chos mthong ba (148) chos thob pa/ chos rig pa/ chos rtogs pa/ som nyi las brgal ba/ the tshom las brgal ba/ gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa/ ston pa'i bstan pa las gzhan gyi mi bkri ba/ chos rnams la mi 'jigs pa thob pa/ zhes gsung ngo*// de yang dang po bzhi ni/ chos bzod/ chos shes/ rjes bzod/ rjes shes bzhi la rim bzhin du ldan pa'i yon tan no// phyi ma rnams ni mthong lam spyi'i yon tan no// de yang mthong lam la som nyi las brgal ba zhes bya ste/ rang gis thob pa'i yon tan la som nyi spangs pa'i phyir/ them tshom las brgal ba zhes bya ste/ gzhan gyis thob pa'i yon tan la the tshom zad pa'i phyir/ gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa zhes bya ste/ lam bsgom pa'i tshul gzhan la rag ma las par shes pa'i phyir/ ston pa'i bstan pa la gzhan gyis mi bkri ba zhes bya ste/ bdud dang mu stegs la sogs pa la bsgom pa la bar (149) chad mi nus pa'i phyir/ chos rnams la mi 'jigs pa thob pa zhes bya ste/ gzhan gyis dris pa'i lan lung du ston pa la sems zhum pa med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ theg chen gyi mthong lam shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug chos can/ lam shes 'chad pa'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i mthong lam yin te/ tshe 'di phyi gnyis kyi phan yon chen po dang ldan pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ bsgom lam gyi byed pa dang*/ byed pa can gyi bsgom lam gnyis/ dang po ni/ kun nas zhi dang thams cad la// zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ theg chen bsgom lam gyi byed pa la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ kha cig theg chen gyi bsgom lam bsgom stobs kyis ma thob pa'i dge legs dang*/
theg chen gyi sgom lam bsgom stobs kyis thob pa'i dge legs zer/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam na/ theg chen gyi sgom lam gyi byed pa yod par thal/

(150) de na mtshan nyid phyi ma de yod pa'i phyir te/ slob lam na rang rgyu rnam mkhyen sgom stobs kyis thob pa'i dge legs yod pa'i phyir te/ rnam mkhyen gyis bdag rkyen byas pa las byung ba'i mdzad pa'i phrin las yod pa'i phyir/ lugs dang po yang des khegs/ rang lugs ni/ rang rgyu theg chen gyi sgom lam ngo bo ji lta ba bzhin du bsgom stobs kyis thob pa'i dge legs/ dbye na gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi byed pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bsgom lam skad cig gnyis pa nas rgyun mtha'i bar gyi spangs rtogs kyi yon tan rnams lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas sa'i spangs rtogs kyi yon tan rnams lta bu'o// 'bras bu'i sgo nas dbye na/ kun nas zhi ba'i/ thams cad la 'dud pa'i/ nyon mongs pa las rgyal ba'i/ gnod pas rdzi ba med pa'i/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa'i rten gyi yul mchod pa'i gnas su gyur pa'i theg chen gyi sgom lam gyi/ dbye ba dang drug bsdu na skyes bu byed pa'i/ rnam smin gyi bdag po'i 'bras (151) bu dang gsum/ dang po la/ nang gi nyer 'tshe zhi ba dang*/ phyi'i nyer 'tshe zhi ba gnyis/ dang po la/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu'i dbang du byas nas byed pa dang po gnyis/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu'i dbang du byas nas byed pa gsum pa/ spyi'i nyer 'tshe zhi ba'i dbang du byas nas byed pa bzhi pa/ gnyis pa'i dbang du byas nas lnga pa/ gsum pa'i dbang du byas nas drug pa bzhag pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/ 'dir bstan kun nas zhi ba la sogs pa'i byed pa drug chos can/ theg chen sgom lam gyi byed pa yin te/ rang gi rgyur gyur pa'i theg chen gyi sgom lam ngo bo ji lta ba bzhin du sgom stobs kyis thob pa'i rnam dkar gyi yon tan yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ so sor bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ byed pa'i 'og tu bsgom pa'i lam// zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/

sgom lam la/ lus kyi rten/ bsam pa'i rten/ rten pa sgom lam (152) gyi rang bzhin no// dang po la/ rang rgyal ni/ 'dod pa'i rten can du nges la/ nyan thos kyi sgom lam sngar med gsar du skye ba 'dod gzugs kyi rten dang*/ thob zin gnas pa gzugs med kyi rten la yang yod/ theg chen gyi sgom lam 'dod gzugs gang rung gi rten can du nges kyi gzugs med kyi rten can med de/ gzugs med khams pa ni/ theg chen 'phags pa'i 'phrin las dngos su 'jug pa'i rten du mi rung ba'i phyir te/ sdud pa las/ byang chub yon tan pha rol phyin nyams 'gyur 'ong zhes// gzugs med khams su skye ba don du gnyer mi byed// ces so// gnyis pa la/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ dogs gcod gnyis las/ dang po ni/ theg dman gyi sgom lam sngar med gsar du skye ba bsam gtan sa drug gang rung la dngos su brten cing*/ thob zin mngon du byed pa gzugs med kyi sems la brten pa yod de/ nyan thos bsgom lam pas srid rtse'i dngos gzhi la brten nas 'gog snyoms mngon du byed pa (153) yod pa'i phyir/ theg chen gyi bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi'i sems la brten pa gtso che ste/ de zhi lhag chad mnyam pas de la brten nas lam sgrub sla ba'i phyir/ gzugs med kyi sems la dngos su ma brten pa ma yin te/ sa dang po'i mnyam bzhag khyad par lam gyi skad cig tha ma'i ngo bor gyur pa'i gzugs med kyi dngos gzhis sa gnyis pa'i dngos rgyu byed pa yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'grel chen las/ gang yang*/ 'dod pa'i khams la srid rtse yi// byang chub lam gyi yan lag spangs// zhes bya ba de/ la la ni thabs la mi mkhas pa yin pa'i phyir/ nyan thos kyi dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ de dang 'di la 'gal ba med do zhes 'chad do// zhes gsungs pa'i don la/ kha cig theg dman gyi sgom lam 'dod pa dang srid rtse'i sems la ma brten te/

thabs la mi mkhas pa'i phyir/ theg chen gyi sgom lam de gnyis la brten te/ thabs la mkhas pa'i (154) phyir/ zhes zer/ mi 'thad de/ sa dang po'i ye shes dang 'dod sems kyi gzhi mthun yod par thal/ theg chen sgom lam gyi dngos kyi sems rten dang*/ 'dod sems kyi gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir/ lung gi don ni/ byang sems 'phags pas 'dod pa'i sems can la dmigs pa'i brtse ba snying rje dang ldan pa'i rjes thob kyi mkhyen pa la dngos su brten nas bsgom la mngon du byed pa yod de/ de thabs la mkhas pa yin pa'i phyir/ theg dman gyis de ltar mi nus te/ de thabs la mi mkhas pa'i phyir/ des na theg chen gyi sgom lam skad cig ma dang po mnyam bzhag tu nges kyang de'i dngos rgyu las dang po'i mnyam bzhag khyad par gyi lam yang yod/ rjes thob khyad par gyi lam yang yod par shes par bya'o// gsum pa la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ bdag med mngon sum du rtogs zin bsgom par byed pa'i rjes la mngon rtogs/ dbye na/ nyan thos/ rang rgyal/ theg chen gyi sgom lam dang gsum/ (155) dang po'i mtshan nyid/ gang zag bdag med mngon sum du rtogs zin bsgom par byed pa'i nyan thos kyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ dbye na/ nyan thos kyi sgom lam chung ngu la sogs pa dgu/ bsdu na/ rjes thob kyis bsdus pa'i zag bcas sgom lam dang*/ mnyam bzhag gis bsdus pa'i zag med sgom lam gnyis su 'dus so// gnyis pa la yang des mtshon no// gsum pa la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ so so'i rang bzhin/ grangs nges pa'o// dang po la/ kha cig theg chen gyi mthong lam rdzogs rjes su byung zhing*/ rnam mkhyen ma skyes gang gi theg chen skyes bu'i mngon rtogs zer na/ sa dang po'i rjes thob ye shes chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ theg chen gyi zag bcas bsgom lam du thal/ 'dod pa gang zhig rjes thob ye shes yin pa'i phyir/

'dod na/ rang rgyu zag med bsgom lam sngon song*/ yang de chos can/ (156) khyod rgyud ldan gyi gang zag de theg chen bsgom lam par thal/ khyod theg chen gyi bsgom lam yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mthong lam pa phyir mi ldog tu sgrub par byed pa'i rjes thob lus ngag gi spyod pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'i byang sems mthong lam pa med par thal/ rjes thob la gnas bzhin pa'i byang sems mthong lam pa med pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ byang sems mthong lam pa rang las rtogs pa dma' ba'i gang zag gi ngor gtso bor phyir mi ldog tu sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs gzhi ma grub par 'gyur ro// byang sems mthong lam pa yin na/ sa dang po'i yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis dang ldan pas ma khyab par thal/ de yin na sems can gtso bor smin par byed pa'i yon tan dang ldan pas ma khyab pa'i phyir te/ de dang rjes thob la gnas bzhin pa'i gzhi mthun med pa'i phyir/ gal te rjes thob de bsgom lam yin te/ ṭī ka las kyang de bsgom lam du bshad pa dang*/ kun btus su/ mthong ba'i lam la ni bden pa rnam par 'jog pa mngon par (157) rtogs pa'i mtha' las byung ba kun rdzob shes pa rnams 'thob ste/ mngon du byed pa ni ma yin no// de dag ni bsgom pa'i lam la mngon du byed do// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang de chos can/ sgom lam du thal/ lam lnga po gang rung gang zhig lam gzhan bzhi po gang rung ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ theg chen gyi lam la lngar grangs ma nges par thal lo// zhe na skyon med de/ ṭī ka dang kun btus kyi don ni/ mthong zin sgom par byed pa'i lam la sgom lam gyi ming gis btags pa tsam yin pa'i phyir/ lam la lngar grangs ma nges pa'i skyon med de/ sa dang po'i rjes thob ye shes de mthong lam gyi rtogs rigs kyis bsdus pa'i phyir/ gzhan du na/ thar pa don gnyer gyi shes bya'i gtso bo la bden pa bzhir grangs ma nges par thal/

bden bzhi gang rung ma yin pa'i thar pa don gnyer gyi shes bya'i gtso bo yod pa'i phyir/ khyab gsal sgrib/ kha cig (158) sa dang po'i ye shes rdzogs rjes su byung zhing*/ rnam mkhyen ma thob pa'i theg chen skyes bu'i mngon rtogs zer na/ sa dang po rdzogs rjes su byung ba'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pas ma nges/ kha cig stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs zin rgyun ldan du bsgom par byed pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs zin na/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes chos can mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs zin rgyun ldan du sgom par thal lo// rang lugs ni/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs zin sgom par byed pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ gnyis pa/ dbye ba la/ ngo bo'i sgo nas zag bcas dang*/ zag med gnyis rnam pa'i sgo nas chung ngu'i chung ngu la sogs pa dgu/ gsum pa la/ theg chen gyi zag bcas bsgom lam dang*/ zag med bsgom lam gnyis kyi khyad par la/ dgag bzhag gnyis/ dang po la/ lo chen na re/ 'dir bstan gyi zag pa ni sgra don 'dris 'dzin gyi rtogs pa yin cing*/ de dang bcas pa'i (159) don de'i ngo bo yin pa la byed/ dar ṭīka pa yang de dang mthun/ theg chen gyi bsgom lam rjes thob rnams ni sgra don 'dris 'dzin gyi rtog pa dang bcas pas zag bcas bsgom lam yin la/ mnyam bzhag ni de dang bral bas zag med bsgom lam du bzhed/ mi 'thad de/ sa brgyad par sgra don 'dris 'dzin gyi rtog pa gnas gyur pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes la dbang bsgyur thob pa mi 'thad par thal/ sa brgyad pa'i rjes thob de sgra don 'dris 'dzin gyi rtog bcas yin pa'i phyir/ kun rdzob bden pa gtso bor mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen slob pa'i mkhyen pa gzhi ma grub par thal/ theg chen slob pa'i rjes thob ye shes ni sgra don 'dris 'dzin gyi rtog pa yin pa'i phyir/

'dod na/ theg chen 'phags pa'i rjes thob kyi gnas skabs na nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes dang*/ gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes gzhi ma grub par thal lo// 'dre ar na re/ 'dir bstan gyi zag pa ni nyon (160) mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa yin la/ de dang bcas pa'i don ni/ de'i sa bon la de'i rigs 'dra phyi ma 'byung ba'i rkyen kun rdzob gnyis snang dang bcas pa'o// des na gnyis snang dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs dang*/ de nub pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ rim bzhin du mtshan nyid du bzhed/ sa gnyis pa'i bar chad med lam chos can/ zag bcas sgom lam du thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir te/ rang las ngo bo tha dad du gyur pa'i gzugs sogs dngos yul du byed pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yang des khegs/ gser phreng pa na re/ theg chen gyi sgom lam rjes thob rnams ni/ zag bcas sgom lam yin te/ bden snang dang bcas pa'i bsgom lam yin pa'i phyir/ mnyam bzhag rnams ni zag med bsgom lam yin te/ de dang bral ba'i bsgom lam yin pa'i phyir/ de yang ma dag pa'i rjes thob kyi gnas skabs su/ bden snang dang bden zhen gnyis ka (161) yod cing*/ dag pa'i rjes thob na bden snang tsam yod kyi/ bden zhen med zer/ bla ma mkhyen rab dbang phyug kyang 'di kho na ltar bzhed/ bden med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab dang*/ bden 'dzin gnyis gang zag gi gcig gi rgyud la lhan cig tu 'jug pa yod par thal/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud la bden zhen yod pa'i phyir/ sa brgyad par bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mi rtog ye shes la dbang bsgyur thob pa ma yin par thal/ sa brgyad pa'i rjes thob ye shes bden snang dang bcas pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig 'dir bstan gyi zag pa ni mngon zhen med par gzung 'dzin tha dad du snang ba'i shes sgrib rtog pa yin/

de dang bcas pa'i don yang*/ theg chen gyi bsgom lam/ rjes thob rnams de dang lhan cig tu 'jug pa la byed zer/ 'o na 'dir bstan gyi shes sgrib rtogs pa de dbang shes la byed dam/ yid shes la byed/ dang po ltar na sa brgyad pa'i rjes thob la gnas pa'i byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi mig gi rnam par shes pa (162) de gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi shes sgrib rtog par thal/ de'i rgyud la dbang shes su gyur pa'i gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi shes sgrib rtog pa yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ de ma yin par thal/ zag bcas kyi dbang po zag med du gyur pa'i ma 'khrul pa'i shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ dag pa'i byang sems kyi dbang shes yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rgyan las/ dbang po lnga rnams gzhan gyur na// don kun 'jug dang thams cad la// yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis kyi// 'byor pa dam pa thob par 'gyur// zhes so// gnyis pa ltar na/ sa brgyad par mi rtog ye shes la dbang bsgyur thob pa ma yin par thal/ de'i rjes thob kyi gnas skabs su bsgom spang shes sgrib rtog pa rgyun chags su ldan pa'i phyir dang*/ sa brgyad pa yan chad du lam gyi dngos po rgyun mi chad du ldan pa ma yin par thal/ sa brgyad pa'i rjes thob tu rang rgyud kyi yid kyi rnam par shes pa shes sgrib rtog pa'i ngo bor skyes pa yin pa'i phyir te/ der yid kyi rnam par shes par gyur pa'i/ shes sgrib rtog pa rgyun (163) chags su yod pa gang zhig gang zag gcig gi rgyud la yid kyi rnam par shes pa rdzas gzhan pa gnyis cig char du mi 'byung ba grub mtha' la khas len pa'i phyir/ rang lugs/ 'dir bstan gyi zag pa ngos gzung ba/ de dang bcas ma bcas kyi don/ mtshan nyid bsdus ste bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ 'dir bstan gyi zag pa gzung 'dzin tha dad du snang ba'i shes sgrib rtog pa yin te/ chos bshes kyi/ rnam rtog dang bcas pas zag bcas dang*/

rtog pa dang bral bas zag med zhes dang*/ ṭī ka las/ rjes thob ni zag bcas zhes brjod de/ gzung 'dzin tha dad pa can gyi shes sgrib kyi rnam rtog dang bcas pa'i phyir/ mnyam bzhag ni zag med ces brjod de/ gzung 'dzin tha dad pa can gyi shes sgrib kyi rnam rtog med pa'i phyir/ zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ zag bcas bsgom lam dang*/ shes sgrib rtog pa nges par lhan cig tu 'jug pa'i cha nas de dang bcas pa 'jog pa (164) ma yin te/ dag pa'i rjes thob kyi gnas skabs su shes sgrib rtog pa rgyun chags su 'byung ba'i nges pa med pa'i phyir/ des na shes sgrib rtog pa'i sa bon la shes sgrib rtog pa'i rigs 'dra phyi ma 'byung ba'i rkyen kun rdzob kyi spros pa sna tshogs 'dzin stangs kyi yul du byed pa ni zag pa dang bcas pa'i don yin la/ de las log pa ni zag pa dang bcas pa ma yin pa'i don to// gsum pa ni/ kun rdzob bden pa yul gyi gtso bor byed pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi/ theg chen gyi bsgom lam rjes thob mtha' dag go /don dam bden pa yul gyi gtso bor byed pa'i/ theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi/ theg chen gyi sgom lam mnyam bzhag mtha' dag go /bzhi pa la kha cig theg chen gyi bsgom lam la chung ngu'i chung ngu la sogs pa dgur grangs ma nges te/ sa dang po'i rjes thob ye shes theg chen gyi sgom lam yin kyang*/ dgu po

(165) gang rung ma yin pa'i phyir/ zer/ grangs med la sogs bstan pa rnams// zhes pa'i gzhung de theg chen gyi bsgom lam gyi grangs nges la rtsod pa spong byed ma yin par thal/ de ni rgyun chags yin pa'i phyir// zhes sogs kyis de'i grangs nges ma bstan pa'i phyir/ rtags khas rang lugs ni/ theg chen gyi bsgom lam chung ngu'i chung ngu la sogs pa dgur grangs nges te/ theg chen gyi bsgom lam de sa gnyis pa nas bcu pa'i bar rgyun chags su 'byung ba'i phyir/ khyab ste/ sa gnyis pa dang*/ de'i chung ngu'i chung ngu don gcig pa nas/ sa bcu pa dang de'i chen po'i chen po don gcig pa'i phyir/ de ni rgyun chags yin pa'i phyir// zhes sogs kyi don no// gnyis pa ni/ sa gnyis pa'i rjes thob ye shes chos can/ theg chen gyi zag bcas bsgom lam yin te/ kun rdzob bden pa 'dzin stangs kyi yul gyi gtso bor byed pa'i rjes thob kyis bsdus pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs (166) yin pa'i phyir/ sa gnyis pa'i bar chad med lam chos can/ theg chen gyi zag med bsgom lam yin te/ don dam bden pa 'dzin stangs kyi yul gyi gtso bor byed pa'i mnyam bzhag gis bsdus pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ zag bcas dang*/ zag med bsgom lam gnyis/ dang po la/ mos pa dang*/ bsngo ba dang*/ rjes su yi rang bsgom pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ mos pa rang gi don dang ni// zhes pa'i skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ theg chen gyi mos pa bsgom lam la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams/ phan yon dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ yum sher phyin don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su mos pa byed pa'i rjes thob kyis bsdus pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ 'dir kha cig rnam mkhyen mos yul du byed pa'i mos pa sgom lam rnal 'byor mngon sum ma yin te/ gal te de yin na/ de chos can/ rnam mkhyen mngon sum du rtogs par

(167) thal/ rnam mkhyen rtogs pa gang zhig rnal 'byor mngon sum yin pa dang*/ de don spyi'i tshul du mi rtogs pa'i phyir/ zer/ gzhan don du/ rnam mkhyen thob par 'dod pa'i theg chen mthong lam pa'i don dam sems bskyed chos can/ rnam mkhyen mngon sum du rtogs par thal/ de rtogs pa gang zhig de don spyi'i tshul du ma rtogs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ rang don/ gnyis don/ gzhan don mos pa bsgom lam dang gsum/ mtshan nyid la kha cig mos pa bsgom lam gang zhig yum sher phyin rang don phun tshogs kyi 'byung gnas su mos par byed pa'i 'dun pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa dang*/ de gang zhig gnyis don phun tshogs kyi dang*/ de gang zhig gzhan don phun tshogs kyi 'byung gnas su mos par byed pa'i 'dun pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ rim bzhin mtshan nyid yin zer/ yum sher phyin don gsum ka'i 'byung gnas su mos par byed pa'i sa gnyis (168) pa'i mos pa bsgom lam chos can/ gzhan don mos pa bsgom lam du thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dag pa sas bsdus kyi mos pa bsgom lam du thal lo// gnyis pa yang des khegs/ kha cig mos pa bsgom lam gang zhig sbyor bas rang don gtso bor sgrub pa dang*/ de gang zhig sbyor bas rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don gtso bor sgrub pa dang*/ de gang zhig sbyor bas gzhan don gtso bor sgrub pa zer/ gdul bya la chos dngos su 'chad pa'i sbyor ba la bzhugs bzhin pa'i sa gnyis pa'i mos pa sgom lam chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ sbyor bas gzhan gtso bor sgrub pa'i phyir/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ mtshan nyid gsum pa yang des khegs/ gnyis pa la/ sa brgyad par gzhan don 'bad med lhun grub tu sgrub pa ma yin par thal/ de na sbyor bas gzhan don gtso bor sgrub pa'i mos pa bsgom lam med pa'i phyir te/ de (169) yin na/ sbyor bas rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don cha mnyam du sgrub pas khyab pa'i phyir/

rang lugs/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ ma dag sas bsdus kyis mos pa bsgom lam gang zhig yum sher phyin rang don phun tshogs kyi 'byung gnas su mos pa byed pa'i 'dun pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na/ rang don mos pa bsgom lam chung ngu'i chung ngu la sogs pa dgu/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ sa bcu pa'i ye shes ma skyes gong gi dag pa sa'i mos pa bsgom lam gang zhig sher phyin don gnyis phun tshogs kyi 'byung gnas su mos pa byed pa'i 'dun pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa dbye na/ dgu/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ sa bcu pas bsdus pa'i mos pa bsgom lam gang zhig sher phyin gzhan don phun tshogs kyi 'byung gnas su mos par byed pa'i 'dun pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na/ gzhan don mos pa bsgom lam chung ngu'i chung ngu la sogs pa dgu/ 'di dag kyang mtshon (170) byed dpe'i sgo nas chung 'bring chen por bzhag pa yin gyi/ dang por skye ba la chung ngu*/ bar du skye ba la 'bring*/ tha mar skye ba la chen por bzhag pa ni ma yin te/ gang zag gcig gi rgyud la mtshon byed dpe dgu cig char du yod pa la 'gal ba med pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ dgag bzhag spangs gsum/ dang po la kha cig rang don mos pa bsgom lam tshogs sbyor gyi gnas skabs/ gnyis pa ma dag pa/ gsum pa dag sa na yod zer ba mi 'thad de/ tshogs sbyor gyi gnas skabs na zag med bsgom lam sngon song gi mkhyen pa yod pa thal ba dang*/ bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug gis bsdus pa'i 'jig rten pa'i bsgom lam yin na/ sgom lam yin dgos par thal/ sa mtshams dang po de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ lam ma zhugs na sgom lam yod par thal lo// kha cig rang don mos pa sgom lam chung ngu sa gnyis pa nas yod pa nas chen po'i chen po sa bcu pa na yod/ de bzhin du (171) phyi ma gnyis kyi chung ngu'i chung ngu sa gnyis pa nas/ chen po'i chen po bcu pa'i bar du yod zer/ rjes thob tu gzhan don byed tshul sangs rgyas dang tshul mtshungs pa'i ma dag pa'i byang sems yod par thal/

gzhan don mos pa bsgom lam rgyud ldan gyi ma dag pa'i byang sems yod pa'i phyir/ sbyor bas rang don gtso bor sgrub pa'i sa bcu pa'i byang sems yod par thal/ rang don mos pa sgom lam rgyud ldan gyi de yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rang lugs/ dang po sa gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar du yod de/ der nyon yid kyi bag la nyal rags pa gnas ma gyur pa'i stobs kyis sbyor bas rang don gtso bo sgrub pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i phyir/ 'grel chen las/ bdag tu nga rgyal ba'i sa bon ma zad pa nyid kyis dang po kho na rang gi don gyi mos pa zhes so// gnyis pa sa dgu pa'i gnas skabs na yod de/ sbyor bas rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don 'bad med du sgrub nus shing*/ gdul bya gzhan ngor rjes thob tu sems can gyi don (172) byed tshul sangs rgyas dang tshul mtshungs pa ma thob pa'i phyir/ rang dang gzhan mnyam pa nyid kyis/ rang dang gzhan gyi don mos pa rnam pa dgu bstan zin nas/ zhes so// gsum pa/ sa bcu pa na yod de/ der rjes thob tu gdul bya gzhan ngor sems can gyi don byed tshul sangs rgyas dang tshul mtshungs pa'i phyir te/ rgyud blar/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul 'di ni// rjes thob de bzhin gshegs rnams dang*// sems can yang dag sgrol ba la// 'jig rten du ni mnyam pa nyid// ces so// spangs rtogs kyi ngos nas mnyam pa ma yin te/ sa gzhi dang rdul phran gyi khyad par dang*/ rgya mtsho dang ba glang gi rmig rjes kyi chus mtshon pa'i khyad par yod pa'i phyir te/ de lta mod kyi sa rdul dang*// rgya mtsho ba glang rmig rjes kyi// khyad par gang yin sangs rgyas dang*// byang chub sems pa'i khyad de nyid// zhes so// 'dir ṭī ka las/ ma dag sa bdun gyi rjes thob kyis bsdus te/ nyon yid ma (173) spangs pas nga rgyal phra mo 'byung ba'i phyir/ zhes dang*/ 'grel chen las/ bdag tu nga rgyal ba'i sa bon ma zad pa nyid kyis// zhes gsungs pa ni sgra ji bzhin pa ma yin no// don gzhan la dgongs nas gsungs pa'i phyir/

ji ltar gsungs na/ spyir nyon yid spong tshul de la ngo bo sa bon dang bcas pa spangs pa/ de'i bag la nyal rags pa spangs pa/ de'i bag chags phra zhing phra ba spangs pa dang gsum yod/ dang po sa dang po nas thob ste/ der khams gsum gyis nyon mongs pa zad par spangs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sa brgyad pa nas thob ste/ der nyon yid kyi bag chags rags pa gnas gyur pa'i stobs kyis mi rtog ye shes la dbang bsgyur thob pa'i phyir/ gsum pa sangs rgyas kyi sar thob ste/ der de'i bag chags phra mo gnas gyur pa'i stobs kyis mnyam nyid ye shes thob pa'i phyir/ des na/ ṭī ka dang*/ 'grel chen las bshad pa ni/ gnas gyur (174) gnyis pa la dgongs so// gsum pa la/ kha cig sa gnyis pa'i rang don mos pa sgom lam chen po'i chen po chos can/ sgom lam chen por thal/ rang don mos pa sgom lam chen po yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ de chung ngu'i chung ngu yin pa'i phyir/ sa gnyis pa ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ sa bcu pa'i gzhan don mos pa sgom lam chung ngu chos can/ sgom lam chung ngur thal/ gzhan don mos pa sgom lam chung ngu yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ de chen po'i chen po yin pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ sa bzhi pa'i ye shes chos can/ sgom lam chen por thal/ de chung ngu'i chen po yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ 'dod na ma yin par thal/ de chung ngu yin pa'i phyir te/ chung ngu skor gsum gyi nang tshan yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ sa brgyad pa'i ye shes chos can/ sgom lam chung ngur thal/ de chen po'i chung ngu yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod (175) na ma yin par thal/ chen po skor gsum gyi nang tshan yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rang gi rgyur gyur pa'i mos pa sgom lam ngo bo ji lta ba bzhin du sgom stobs kyis thob pa'i dge legs/ dbye na/ bstod pa'i phan yon dgu/ bkur ba'i phan yon dgu/

bsngags pa'i phan yon dgu ste nyer bdun/ de yang bstod pa'i phan yon ni rang don mos pa'i bkur ba ni gnyis don mos pa'i/ bsngags pa'i ni/ gzhan don mos pa'i phan yon no// gsum pa ni/ mos pa sgom lam skad cig ma gnyis pa nas sangs rgyas sa'i bar du'o// gnyis pa ni/ mos pa sgom lam chos can/ khyod la dbye na rnam pa gsum du yod de/ khyod la dbye na rang don mos pa sgom lam/ gnyis don mos pa sgom lam/ gzhan don mos pa sgom lam rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ yongs su bsngo ba (176) khyad par can// zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ theg chen gyi bsngo ba sgom lam la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ zhar byung bsngo ba'i rnam bzhag dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rang gi dge rtsa rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar byed pa'i rjes thob kyis bsdus pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ gnyis pa la/ sa mtshams dang*/ yul gyi sgo nas dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ ma dag sa dang*/ dag pa sas bsdus kyi bsngo ba sgom lam gnyis/ gnyis pa la/ mos pa khyad par can gyi/ mi dmigs pa'i/ phyin ci ma log pa'i/ dben pa'i/ dge tshogs kyi rang bzhin dran pa'i/ thabs la mkhas pa'i/ mtshan ma med pa'i/ sangs rgyas kyis snang ba'i/ khams gsum par ma gtogs pa'i/ dpe chung ngus mtshon pa'i/ dpe 'bring gis mtshon pa'i/ dpe chen pos mtshon pa'i bsngo ba sgom lam dang bcu gnyis/ gsum pa la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ khyad chos dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rang gzhan (177) gyi dge rtsa 'bras bu khyad par can du sgrub par byed pa'i 'dun pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa ste/ rgyan las/ brtan pa rnams kyi smon lam ni// sems pa 'dun dang bcas pa ste// zhes so// bsngo ba dang smon lam don gcig ming gi rnam grangs so// gnyis pa la/ mngon mtho'i dang nges legs kyi bsngo ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'khor ba'i phun tshogs thob par 'dod pa'i 'dun pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'o// gnyis pa ni/

'khor ba spangs pa'i thar pa don gnyer gyi 'dun pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'o// dbye na/ theg dman dang*/ theg chen gyi bsngo ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang don du 'khor ba spangs pa'i thar pa don gnyer gyi 'dun pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ gzhan don du 'khor ba spangs pa'i thar pa don gnyer gyi 'dun pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa lta bu'o// gsum pa la/ gang bsngo ba'i dge rtsa/ gang du bsngo ba'i sa/ gang gis bsngo ba'i gang zag ji ltar (178) bsngo ba'i tshul/ de ltar bsngos pa'i dgos pa/ bsngo ba 'grub par byed pa'i dpang po dang drug dang po la/ kha cig chos nyid bsngo rgyu'i dge rtsa yin te/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba'i mdo las/ 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// zhes pa des/ chos nyid gdod ma nas yod pa'i bsngo rgyu'i dge rtsa bstan pa'i phyir/ zer/ gnas skabs dge rtsa 'chad pa'i gang zag gzhi ma grub par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ 'gro kun zhes pa'i tshig gi khyad par smros pa dgos med du thal/ phyi rol bum snam sogs kyi chos nyid kyang bsngo rgyu'i dge rtsar mtshungs pa'i phyir/ chos nyid chos can/ khyod byang chub tu bsngos pa las gong 'phel du 'gyur bar thal/ bsngo rgyu'i dge rtsa yin phyir/ ma khyab na/ byang chub tu bsngos pa don med du 'gyur/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ 'dus byas su thal lo// rab dbye las/ chos dbyings dge bar byas nas ni// de la bsngo ba'i rgyur byed pa// bsngo bas 'gyur na 'dus byas 'gyur// mi (179) 'gyur bsngo ba don med yin// zhes so// mdo'i don ni/ 'gro ba kun gyi dge ba ji snyed yod pa zhes pas mdor bstan/ sngar byas pa/ ma 'ongs pa na byed par 'gyur ba/ da ltar byed bzhin pa gsum dmigs bsal du byas pa ni rgyas bshad yin te/ rab dbye las/ des na gzhung de'i dgongs pa ni// legs par bshad kyis 'di ltar bzung*// 'gro ba kun gyis byas pa yi// dge ba ji snyed yod pa zhes// bya ba'i sgra ni spyir bstan yin// byas dang byed 'gyur byed pa zhes// dus gsum dbye ba dmigs bsal yin// zhes so// des na/

rten gyi gang zag rang gzhan gnyis ka'i rgyud la yod pa/ dus 'das ma 'ongs da lta bas bsdus pa/ ngo bo sbyin pa tshul khrims sgom pa las byung ba'i dge ba ji snyed yod pa bsngo rgyu'i dge ba'o// gnyis pa la/ 'jig rten pa'i/ theg dman gyi sar/ bla med byang chub tu bsngo ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ dge rtsa ji snyed bsags pa rnams 'khor (180) ba'i phun tshogs tsam thob phyir du bsngo ba lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ dge rtsa rnams rang nyid gcig pus 'khor ba spangs pa'i myang 'das thob phyir du bsngo ba lta bu'o// gsum pa ni/ dge rtsa rnams sems can thams cad byang chub thob phyir bsngo ba lta bu'o// gsum pa ni/ tshul khrims dang 'bras bu la don gnyer gyi 'dun pa drag po yod pa'i gang zag gis sku gsung thugs kyi rten khyad par can yod pa'i gnas su bsngos na 'grub ste/ tshul khrims ldan pas smon pa 'grub// chos rnams thams cad rkyen bzhin du// 'dun pa'i rtse la rab tu gnas// gang gis smon lam ci btab pa// 'bras bu'ang de 'dra nyid du smin// zhes dang*/ ring bsrel can gyi mchod rten drung*// bde bar gshegs pas bsngags pas 'grub// ces so// bzhi pa ni/ gang bsngo ba'i dge rtsa/ gang du bsngo ba'i sa/ gang gis bsngo ba'i gang zag rnams don dam par mi dmigs shing kun rdzob tu snang cha ma dor ba ste/ bden gnyis zung 'jug gi rnam pas bsngo bar byed

(181) dgos te/ mdo las/ de bzhin nyid kyi rang bzhin ci 'dra dang*// de bzhin nyid kyi ngang tshul ci 'dra dang*// de bzhin nyid kyi chos nyid ci 'dra dang*// de 'drar las rnams kun kyang yongs su bsngo// zhes dang*/ rgyan las/ yongs su bsngo ba khyad par can// de yi byed pa mchog yin no// de ni dmigs med rnam pa can// zhes dang*/ rab dbye las/ chos nyid spros bral ngang nas ni// dge ba ji snyed byas pa rnams// 'grub bam gal te mi 'grub kyang*// 'gro ba'i don du bsngo byed na// byang chub sems dpa'i blo sbyong yin// zhes so// lnga pa ni/ dge rtsa mi zad cing gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i ched yin te/ byang chub tu bsngos pa'i dge rtsa rnams khong khro log lta sogs kyis 'joms par mi nus la/ ma bsngos na de gnyis kyis 'joms nus pa'i phyir/ dang po yin te/ blo gros rgya mtsho'i mdo las/ ji ltar chu thigs rgya mtsho che nang lhung*// rgya mtsho ma zad bar du de mi 'dzad// de (182) bzhin byang chub yongs bsngos dge ba yang*// byang chub ma thob bar du de mi 'dzad// ces dang*/ don gsal las/ sems can thams cad kyi don du mi zad par bya ba'i phyir/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba rnam pa bcu gnyis byed do// zhes so// gnyis pa yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ bskal pa stong du bsags pa yi// sbyin dang bde gshegs mchod la sogs// legs spyad gang yin de kun yang*// khong khro gcig gis 'joms par byed// ces dang*/ log par lta bas rtsa ba gcod// ces so// drug pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams mngon sum du bzhugs par mos pa bya ste/ rang gis gyur cig dang*/ shog cig gi tshig rnams brjod pa'i tshe/ de rnams kyis kyang mthun 'gyur byed par mos pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/ sa gnyis pa'i rjes thob ye shes chos can/

bsngo ba sgom lam yin te/ rang gzhan gyi dge (183) rtsa bla med rdzogs byang du bsngo bar byed pa'i rjes thob kyis bsdus pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir 'dir bstan bsngo ba sgom lam chos can/ khyod la dbye na rnam pa bcu gnyis yod de/ khyod kyi yul de la bcu gnyis yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis khyod la bcu gnyis su dbye ba yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ thabs dang mi dmigs pa dag gi /zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ rjes su yi rang sgom lam la// mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ dogs gcod dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rang gzhan gyi dge rtsa la dga' ba yang dag par sgom par byed pa'i tshor ba yid bde mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'i/ rjes thob kyis bsdus pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ gnyis pa la/ ma dag sa dang*/ dag sas bsdus pa'i rjes su yi rang gnyis/ gsum pa la/ kha cig mos bsngo rjes su yi rang gsum 'gal te/ de gsum gyi 'dzin stangs (184) 'gal ba'i phyir/ zer/ 'o na/ rnam mkhyen don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su mos par byed pa'i bsngo ba sgom lam chos can/ mos pa sgom lam ma yin par thal/ bsngo ba sgom lam yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ yin par thal/ rnam mkhyen don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su mos par byed pa'i theg chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam yin pa'i phyir/ dge rtsa rdzogs byang du bsngo bar byed pa'i rjes su yi rang bsgom lam de/ bsngo ba sgom lam ma yin par thal/ rjes su yi rang sgom lam yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ yin par thal/ dge rtsa rdzogs byang du bsngo bar byed pa'i theg chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam yin pa'i phyir/ rang lugs/ de gsum mi 'gal te/ theg chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam thams cad bsngo ba sgom lam gyi nang du 'dus pa'i phyir te/ de thams cad byang chub don gnyer gyi 'dun pas zin pa'i sgom lam yin pa'i phyir/ yin khyab mnyam yang ma yin te// tshor ba

(185) btang snyoms dang mtshungs ldan gyi mos bsngo gnyis rjes su yi rang sgom lam ma yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rang gzhan gyi dge ba la dga' ba yang dag par sgom pa'i sa gnyis pa'i rjes thob ye shes chos can/ rjes su yi rang sgom lam yin te/ rang gzhan gyi dge ba la dmigs nas dga' spro rgya chen po dang ldan pa'i rjes thob kyis bsdus pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ bsgrub pa sgom lam dang*/ rnam dag sgom lam gnyis/ dang po ni/ de yi ngo bo nyid mchog nyid// ces skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ theg chen gyi sgrub pa sgom lam la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la kha cig sgom spangs shes sgrib dngos su spong bar byed pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs dang*/ de'i sa bon dngos su spong ba'i zer na/ dang po la/ theg chen gyi sgom lam gyi skyon brjod pa yang yod/ gnyis pa la/ rgyun (186) mtha'i ye shes chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ de spangs zin pa'i phyir te/ sgom spangs rtog pa zad par spangs pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ rang lugs/ sgom spang shes sgrib kyi spong ba gnyen pos bsdus pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ 'di dang theg chen gyi sgom lam bar chad med lam don gcig gnyis pa la/ sa mtshams kyi sgo nas dbye na/ ma dag sa dang*/ dag pa sas bsdus kyi sgrub pa sgom lam gnyis/ spang bya'i sgo nas dbye na/ sgom spangs kyi sa bon dang*/ gnas ngan len dngos su spong ba'i grub pa sgom lam gnyis/ gnyis pa ni/ sa gnyis pa'i bar chad med lam chos can/ theg chen gyi sgrub pa sgom lam yin te/ rang gi ngo skal gyi shes sgrib dngos su spong bar byed pa'i bar chad med lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'bras bu dag pa (187)

gzugs la sogs// zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po la/ theg chen gyi rnam dag sgom lam/ gzhung gi bstan don/ 'bras bu rnam dag bye brag tu bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ sgom spangs shes sgrib kyi rten gnyen pos bsdus pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ 'di dang theg chen gyi sgom lam rnam grol lam don gcig dbye na/ sa gnyis pa'i rnam grol lam nas/ sa bcu pa'i rnam grol gyi bar dgu/ gnyis pa la chos can/ bsgrub bya'i chos/ gtan tshigs kyi don la dpyad pa dang gsum/ dang po la kha cig 'dir bstan gyi chos can la rnam grol lam bcu bdun du yod de/ theg chen la/ sa bcu'i dang*/ sangs rgyas pa'i rnam grol lam dang bcu gcig nyan thos la 'bras gnas bzhi'i rnam grol lam/ rang rgyal la rgyun (188) zhugs dang*/ dgra bcom gyi rnam grol lam gnyis su yod pa'i phyir/ rang rgyal la/ 'bras bu bar pa gnyis med de/ de cig char ba yin pa'i phyir zer bar mi 'thad de/ rang rgyal cig char pa yin pa gong du bkag zin pa'i phyir/ rang lugs/ 'dir dngos bstan gyi rnam grol lam/ nyan thos rang rgyal/ byang sems/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam grol lam bzhi yod de/ nyon mongs shes bya lam gsum gyi// zhes sogs rgyas bshad kyi skabs su de ltar bshad pa'i phyir/ 'dir bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i rnam grol lam ni/ theg chen gyi rnam grol lam ste/ 'dir rnam dag sgom lam 'chad pa'i skabs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ mdo las/ 'bras bu rnam par dag pas gzugs rnam par dag pa/ zhes dang*/ 'dir/ 'bras bu dag pas gzugs la sogs/ dag pa nyid de/ zhes pa'i don gang la byed zer ba la/ kha cig rnam grol lam rang gi ngo skal gyi dri mas rnam par dag pa na (189) de'i yul gzugs sogs kyang rang gi ngo skal gyi dri mas rnam par dag pa dang*/ de'i yul gzugs sogs kyi chos nyid mthong ba la rang gi ngo skal gyi dri mas rnam par dag pa'o// gsum pa ni/

mdo las/ de ltar na 'bras bu rnam par dag pa dang*/ gzugs rnam par dag pa 'di la gnyis su med de gnyis su byar med/ zhes sogs dang*/ 'dir de gnyis tha dad ma yin cing*// gcad du med pas dag par brjod// ces pa'i don gang yin zhe na kha cig rnam grol la rang gi ngo skal gyi dri mas rnam par dag pa'i dag pa de dang*/ de'i yul gzugs sogs rang gi ngo skal gyi dri mas rnam par dag pa'i dag pa gnyis rang mtshan la rdzas tha mi dad cing*/ spyi mtshan la ldog pa so sor blo don mthun gyi dpyad du med pa la byed/ zer/ de'i dag pa gnyis pa tha dad gtan med gcig tu thal/ de gnyis ldog pa so sor blo mthun gyis dpyad du med pa'i phyir/ rang lugs/ theg chen gyi sgom lam rnam grol lam ngo skal gyi dri mas rnam par dag (190) de'i yul gzugs sogs kyi chos nyid mthong ba la yang rang gi ngo skal gyi dri mas dag pa'i khyad par rang mtshan la rdzas tha dad pa dang*/ spyi mtshan la ldog pa so sor blo don mthun gyis dpyad du med ces pa'i don no// gsum pa/ 'bras bu rnam dag la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ kha cig rang rgyu bar chad med lam gyi 'bras bur gyur pa'i spangs rtogs gang rung gis bsdus pa'i yon tan dang*/ de'i 'bras bur gyur pa'i 'gog bden dang*/ rnam grol lam gang rung gis bsdus pa'i yon tan/ zer na/ sa gnyis pa'i rjes thob ye shes kyis ma nges/ gnyis pa la/ dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i sdug bsngal chos bzod la gnas pa'i byang sems kyi 'gog bden gyis ma nges/ rang lugs/ zag med bar chad med lam gyi stobs kyis rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya'i sa bon las grol ba'i rnam grol lam dang 'gog bden gang rung gis bsdus pa'i yon tan/ 'di dang dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu don gcig (191) dbye na/ nyan thos/ rang rgyal/ byang sems/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag dang bzhi/ mtshan nyid la/
