kha cig rang rgyu nyan thos/ rang rgyu rang rgyal/ rang rgyu byang sems kyi bar chad med lam gyi 'bras bur gyur pa'i rnam grol lam dang 'gog bden gang rung gis bsdus pa/ dang po gsum gyi mtshan nyid/ zer na/ dang po gnyis la/ nyan thos dgra bcom dang*/ rang rgyal dgra bcom gyi rtogs pa sngon du song ba'i byang 'phags kyi rnam grol lam gyis ma nges/ gsum pa la/ rnam mkhyen gyis ma nges/ rang lugs/ theg pa chung ngu'i rgyud kyi rnam grol lam dang 'gog bden gang rung gis bsdus pa'i yon tan/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ 'dus byas rnam grol lam dang*/ 'dus ma byas/ 'gog bden gnyis/ phyi ma gsum la dbye ba 'dis rig bsgre gnyis pa'i/ theg pa 'bring po pa'i rgyud kyi rnam grol lam dang 'gog bden gang rung gis bsdus pa'i yon tan/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ rgyal sras 'phags pa'i rgyud (192) kyi rnam grol lam dang 'gog bden gang rung gis bsdus pa'i yon tan/ bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa ma lus par zad par spangs pa'i spangs rtogs gang rung gis bsdus pa'i yon tan no// gnyis pa ni/ sa gnyis pa'i rnam grol lam chos can/ 'bras bu rnam dag yin te/ rang rgyud bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi sgrib pa las grol ba'i rten gnyen po yin pa'i phyir/ legs par bshad pa lung rigs kyi rgya mtsho las/ lam shes bshad pa'i skabs te gnyis pa'o// // (193) gsum pa gzhi shes la/ 'brel bkod pa'i sgo nas 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ mtshon byed kyi chos rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzhi thams cad yongs su shes pa med/ ces skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ gzhi shes la/ ngo bo/ dbye ba/ gzhung gi bstan tshul/ lam shes kyi 'og tu gzhi shes 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan dang bzhi/ dang po gnyis gong du bstan zin/ gsum pa la/ mkhas pa bu la sogs pa na re/ 'di'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i gzhi shes yin na/

theg dman gyi gzhi shes yin dgos te/ ye shes zhabs kyis/ byang chub gzhan shes nas spangs bar bya ba/ nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas kyi mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i gzhi shes/ zhes gsungs so// skabs gsum pa'i gzhung 'di rnams theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i bstan bcos ma yin par thal/ khas len rtags/ 'dod na/ sher phyin gyi mdo'i dgongs pa 'grel byed ma yin par thal lo// (194) lo chen na re/ 'di'i bstan bya'i gtso bo la theg pa che chung gi gzhi shes gnyis ka yod de/ de ltar kun shes nyid lugs la// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ dper na/ tshad ma'i bstan bcos su mngon rjes gnyis ka bstan bya'i gtso bor byas nas bstan pa bzhin no// zhes zer/ skabs gsum par tshig zin la bstan pa'i gzhi shes yin na/ skabs gsum pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i gzhi shes yin dgos par thal/ khas len rtags/ 'dod na/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi ting nge 'dzin chos can/ rnam mkhyen du thal/ skabs brgyad pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i mi slob lam yin pa'i phyir te/ der tshig zin la bstan pa dang*/ mi slob lam gyi gzhi mthun yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ rtags der thal/ nyan thos nyon mongs med pa'i lta// zhes skabs sa tshig zin la bstan pa'i mi slob lam yin pa'i phyir/ rang lugs/ skabs gsum pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bo (195) gyur pa'i gzhi shes yin na/ gnyen po gzhi shes yin dgos te/ skabs gsum pa'i ched du bya ba'i gdul bya'i gtso bo yin na/ theg chen gyi rigs can yin dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ de ni mtshan mar dmigs sgo nas// zhes so// theg dman gyi gzhi shes 'chad pa'i gzhung rnams ni skabs gsum pa'i zhar byung gi gzhung yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ 'dir lam shes las logs su gzhi shes bshad pa mi 'thad par thal/ theg chen gyi gzhi shes lam shes bshad pas go nus/ theg dman gyi gzhi shes 'di'i bstan bya'i gtso bo ma yin pa'i phyir/

zhe na/ skyon med de/ byang sems kyi gzhi shes rgyu lam shes dang ngo bo gcig tu shes pa'i sgo nas rnam mkhyen gyi rgyu rnal ma yin par shes pa dang*/ theg dman gyi lam rnams de'i gol sa mi mthun phyogs yin par shes pa'i phyir du/ 'dir theg pa che chung gi gzhi shes so sor phye nas bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ bsdu ba spyir bstan pa (196) dang*/ dka' gnas bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ gzhi shes mtshon par byed pa'i chos dgu po thams cad kyang*/ gang la 'jug pa'i yul/ gang gi 'jug pa'i sbyor ba/ zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mthong lam dang gsum du 'dus/ dang po la/ srid zhi la gnas mi gnas kyi/ 'bras yum la nye ring gi mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po'i gzhi shes so// dang po ni/ srid zhi la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes dngos su bstan nas/ gnas pa'i gzhi shes shugs la bstan pa ni/ tshu rol pha rol mtha' la min// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ de ni mtshan mar dmigs sgo nas// zhes sogs so// gsum pa la/ gzhi lam la mtshan 'dzin gyi spang gnyen/ 'bras bu la mtshan 'dzin gyi spang gnyen/ de'i don bsdu ba'o// dang po la/ spang bya dang*/ gnyen po gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzugs sogs phung po stong nyid dang*// zhes sogs so// gnyis pa ni/ sbyin la sogs la ngar 'dzin med//

(197) ces sogs so// gnyis pa la/ spang bya dang*/ gnyen po gnyis/ dang po la/ mi mthun phyogs su bstan pa dang*/ mi mthun phyogs su sgrub pa gnyis/ dang po la/ rgyal la sogs la chags pa phra// zhes sogs so// gnyis pa ni/ chos kyi lam ni rang bzhin gyis// zhes sogs so// gnyis pa la/ gnyen po dngos dang*/ yul zab pa'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ rtogs dka' ba'i rgyu mtshan no// dang po ni/ chos rnams rang bzhin gcig par ni// zhes sogs so// gnyis pa ni/ mthong ba la sogs bkag pa yis// zhes sogs so// gsum pa ni/ gzugs la sogs pa mi shes phyir// zhes sogs so// don bsdu ba ni/ de ltar kun shes/ zhes sogs so// gnyis pa ni/ sbyor ba'i ngo bo dang*/ de'i mnyam nyid gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzugs sogs de mi rtag sogs dang*// zhes sogs so// gnyis pa ni/ gzugs la sogs la rlom med pa// zhes sogs so// (198) gsum pa la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ zhar la bsgom lam mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ dang po ni/ sdug bsngal la sogs bden pa la// zhes sogs so// gnyis pa ni/ gzugs rtag ma yin mi rtag min// zhes sogs so// gsum pa ni/ nyan thos kyi lam ni/ zhes sogs so// mkhyen gsum spyi'i don bsdu 'chad pa ni// de ltar 'di dang yang 'di dang*// zhes sogs so// gnyis pa ni/ rje btsun byams pa mgon po chos can lam shes kyi 'og tu gzhi shes 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ blang dor bya ba'i gzhi thams cad yongs su shes pa med par theg pa gsum gyi lam legs par yongs su shes pa med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ltar du bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dka' ba'i gnas so sor bshad pa ni/ tshu rol pha rol mtha' la min// zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po la/ srid zhi la gnas mi gnas kyi gzhi shes ngos gzung ba dang*/ 'phros don nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa yod (199) med dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ srid zhi la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid la/

kha cig dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa dang*/ 'khor 'das rang bzhin med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa zer/ dang po la/ theg chen gyi mthong lam chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid yin par thal/ de ltar du tshad mas grub pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ rnal 'byor mngon sum chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ rnal 'byor mngon sum gang zhig 'khor 'das rang bzhin gyis med pa de khyod kyi gzhal bya yin pa'i phyir/ rang lugs/ 'khor 'das bar gsum rang bzhin gyis med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi/ theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa mtha' dag go /'khor 'das bar gsum rang (200) bzhin gyis med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg dman 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi/ theg dman 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa mtha' dag go /de yang theg chen gyi gzhi shes rnams la srid zhi gnyis kyi mtha' la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes zhes bya ste/ theg chen gyi gang zag rnams ni chos rang bzhin med pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab dang*/ sems can gyi don byed pa'i snying rje gnyis dang ldan pa'i stobs kyis 'khor ba la dor bya dang*/ myang 'das la blang byar zhen pa dang bral ba'i phyir/ theg dman gyi gzhi shes rnams la srid zhi gnyis kyi mtha' la gnas pa zhes bya ste/ theg dman gyi gang zag rnams ni chos rang bzhin gyis med par rtogs pa'i shes rab dang*/ sems can la dmigs pa'i brtse ba snying rje chen po dang mi ldan pa'i stobs kyis 'khor ba la dor bya dang*/ myang 'das la blang byar zhen pa dang bcas pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ dgag bzhag gnyis/ dang po/ mtha' gcig tu nyan (201) rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa yod pa'i lugs dgag shing rta'i srol byed dgongs pa tha dad du 'dod pa'i lugs dgag

chos kyi bdag med dang*/ bden med la rtogs dka' sla'i khyad par yod par 'dod pa'i lugs dgag pa'o// dang po la/ 'dod pa brjod pa dang*/ de dgag pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ dpal ldan zla grags kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i mkhas pa kha cig nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa yod de/ lung rigs gnyis kyis grub pa'i phyir/ lung gis grub ste/ mdo sde sa bcu pa las/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di lta ste/ dper na/ rgyal po'i rigs su skyes pa'i rgyal po'i bu rgyal po'i mtshan dang ldan pa ni skyes pa tsam gyis rgyal po'i byin gyis blon po'i tshogs thams cad zil gyis gnon gyi rang gi blo'i stobs kyis rnam par dpyad pas ni ma yin no// nam de nar son par gyur pa de'i tshe rang gi blo'i stobs bskyed pas blon po'i bya ba thams cad las shin tu 'das pa yin no// kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de bzhin (202) du byang chub sems dpa' yang sems bskyed ma thag tu lhag pa'i bsam pa'i che ba nyid kyis nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad zil gyis gnon gyi/ rang gi blo'i stobs kyis rnam par dpyad pas ni ma yin no// byang chub sems dpa' sa bdun pa 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni rang gi yul shes pa'i che ba la gnas pas nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi bya ba thams cad las shin tu 'das pa yin no// zhes dang*/ sher phyin gyi mdo las/ nyan thos kyi sa la slob par 'dod pas kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslab par bya'o// zhes dang*/ theg dman gyi mdo las/ gzugs ni dbu ba brdos pa 'dra// tshor ba chu yi chu bur bzhin// 'dus shes rmig rgyu lta bu ste// 'du byed rnams ni chu shing bzhin// rnam par shes pa sgyu ma ltar// nyi ma'i gnyen gyis bka' stsal to// zhes so// rigs pa ni/ byang sems mthong lam pa des nyan thos dgra bcom pa blo gros kyi stobs kyis zil gyis gnon nus par

(203) thal/ des chos kyi bdag med rtogs/ nyan thos dgra bcom pas de ma rtogs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ skyes ma thag pa'i rgyal bus/ blon po'i tshogs blo gros kyi stobs kyis zil gyis gnon nus par thal lo// nyan thos dgra bcom pas rang rgyud kyi phung po la dmigs nas ngar 'dzin gyi blo skye ba yod par thal/ des phung po bden med du ma rtogs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ des ngar 'dzin gyi dbang gis las bsags te yang srid du skye ba yod par thal/ de'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rin chen phreng bar/ ji srid phung por 'dzin yod pa// de srid de las ngar 'dzin yod// ngar 'dzin yod na yang las te// de las yang ni skye ba yin// zhes so// theg dman la 'khor ba spangs pa'i myang 'das med par thal/ des stong nyid ma rtogs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rtsa sher las/ las dang nyon mongs zad pas thar// las dang nyon mongs rnam rtog las// de dag spros las spros pa ni// stong pa nyid kyis 'gags (204) par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ bden pa mthong bar grol 'gyur gyi// stong nyid mthong bas ci zhig bya// gang phyir lung las lam 'di ni// med par byang chub med par gsungs// zhes dang*/ bstan rtsa dge slong nyid yin na// dge slong nyid kyang dka' bar gnas// sems ni dmigs dang bcas rnams kyi// mya ngan 'das pa'ang dka' bar gnas// zhes so// nyan thos dgra bcom pas gang zag gi bdag med mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i tshul gyis ma rtogs par thal/ des gang zag bden med du ma rtogs pa'i phyir/ des khams gsum na spyod pa'i nyon mongs pa zad par ma spangs par thal/ des phung po la bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin ma spangs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ bden 'dzin la nyon sgrib kyis khyab pa'i phyir/ de yang sa bdun pa man chad du nyon sgrib tsam spong ba'i bya ba byed de/ der bden 'dzin sa bon dang bcas pa spong ba'i bya ba byed pa'i phyir/

shes sgrib ni sa brgyad pa yan (205) chad kho nar spong dgos pa yin no// gal te/ nyan thos kyi theg pa las logs su theg chen gyi theg pa bstan pa dgos med du thal/ nyan thos la yang chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa yod pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ skyon med de/ snying rje dang smon lam la sogs pa'i byang sems kyi spyod pa rgya chen po ston pa'i phyir du theg chen gyi theg pa bstan pa'i phyir te/ rin chen phreng bar/ nyan thos theg pa de las ni// byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang*// spyod pa yongs bsngo ma bshad nges// byang chub sems dpar ga la 'gyur// zhes so// chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa rgyas par bstan pa'i phyir du yang theg chen gyi theg pa bstan pa yin te/ nyan thos kyi theg pa las/ chos kyi bdag med mdor bsdus pa tsam las ma gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'jug 'grel las/ chos kyi bdag med pa gsal bar bya ba'i phyir theg pa chen po bstan pa yang rigs pa nyid de rgyas par brjod par (206) 'dod pa'i phyir ro// nyan thos kyi theg pa las ni chos kyi bdag med pa mdor mtshon pa tsam zhig tu zad do// ji skad du slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ mtshan ma med pa ma rtogs par// khyod kyis thar pa med par gsungs// de phyir khyod kyi theg chen las// de ni tshang bar bstan pa lags// ces gsung ngo*// gnyis pa la/ gnod byed yod pa/ lung gis mi gnod pa'i tshul/ bden 'dzin nyon sgrib kyi mtshan gzhi yin pa mi 'thad pa/ nyon sgrib spongs ba'i sa mtshams mi 'thad pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam de/ theg dman gyi tshogs lam las thabs shes khyad par can gnyis dang ldan pa'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa ma yin par thal/ theg dman gyi tshogs lam la yang stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mtshan med rab tu sbyin la sogs// zhes sogs dang 'gal/ sbyor lam (207) la/ dmigs pa dang ni rnam pa dang*// zhes sogs dang*/

mthong lam la/ bsam mi khyab sogs khyad par gyis// zhes sogs dang*/ sgom lam la/ sgom pa lam ni zab pa ste// zhes sogs dang sbyar te shes par bya'o// nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i mngon rtogs chos can/ chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i mkhyen par thal/ chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i mi slob lam yin pa'i phyir/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam de srid zhi la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes su thal/ de 'khor 'das bar gsum rang bzhin gyis med pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ dus rnams mnyam pa nyid shes phyir// shes rab pha rol phyin par 'dod// ces so// gnyis pa ni/ sa bcu pa'i lung gis mi gnod de/ sa dang por blo gros kyi stobs kyis zil gyis gnon pa'i nus pa yod kyang*/ sa bdun pa nas shin tu (208) nas kyang*/ blo gros kyi stobs kyi zil gyis gnon pa'i nus pa yod pa la dgongs pa'i phyir te/ sa bdun par yang dag pa'i mtha' la dus skad cig ma gcig la 'jug ldang byed nus par bshad pa'i phyir/ mdo rang nyid las kyang*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi bya ba thams cad las shin tu 'das pa yin no// zhes 'byung ba'i phyir/ sher phyin gyi lung gis mi gnod de/ der bdag med tsam rtogs pa'i shes rab la sher phyin gyi ming gis btags nas bstan pa'i phyir lung gsum pas mi gnod de/ theg dman gyi lung las/ phung po bden med du rtogs pa'i shes rab bshad kyang*/ de theg dman gyi rgyud la ldan mi dgos pa'i phyir/ dper na/ theg dman gyi lung las/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes bshad kyang*/ de theg dman la ldan mi dgos pa bzhin no// lung phyi ma rnams kyi don ni/ theg dman la gang zag gi bdag med stong pa'i stong nyid nyi 'tshe ba'i rtogs pa yod pa tsam la dgongs te/ rab dbye las/ (209) stong nyid nyan thos rnams kyang sgom// de'i 'bras bu 'gog pa'ang 'thob// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/

'khor gsum du rnam par rtog pa'i bden 'dzin de shes sgrib ma yin par thal/ bden 'dzin la nyon sgrib kyi khyab pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ 'khor gsum rnam par rtog pa gang*// de ni shes bya'i sgrib par 'dod// ces pa dang 'gal/ bzhi pa ni/ theg chen gyi sgom lam chung ngu'i chung ngu la sogs pa dgu po des/ sgom spangs shes sgrib chen po'i chen po la sogs pa dgu rim bzhin du spong ba mi 'thad par thal/ sa bdun pa man chad du shes sgrib dngos su spangs ba mi srid pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sa dgu la ni chen po yi// zhes sogs dang 'gal/ mthong spangs shes sgrib spangs ba'i theg chen mthong lam pa gzhi ma grub par thal/ mthong spangs shes sgrib dngos su spong ba'i bar chad med lam gzhi ma grub pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mthong ba'i lam thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa de nyon mongs pa dang (210) shes bya'i sgrib pa'i 'jigs pa med pa'i phyir/ ting 'dzin seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa la snyoms par zhugs nas/ zhes pa dang 'gal/ byang sems 'phags pas/ sa bcur shes sgrib gtso bor yang*/ nyon sgrib gtso bo mi spong bar bshad de mi 'thad par thal/ khas len rtags/ 'dod na/ kun btus su/ sa bcu rnams su bsgom pa'i lam la shes bya'i sgrib pa'i gnyen po'i lam sgom gyi nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa'i gnyen po ni ma yin te/ zhes so// nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rtogs pa sngon du song ba'i ma dag sa'i bar chad med lam gyis sgrib pa dngos su spong ba'i bya ba cung zad kyang mi byed par thal/ des nyon sgrib spangs zin pa gang zhig shes sgrib spong ba'i bya ba cung zad kyang mi byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ kha cig klu sgrub rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i lugs la nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa yod/ byams chos rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i lugs la/ de rtogs pa (211) med zer na/ sher phyin gyi mdo'i dgongs pa/ nyan rang gis chos kyi bdag med rtogs par gnas sam/

ma rtogs par gnas/ dang po ltar na/ byams pas/ sher phyin gyi mdo'i dgongs pa phyin ci ma log par ma shes par thal ba'i skyon gnas/ gnyis pa ltar na/ klu sgrub kyis/ mdo'i dgongs pa phyin ci ma log par ma shes pa'i skyon gnas/ gsum pa la/ kha cig nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa med de/ nyan rang ni 'khor gsum du zhen pa dang bcas pa'i phyir/ bden med rtogs te/ gang zag bden med du rtogs pa'i phyir te/ gang zag phung po la btags pa'i btags yod du rtogs pa'i phyir dang*/ des phung po lnga bden med du rtogs pa'i phyir/ zer/ rgyun zhugs srid pa lan bdun pa chos can/ 'khor bar las nyon gyi dbang gis skye ba mi len par thal/ bden med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i skyes bu yin pa'i phyir/ rgyud blar/ (212) ji bzhin yang dag mthong ba'i phyir// skye sogs rnams las 'das gyur kyang*// zhes so// nyan thos kyi mthong lam chos can/ gnyen po gzhi shes su thal/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum rang bzhin gyis med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med rtogs par thal/ shes pa bden med du rtogs pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ shes pa la bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin de/ 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag 'dzin ma yin par thal lo// rdzas 'dzin rtog pa de theg chen gyi lam gyi gnas skabs su gtso bor spang nus/ theg dman gyi lam gyi gnas skabs su gtso bor spong mi nus pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de theg chen sbyor lam gyi khyad chos su bshad pa mi 'thad par thal/ rdzas 'dzin rtogs pa'i sa bon dngos su spong ba'i theg dman gyi bar chad med lam yod pa'i phyir te/ shes pa la bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin gyi sa bon

(213) dngos su spong ba'i theg dman gyi bar chad med lam yod pa'i phyir/ rnam shes kyi phung po bden med du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i de yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rang lugs/ nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa med de/ de lung dang rigs pa gnyis kyis grub pa'i phyir/ lung ni/ 'dus pa rin po che'i tog las/ rtag tu khams gsum bdag med rdzas med cing*// byed po rang dbang med par rnam bltas nas// rjes su mthun pa'i bzod pa gang bsgom pa// de dag 'gro ba kun las thar bar 'gyur// zhes dang*/ lang gshegs las/ mtshan ma med pa ma rtogs pas theg pa chen po'i byang chub mi rtogs pa yin gyi nyan thos kyi byang chub mi rtogs pa ma yin no// zhes dang*/ rgyan stug po bkod pa las/ chos kyi dngos yod ma bshig phyir// nyan thos de dag mngon rtogs gyur// zhes so// rigs pa ni/ theg dman gyi lam de thabs shes khyad par can gnyis dang bral (214) ba'i lam ma yin par thal/ de la stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sdud par/ thabs med shes rab bral bas nyan thos nyid du ltung*// zhes dang*/ srid dang zhi bar ltung ba'i phyir// rtogs pa dman pa nyid dang ni// zhes pa dang 'gal/ mig med pa'i gang zag gis/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du mi mthong ba dang*/ theg dman gyi spros bral stong nyid mngon sum du mi mthong ba dpe don du bshad pa mi 'thad par thal/ de la stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rgyud blar/ rang 'byung rnams kyi don dam de// dad pa nyid kyis rtogs bya yin// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba// mig med pas ni mthong ba med// zhes pa dang 'gal/ theg dman gyi gang zag de gzhan don la sems pa'i de'i thabs rnyed pa'i/ ji snyed pa'i chos rgya chen po rtogs pa'i/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i bde ba bzhi dang bral bar bshad pa mi 'thad par thal/

de la stong (215) nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rgyan las/ cher 'os sems bskyed spangs ba'i skye bo dang*// gzhan don sems dang de'i thabs rnyed dang*// dgongs chen don dang de nyid mchog mthong ba'i// bde ba de spangs zhi bar 'gro bar 'gyur// zhes pa dang 'gal/ gzhan yang*/ theg chen gyi lam lnga/ theg dman gyi lam lnga las chos kyi bdag med rtogs tshul gyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa'i sngar bshad pa'i rigs pa rnams dran par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ theg chen gyi mthong lam chos can/ srid zhi la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes yin te/ 'khor 'das bar gsum rang bzhin med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ de ni mtshan mar dmigs sgo nas// zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po la/ 'bras yum la nye ba dang*/ ring ba'i gzhi shes gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid la/ kha cig 'bras yum sgrub pa'i thabs la (216) mkhas pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa/ zer/ rnam mkhyen chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ 'bras yum dngos ma yin par thal lo// rang lugs/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ 'bras yum sgrub pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i byang 'phags kyi mkhyen pa/ mtshan gzhi/ theg chen gyi mthong lam sgom lam lta bu'o// gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'bras yum sgrub pa'i thabs la mi mkhas pa'i theg dman 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa/ mtshan gzhi/ theg dman gyi mthong sgom mi slob lam lta bu'o// gal te/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i mkhyen pa chos can/ mtshan nyid de ma yin par thal/ 'bras yum sgrub pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir te/ 'bras yum sgrub pa'i thabs la rmongs pa spangs pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir te/ rmongs pa ma lus pa spangs pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir te/ ma rig pa ma (217) lus par spangs pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i mkhyen pa chos can/

shes bya thams cad mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa yin par thal/ de rtogs pa la rmongs pa ma lus par spangs pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khyab khas/ gnyis pa ni/ theg dman gyi mthong lam chos can/ 'bras yum la ring ba'i gzhi shes yin te/ 'bras yum sgrub pa'i thabs la mi mkhas pa'i/ theg dman 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ theg chen gyi mthong lam chos can/ 'bras yum la nye ba'i gzhi shes yin te/ 'bras yum sgrub pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i rgyal sras 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs sogs phung po stong nyid dang*// zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po la/ yul can gzhi shes/ spangs bya mtshan 'dzin/ de dag gnyen pos ji ltar spongs tshul lo// dang po la/ gnyen (218) po gzhi shes dang*/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i mtshan 'dzin gyis ma bcings pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ des bcings pa'i theg dman 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa/ bcings ma bcings kyi don gang yin zhe na/ kha cig theg chen gyi gzhi shes de des ma bcings pa'i gzhi shes yin te/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum la mtshan mar mi 'dzin pa'i gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir/ theg dman gyi de des bcings pa yin te/ de dang mtshan 'dzin gyi rtag pa lha/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir/ zer/ theg dman gyi gzhi shes chos can/ bdag med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor mngon sum ma yin pa thal ba dang*/ mtshan med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi spang bya yin par thal// mtshan 'dzin gyi blo yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig (219) theg chen gyi gzhi shes des ma bcings te/ de dang mtshan 'dzin gyi rtog pa lhan cig tu 'jug mi srid pa'i phyir/ theg dman gyi de des bcings te/ de dang mtshan 'dzin gyi rtog pa rgyun chags su lhan cig 'jug srid pa'i phyir/

zer/ ma dag pa'i rjes thob kyi gnas skabs su shes sgrib rtag 'dzin rtog pa ldan pa mi srid par thal/ yul la mngon par zhen pa'i mngon zhen gyi dri ma rags pa rgyud la ldan bzhin pa'i ma dag sa'i byang sems gzhi ma grub pa'i phyir te/ mtshan 'dzin gyi rtog pa rgyud la ldan bzhin pa'i de gzhi ma grub pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ gang zag gi bdag med la yid rtse gcig tu gnas bzhin pa'i nyan thos 'phags pa gzhi ma grub par thal/ rang rgyud kyi yid kyi rnam par shes pa mnyam bzhag ye shes kyi ngo bor skyes pa'i nyan thos 'phags pa med pa'i phyir te/ nyan thos 'phags pa yin na/ mtshan 'dzin gyi rtog pa rgyud ldan yin (220) dgos pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ rang lugs/ theg chen gyi gzhi shes la gzhi lam 'bras gsum la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i mtshan 'dzin gyis ma bcings pa zhes bya ste/ des gzhi lam 'bras gsum rang bzhin med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i stobs kyis gzhi lam 'bras gsum la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i mtshan 'dzin sa bon dang bcas pa rang lam du spong nus pa'i phyir/ theg dman gyi gzhi shes la des bcings pa zhes bya ste/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i stobs kyis de'i sa bon rang lam du spong mi nus pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ spyir mtshan 'dzin ni/ 'dus byas kyi chos rnams gzhan la rags ma las rang dbang can du 'dzin pa'i blo yin la/ de la nyon sgrib kyis bsdus pa'i mtshan gzhi dang*/ shes sgrib kyi bsdus pa'i de gnyis/ dang po ni/ gang zag gi bdag 'dzin/ lhan skyes dang*/ kun btags lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ rang rgyu chos kyi bdag 'dzin las byung zhing*/ yul la mngon par zhen pa'i (221) mngon zhen gyi dri ma rags pa'o// de la 'dzin pa dang*/ yul gyi sgo nas dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ rdzas 'dzin dang*/ btags 'dzin gyis bsdus pa'i mtshan 'dzin gnyis/ dang po ni/ yul yul can gyi chos rnams la 'khor gsum du rtogs pa'i bdag 'dzin lta bu/

'di dang chos kyi bdag 'dzin don gcig dbye na/ lhan skyes dang*/ kun btags kyi chos kyi bdag 'dzin gnyis/ dang po ni/ lung rigs sogs la ltos med du yul yul can la rang gi ngang gi bden pa 'dzin pa'i blo lta bu'o// gnyis pa lung rigs ltar snang rgyu mtshan du byas nas brtags shing dpyad pa'i sgo nas yul yul can la bden par 'dzin pa'i blo lta bu'o// gnyis pa/ yul yul can gyi chos rnams la btags pa tsam du mngon par zhen pa'i shes sgrib rtog pa lta bu'o// de la rags pa dang*/ shin tu phra ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ mtshan 'dzin dang sgra don 'dres 'dzin gyi rtog pa gnyis ka yin la/ sa mtshams (222) sa bdun pa'i bar du yod de/ ṭī kar/ sa brgyad pa ma thob pa de srid du gzhi la mtshan mar 'dzin par 'byung ba'i phyir ro// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa/ yul la btags pa tsam du zhen pa'i zhen pa phra zhing phra ba/ sa bcu pa'i rjes thob kyi bar du yod de/ ṭī ka las/ sbyor ba tsam ni sa bcu pa'i bar du yod de/ gzhi'i chos la mngon par zhen pa'i dri ma yod pa de srid du sgom par bya ba yin pa'i phyir dang*/ rgyun mtha'i bar du bag la nyal yod pa'i phyir ro// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ ṭī ka'i rjes su 'brang ba kha cig sa brgyad pa yan chad du shes sgrib rtog pa med pa dang*/ shes sgrib rtog pa la sgra don 'dres 'dzin gyi rtog pas khyab par smra ba ni/ ṭī ka la zhib tu ma spyad pa'i pho tshod tsam du zad do// gnyis pa/ yul gyi sgo nas dbye ba la/ gzhi lam 'bras bu la mtshan mar 'dzin pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ gzhi'i chos nyid dang*/ gzhi'i chos can la mtshan (223) mar 'dzin pa'i blo gnyis/ gzugs sogs phung po stong nyid la// spyod pa'i 'du shes mi mthun phyogs// zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa/ lam la mtshan 'dzin ni/ sbyin sogs byang chub phyogs rnams la// spyod pa'i 'du shes mi mthun phyogs// zhes pas bstan/

gsum pa/ rgyal la sogs pa chags pa phra// zhes pas bstan/ des na 'dir 'ching byed kyi mtshan 'dzin dngos su bstan nas des bcings pa'i theg dman gyi gzhi shes mtshon nas bstan pa yin no// gsum pa la/ kha cig byang sems kyi rgyud kyi gnyen po gzhi shes kyi theg dman gyi rgyud kyi mtshan 'dzin dngos su spong ste/ 'dir mtshan 'dzin dang gnyen po gzhi shes spang gnyen du bshad shing*/ 'dir bstan gyi mtshan 'dzin theg dman gyi rgyud la ldan pa'i phyir/ zer/ theg dman gyi gang zag 'bad med du grol ba dang*/ theg chen gyi rigs can 'bad pa (224) byas kyang grol ba'i dus med par thal ba'i skyon gnas so// rang lugs/ gnyen po gzhi shes dang*/ mtshan 'dzin mtha' dag spong gnyen du sbyar nas 'chad pa ma yin te/ mtshan 'dzin gyi blo yin na/ rang 'joms byed kyi gnyen po dang dngos su ldan pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ des na/ byang 'phags kyi mtshan med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis byang sems rang rgyud kyi sgrib pa dngos su spong ste/ des byang sems rang rgyud kyi mtshan 'dzin gyi sa bon la dngos su gnod pa byed pa'i sgo nas mngon 'gyur ba rgyud nas 'joms pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam chos can/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes yin te/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i mtshan 'dzin gyis bcings pa'i theg dman 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs sogs de mi rtag sogs dang*// zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po la/ gzhi shes sbyor ba/ gzhi shes sbyor ba'i (225) mtshan nyid/ 'phros don mtshan nyid gsum bshad pa'o// dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ kha cig gzugs sogs yul bcu la/ zhen sbyong mngon 'gyur ba bkag nas sgom par byed pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ gzhi gang zag gi bdag med sgom pa'i nyams len/ zer/ dang po la/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam chos can/

mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir te/ theg dman gyi gzhi shes sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ theg chen gyi mthong lam chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na ma yin par thal/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ rang lugs/ gzhi gang zag gi bdag med pa dang*/ chos kyi bdag med pa gang rung sgom par byed pa'i nyams len/ dbye na/ dngos bstan theg chen gyi gzhi shes sbyor ba dang*/ shugs (226) bstan theg dman gyi de gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams so// dang po ni/ gzugs sogs yul bcu ci rigs pa la bden zhen mngon 'gyur ba bkag nas sgom par byed pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ dbye na/ gzhi'i ngo bo/ khyad par/ mtshan nyid gsum/ spang gnyen gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i chos nyid/ gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i/ byed pa po med pa'i chos nyid/ bya dka' rnam gsum/ 'bras bu khyad par can/ srung byed gzhan la rag ma las pa/ snang ba rnam bdun la zhen sbyor bkag pa'i sbyor ba dang bcu/ dang po bzhi la/ rang bzhin gyi sbyor ba zhes bya ste/ tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar du khyab byed du gnas pa'i phyir/ phyi ma drug la gnas skabs kyi sbyor ba zhes bya ste/ rang rang gi dgag bya'i dri ma skyes na sgom ma skyes na sgom mi dgos pa'i sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ 'brom la sogs pa na re/ 'dir bstan gyi sbyor ba (227) bcu/ sbyor lam kho na'i gnas skabs na yod de/ 'tshams sbyar du/ de dag rnam par sgom pa'i sbyor ba gang yin zhe na/ sbyor ba'i lam ni/ zhes dang*/ sbyor ba'i mnyam pa nyid so sor rtogs nas mthong ba'i lam sgom dgos pas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud la gzugs sogs kyi ngo bo dang*/ de'i khyad par rtag mi rtag sogs la bden zhen 'gog pa'i sbyor ba med par thal/ khas len rtags/ sgrub byed kyang ma nges te/

sbyor ba'i lam zhes sogs gsungs pa tsam gyis nges 'byed cha mthun gyis bsdus pa'i sbyor lam du ma nges pa'i phyir/ nyer bsdogs zhi rags kyi rnam pa can sbyor ba'i lam du gsungs pa dang*/ lam bzhis bzlas phye ba'i sbyor ba'i lam sogs du ma yod pa'i phyir/ rang lugs theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar du'o// gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ gzhi gang zag gi bdag med par sgom par byed pa'i theg dman gyi (228) nyams len/ mtshan gzhi/ theg dman gyi slob lam bzhi lta bu'o// gnyis pa/ theg chen gyi gzhi shes sbyor ba'i mnyam nyid la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ yul can sbyor ba dang sbyor ba'i yul bden med mnyam pa nyid du sgom par byed pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ dbye na gzugs sogs kyi ngo bo la/ de'i khyad par la/ dbye ba'i spros pa la/ yul can sbyor ba la bden zhen 'gog pa'i sbyor ba'i mnyam nyid dang bzhi/ gzugs la sogs la rlom med par// rnam bzhi de yi mnyam pa nyid// ces so// theg chen gyi sbyor lam chos can/ theg chen gyi gzhi shes sbyor ba yin te/ gzugs sogs yul bcu la bden zhen mngon 'gyur ba bkag nas sgom par byed pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ de ma rdzogs dang rab rdzogs dang*// zhes skabs su/ mtshan nyid gsum la/ so so'i ngo bo/ grangs nges/ go rim/ sgra bshad/ lung dang

(229) sbyar ba'o// dang po la/ dgag bzhag gnyis/ dang po la/ kha cig don la med bzhin du rtog pas sgro btags pa'i chos/ rgyu rkyen gyi dbang gis byung ba'i rten 'brel/ yul gyi gnas lugs su grub pa'i chos/ zer/ dang po la/ bum pa chos can mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir te/ don la med pa dang*/ sgro btags kyi gzhi mthun yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gzhan dbang ma yin par thal lo// gnyis pa la/ rgyu rkyen chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rgyu rkyen las byung bar thal lo// gsum pa la/ gang zag gi bdag med chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ don dam bden par thal lo// ma grub na/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab de/ yul gyi gnas tshul la zhugs pa'i blo ma yin par (230) thal lo// kha cig yul gyi gnas tshul la med bzhin du rtog pas sgro btags pa'i chos/ rgyu rkyen gzhan la rag las pa'i chos/ dang po gnyis kyi mtshan nyid yin zer na/ dang po la/ gang zag gi bdag med chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir te/ kun rdzob bden pa dang rtag pa'i gzhi mthun yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ yul gyi gnas tshul ma yin par thal lo// gnyis pa la/ rgyu rkyen gyi chos nyid chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir te/ rgyu rkyen la 'brel ba'i phyir/ rang lugs/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ don byed mi nus pa'i kun rdzob snang tsam gyi chos/ dbye na/ mtshan nyid yongs su chad pa dang*/ rnam grangs pa'i kun btags gnyis/ dang po ni/ gang zag gi bdag lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ don dam bden pa ma yin pa'i rtag pa mtha' dag go /gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang gi rgyu rkyen las skyes pa'i (231) rten 'brel/ mtshan gzhi/ 'dus byas mtha' dag go /dbye na/ dag pa gzhan dbang dang*/ ma dag pa gzhan dbang gnyis/ dang po 'phags rgyud kyi rjes thob lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/

'khor ba lta bu'o// gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ rigs shes tshad ma'i yul gyi gtso bor gyur pa'i de kho na nyid/ dbye na/ phyin ci ma log pa'i/ 'gyur med yongs grub gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'phags rgyud kyi mnyam bzhag lta bu ste/ yongs grub btags pa'o// gnyis pa chos nyid lta bu'o// bsdu na/ bden pa gnyis su 'dus te/ yongs grub don dam pa'i bden pa dang*/ kun rdzob la/ don byed nus mi nus gnyis las/ dang po la/ gzhan dbang*/ gnyis pa la/ kun btags su bzhag pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ yul gyi sgo nas de gsum du bzhag ste/ so so skye bo'i blo'i yul gyi dbang du byas nas kun btags 'phags (232) pa'i rjes thob kyi dbang du byas nas gzhan dbang*/ de'i mnyam bzhag gi yul gyi dbang du byas nas yongs grub bzhag pa'i phyir/ gsum pa/ mtshan nyid gsum gyi go rim 'di ltar du 'jog pa 'thad de/ rnam grol don gnyer gyi gang zag gis/ dang por chos thams cad blos btags nas bzhag pa'i sgro btags su shes par byed/ de'i rjes su ma dag pa'i gzhan dbang spong bar byed/ de'i rjes su dag pa gnyis ldan gyi yongs grub mngon du byed pa'i phyir/ rgyan las/ yongs su shes dang spong ba dang*// mngon sum du ni bya ba'i phyir// zhes so// bzhi pa ni/ rtog pas sgro btags pa tsam gyis na kun btags dang*/ rgyu rkyen gzhan la rag las pas na gzhan dbang*/ yul gyi gnas lugs su grub pas na yongs grub ces bya'o// lnga pa ni/ sher phyin gyi mdo las/ byams pa gzugs kyi rab tu dbye ba ni rnam pa gsum gyis shes par bya ste/ kun btags pa'i gzugs dang*/ rnam par btags (233) pa'i gzugs/ chos nyid kyi gzugs so// zhes dang*/ dgongs 'grel las/ don dam yang dag 'phags chos rnams kyi/ ngo bo nyid med pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid med pa rnam pa gsum po 'di lta ste/ mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa dang*/ skye ba'i ngo bo nyid med pa dang*/

don dam pa'i ngo bo nyid med pa la dgongs nas chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid med do// zhes dang*/ sum cu pa las/ ngo bo nyid ni rnam gsum gyi// ngo bo nyid med rnam gsum la// dgongs nas chos rnams thams cad kyi// ngo bo nyid med bstan pa yin// zhes dang*/ bshad sbyar las/ rnam par rtog pas btags pa'i don// kun tu btags pa'i ngo bo nyid// rnam par rtog pa gzhan gyis dbang*// de yis chos nyid yongs su grub// ces so// gnyis pa ni byang sems kyi sbyor lam chos can/ mtshan nyid gsum la zhen sbyor bkag pa'i sbyor ba yin te/ mtshan nyid gsum la bden zhen mngon gyur (234) pa bkag nas sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa mthong lam la/ gnyis kyi dang po ni/ gong du bshad zin/ gnyis pa ni/ theg chen gyi mthong lam shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug chos can/ gzhi shes 'chad pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i mthong lam yin te/ bden bzhi la sgro 'dogs so// gnyis dang bral ba'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ nyan thos kyi lam ni/ zhes skabs su gnyis kyi dang po la/ gzhi shes 'chad pa'i skabs su dngos su mi ston rgyu'i sgom lam gang yin dpyad pa la/ kha cig 'dir sgom lam tsam dngos su mi ston par 'dod/ kha cig theg dman gyi sgom lam dngos su mi ston par 'dod/ kha cig theg chen gyi sgom lam dngos su mi ston te/ 'dir theg chen gyi mthong lam dngos su bstan rjes su/ theg chen gyi sgom lam dngos su mi ston pa'i phyir/ zer/ lugs gsum ka mi 'thad de/ 'dir mi mthun (235) phyogs dang gnyen po'i gzhi shes rdzogs par bstan pa'i phyir te/ de ltar kun shes nyid lugs la// zhes sogs so// rang lugs/ dogs pa bkod pa dang*/ de'i lan gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzhi shes 'chad pa'i skabs 'dir/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs zin bsgom par byed pa'i theg chen gyi sgom lam dngos su ston rigs par thal/

gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du gsar du mthong ba'i theg chen mthong lam dngos su bstan pa'i phyir/ dper na/ lam shes 'chad pa'i skabs su/ chos nyid mngon sum du gsar du mthong ba'i theg chen gyi mthong lam dngos su bstan pa'i rjes su chos nyid mngon sum du mthong zin bsgoms par byed pa'i theg chen gyi sgom lam bstan pa 'di bzhin/ zhe na/ gnyis pa ni/ 'dir gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du gsar du mthong ba'i theg chen gyi mthong lam dngos su ston pa'i rgyu mtshan (236) yod de/ byang sems 'phags pas/ gdul bya nyan thos kyi rigs can rjes su bzung ba'i phyir du/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du shes par bya dgos pa'i phyir/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs zin sgom par byed pa'i theg chen gyi sgom lam dngos su mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ byang sems 'phags pas/ gang zag gi bdag 'dzin spangs pa'i spangs pa la sogs pa theg dman gyi lam gyi 'bras bu don du mi gnyer ba'i phyir te/ 'grel chen las/ ci'i phyir lam shes pa la ji skad bstan pa de bzhin du thams cad shes pa nyid la bsgom pa'i lam yang logs shig tu bstan pa med ce na/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi phun sum tshogs pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i shes pa dang mthong ba bltas nas 'da' bar bya'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gnyis pa ni/ gzhi shes 'chad pa'i skabs 'dir chos can/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs zin bsgom par (237) byed pa'i theg chen gyi sgom lam mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ theg chen gyi sgom lam gyis gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi de ltar du ma bshad pa'i phyir/ legs par bshad pa lung rigs kyi rgya mtsho las/ gzhi shes bshad pa'i skabs te gsum pa'o// ༄// mkhyen gsum lha lam yang pa der// sbyor bzhi rta bdun gyis drang ste// chos sku'i 'od stong rab rgyas pa// dngos brgyad nyin byed dbang por 'dud// gnyis pa nyams len gyi sbyor ba la/

dbang du bya ba rgyu 'bras dang*/ brtan pa rgyu 'bras gnyis/ dang po la/ rgyu rnam kun gyi sbyor ba dang*/ 'bras bu rtse mo'i sbyor ba gnyis// dang po la/ 'brel bkod pa'i sgo nas 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ mtshon byed kyi chos rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum yongs su (238) shes pa ni/ zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams so// dang po la/ kha cig mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa bsgom pa la dbang ma thob pa thob phyir du mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa bsdus nas bsgom par byed pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ zer/ sa brgyad pa'i ye shes chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa bsgom pa la dbang thob zin pa'i phyir te/ de 'bad med lhun grub du sgom par byed pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa'i phyir/ rang lugs/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa bsdus nas bsgom par byed pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ bsdus nas bsgom pa'i don gang zhe na/ sngar rnam mkhyen thob bya'i 'bras bu/ lam shes de thob byed kyi rgyu/ gzhi shes blang dor bya ba'i yul du thos bsam gyis gtan la phab pa'i don/ yul can mkhyen pa gsum dang (239) yul skye med gsum zung 'jug tu blo gcig gi yul du nyams su len pa ni/ bsdus nas bsgom pa'i don yin te/ 'phags pas/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum ni rnam pa so sor nges pa'i yul can yin la/ rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa ni rnam pa ma lus pa'i yul can yin no// zhes gsung ngo*// kho na re/ theg chen gyi mthong lam chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mkhyen gsum rtogs par thal/ 'dod na/ de mngon sum du rtogs par thal/ de rtogs pa gang zhig rnal 'byor mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ thos bsam gtso bor gyur pa'i theg chen gyi tshogs lam chos can/

mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sgom byung gi mkhyen par thal/ 'dod na/ thos bsam gtso bor gyur pa'i mkhyen pa yin par thal lo// zhe na/ dang po la/ gzhan (240) don du rnam mkhyen thob par 'dod pa'i byang sems mthong lam pa'i don dam sems bskyed chos can/ rnam mkhyen mngon sum du rtogs par thal/ de rtogs pa gang zhig rnal 'byor mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ byang sems 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa yin na/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i mnyam bzhag sngon song yin pas ma khyab par thal/ de yin na/ bsgom byung gi mkhyen pa yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ gsung rab la thos bsam gtso bor byed bzhin pa'i byang 'phags kyi rjes thob ye shes chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ thos bsam gtso bor byed pa'i mkhyen pa ma yin par thal/ de'i phyir/ gsum dngos/ gnyis pa la/ lus kyi sgo nas/ gzhi shes/ lam shes/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa bsgom pa'i sbyor ba dang gsum/ mtshan gzhi'i sgo nas/ rang bzhin gyi sbyor ba lnga dang*/ gnas skabs kyi sbyor ba bco lnga/ gsum pa ni (241) tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar du'o// gnyis pa la/ bsdu ba spyir bstan pa dang*/ dka' ba'i gnas so sor bshad pa'o// dang po la lo chen na re/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gcig po bsdu na/ sbyor ba'i mtshan gzhi/ mtshan nyid/ thob pa'i dus/ bsgom pa'i nus pa grub pa dang bzhir 'dus/ dang po la/ bsgom bya rnam pa/ rten gyi gang zag sbyor ba'i dbye ba/ sbyor ba'i skyon/ sbyor ba'i yon tan dang lnga/ gsum pa la/ thos bsam la 'jug pa'i dus dang*/ yongs su smin pa'i dus gnyis/ dang po/ thar pa cha mthun/ gnyis pa nges 'byed cha mthun no// bzhi pa la/ rten gyi gang zag dang*/ de'i rgyud la yod pa'i sbyor ba'i dbye ba gnyis yod gsung ngo*// rang lugs/ sbyor ba la 'jug tshul gtan la 'bebs pa'i gnas skabs kyi sgom rim dang*/

sbyor ba rgyud la skyes pa'i gnas skabs kyi sgom rim gnyis su 'dus/ 'di dag la (242) bshad pa'i rim pa gzhung dang sbyar ba dang*/ nyams su len tshul bsdus te bstan pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyis gtan la phab pa'i don sbyor bas nyams su len na/ tshul ji ltar du nyams su len/ nyams su len pa'i rten gyi gang zag ni gang*/ nyams len gyi sbyor ba la dbye na du/ nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu yon tan ji lta bu snyam na/ spyir bsgom bya rnams la/ nang tshan gyi sgo nas dbye na/ brgya bdun bcu rtsa gsum du yod cing*/ yul can mkhyen gsum dang*/ yul skye med gsum zung 'jug tu nyams su len tshul 'chad pa ni/ gzhi shes pa yi bye brag rnams// zhes sogs bstan bshad kyi gzhung rnams so// nyams su len pa po'i rten gyi gang zag de yang yongs 'dzin rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun cing mnyes par byas pa/ mkhyen gsum gyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i gang zag khyad par can gcig gis nyams su len dgos zhes bstan pa ni/ sangs rgyas rnams (243) la lhag par byas// zhes sogs so// nyams len gyi sbyor ba de la rgyas par phye na nyi shu/ bsdu na/ rang bzhin gyi sbyor ba lnga/ de yang bsdu na mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba gsum du 'dus/ zhes nyams len sbyor ba'i dbye ba 'chad pa ni/ gzugs la sogs la mi gnas phyir// zhes sogs so// theg chen gyi sbyor bas rnam pa brgya bdun bcu rtsa gsum nyams su len pa la brten nas/ bdud kyi mthu bcom pa sogs yon tan bcu bzhi thob par 'gyur ro// zhes sbyor ba'i 'bras bu 'chad pa ni/ bdud kyi mthu bcom la sogs pa// zhes sogs so// sa bdun pa man chad du theg chen gyi sbyor ba nyams su len pa la bar du gcod pa'i skyon bzhi bcu rtsa drug 'byung bas/ de dag shes nas spong dgos so zhes 'chad pa ni/ skyon ni bcu tshan bzhir bcas pa// zhes sogs so// nyams su blang bya'i rnam pa/

nyams su len pa po'i rten gyi gang zag nyams len sbyor ba'i dbye ba/ nyams su (244) blangs ba'i 'bras bu yon tan de lta bu dang ldan pa'i theg chen sbyor ba'i ngo bo ji lta bu snyam na/ thabs shes khyad par can gnyis dang ldan pa'i nyams su len gcig la 'jog ces 'chad pa ni/ gang gis mtshon de mtshan nyid du// zhes sogs bstan bshad rnams so// theg chen gyi sbyor ba rang rgyud la skyes pa'i ma mtha'i sa mtshams gang nas bzung snyam na/ theg chen gyi thar pa cha mthun nas thob pa yin no// zhes thar pa cha mthun gyi ngo bo 'chad pa ni/ mtshan med rab tu sbyin la sogs// zhes sogs so// thar pa cha mthun rang rgyud la goms par byas pa las bsam sbyor phun sum tshogs pa bcu dgu'i sgo nas rgyud yongs su smin par byas pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun gyi dmigs pa dang rnam par 'chad pa ni/ dro ba rnams kyi dmigs pa 'dir// zhes sogs so// de ltar nges 'byed cha mthun rang rgyud la thob pa la brten nas/ sbyor lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags nyi shu/ mthong lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags bcu drug

(245) bsgom lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags zab mo brgyad kyi yon tan thob par 'gyur ro// zhes rten phyir mi ldog pa'i gang zag 'chad pa ni/ nges 'byed yan lag nas bzung ste// zhes bstan bshad kyi gzhung rnams so// rten gyi gang zag des rang don chos sku thob phyir du/ srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba/ gzhan don gzugs sku thob phyir du zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba/ 'phrin las phun tshogs thob phyir du thabs la mkhas pa'i sbyor ba bsgom dgos so zhes 'chad pa ni/ chos rnams rmi lam 'dra ba'i phyir// zhes dang*/ sems can 'jig rten de bzhin du// zhes dang*/ yul dang sbyor ba can 'di ni// zhes sogs rtsa 'grel rnams so// gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par byas// zhes pa'i skabs nas bstan pa'i rten gyi gang zag des rnam pa brgya bdun bcu rtsa gsum thabs shes khyad par can gnyis dang ldan pa'i sbyor ba nyi shus skyon bzhi bcu rtsa drug dang bral ba'i tshul gyis nyams su blangs pas/ thar pa (246) cha mthun gyi rtogs pa gong nas gong du 'phel te/ bdud kyi mthu bcom pa la sogs pa'i yon tan bcu bzhi mngon du byed pa ni/ sbyor ba la 'jug tshul gtan la 'bebs pa'i nyams len gyi rim pa'o// thar pa cha mthun rang rgyud la skyes pa'i gang zag gi nges 'byed cha mthun gyi rtogs pa rang rgyud la skyed/ sbyor mthong bsgom gsum gyi yon tan rnams gong nas gong du 'phel bar byas te/ sbyor ba gsum nyams su blangs pa la brten nas/ srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba'i 'bras bu chos sku/ zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba'i 'bras bu gzugs sku/ thabs la mkhas pa'i sbyor ba'i 'bras bu 'phrin las phun sum tshogs pa mngon du byas te/ sems can gyi don ma lus pa sgrub pa ni/ sbyor ba rgyud la skyes pa'i bsgom rim gyi nyams len no// gnyis pa ni/ rje btsun byams pa mgon po chos can/

mkhyen gsum gyi 'og tu rnam rdzogs sbyor ba 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyis gtan la phab (247) pa'i don/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i sgo nas nyams su len tshul shes pa'i ched yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ gnyis las/ dang po sbyor ba la 'jug tshul gtan la 'bebs pa'i gnas skabs kyi bsgom rim la/ bsgom bya rnam pa/ bsgom pa po'i gang zag yul can sbyor ba sbyor ba'i sngon 'gro'i chos/ nye rgyu thar pa cha mthu dang lnga/ dang po la bstan bshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzhi shes pa'i bye brag rnams// zhes skabs su gnyis kyi dang po la/ bsgom bya rnam pa la/ mtshan gzhi/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sgom tshul/ mdo bstan bcos las bshad tshul lo// dang po la/ dgag bzhag spang gsum mo// dang po ni/ 'dre ar na re/ bsgom bya rnam pa la don rnam dang*/ shes rnam gnyis su yod kyang*/ don rnam bsgom bya'i gtso bo dang*/ shes rnam bsgom bya'i gtso bo ma yin te/ don rnam bsgoms pas shes rnam bsgom par gyur zhing*/ shes rnam bsgom pas (248) don rnam bsgom par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ don rnam yod na shes rnam yod dgos/ shes rnam yod na don rnam yod mi dgos pa'i phyir/ dper na/ zla ba gnyis snang gi dbang shes yod kyang*/ zla gnyis med pa bzhin no// zer/ snying po'i don yid la byed pa'i bsgom rim de bsgom rim gyi gtso bo yin pa dang*/ mngon par rtogs pa'i don yid la byed pa'i bsgom rim de bsgom rim gyi gtso bo ma yin pa'i khyad par 'thad par thal/ khas len rtags/ 'dod na/ rtsa ba shes rab du/ bsgom nyams len gyi rim par gtso bor bstan pa dang*/ rgyan 'dir/ de gtso bor ma bstan pa'i khyad par 'thad par thal lo// mkhas pa red mda' ba na re/ bsgom bya rnam pa yin na/ shes rnam yin dgos te/ don rnam bsgom bya'i rnam pa ma yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i tha snyad mdo bstan bcos las ma bshad pa'i phyir dang*/

rnam pa bsgom pa'i dgos pa ni/ bsgom bya'i rnam pa phul du phyin par bya ba'i ched yin la/ don rnams la phul du (249) phyin pa byar med pa'i phyir/ sems can thams cad 'bad med du grol bar thal/ de la gnyen po sgom bya rnam pa rang chas su yod pa'i phyir te/ chos nyid sgom bya yin pa'i phyir/ zer/ theg chen gyi sgom lam de/ theg dman gyi sgom lam las yul rtogs tshul gyi sgo nas zab pa ma yin par thal/ de stong nyid rtog zin bsgom par byed pa'i lam ma yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ byang sems tshogs lam pas/ lam bsgoms pa la brten nas rang rgyud kyi bdag 'dzin la mi gnod par thal/ des bdag med mi sgom pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ bzhi brgya pa las/ yul la bdag med mthong nas ni// srid pa'i sa bon ldog par 'gyur// zhes so// sgrub byed de yang mi 'thad de/ don rnam gyi tha snyad mdo dang*/ bstan bcos gnyis ka las bshad pa'i phyir/ dang po yin te/ chos thams cad kyi ngo bo la rnam pa'i sgras gsungs pa'i phyir te/ rab 'byor rnam pa gang dag dang*// zhes sogs (250) gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa yin te/ gzugs kyi ngo bo dang*/ sman gyi ngo bo la rnam pa'i sgras gsungs pa'i phyir te/ rgyud blar/ gzugs kyi rnam pa dman pa dang*// bar ma mchog la nam mkha' bzhin// zhes dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ sman gyi rnam pa gang dag yod pa dang*// zhes so// kha cig shes rnam bsgom bya'i rnam pa ma yin te/ de slob pa'i gnas skabs su rnam pa sgom byed kyi blo dang*/ mi slob pa'i gnas skabs su rnam pa bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir/ zer/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum sgom par byed pas/ zhes pa'i bstan don tshad mas ma grub par thal/ mkhyen gsum sgom bya'i rnam pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ mngon par rtogs pa'i don yid la byed pa'i sgom rim gzhi ma grub par thal lo// rang lugs/ don rnams dang shes rnam gnyis ka sgom bya'i rnam pa yin te/

byang chub sems dpas chos thams cad thos bsam gyi sgo nas shes par bya ste/ bden med du nyams su len dgos pa'i phyir te/ spyod 'jug (251) las/ rgyal sras rnams kyis mi slob pa'i// dngos de gang yang yod ma yin// zhes so// gsum pa la/ gang zag gi bdag 'dzin chos can/ nyams su blang byar thal/ sgom bya rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ khyab ste/ sgom dang nyams len don gcig pa'i phyir/ yang de chos can/ byang chub sems dpa'i sgom byar thal/ sgom bya rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ shes bya yin na byang sems kyi shes bya yin dgos pa'i phyir/ zer/ dang po la/ sa gnyis pa'i rnam grol lam chos can/ sgrub pa sgom lam du thal/ nyams len bsgom lam yin pa'i phyir te/ sgrub pa dang nyams len don gcig pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ nyams len yin na/ byang sems kyi nyams len yin dgos par thal/ shes bya yin na/ de'i shes bya yin dgos pa'i phyir/ khyab pa rnams khas/ gnyis pa la/ kha cig byang chub sems dpas nyams su (252) dpe bden med du/ rang bsgom byed kyi blos nyams su blang bar bya ba zer/ dang po la/ shes sgrib rtog pa chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ shes rnam yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ byang sems lam gyi spang bya'i gtso bo ma yin par thal lo// gnyis pa la/ gang zag gi bdag gis ma nges/ gsum pa la yang*/ gang zag gi bdag chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ bdag bsgom pa'i phyi rol pa'i blos bsgom par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ rang lugs/ byang chub sems dpas bden med du bsgom par bya ba'i chos/ dbye na/ don rnam dang shes rnam gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ bsgom bya rnam pa gang zhig shes rnam kyi rtogs byar gyur pa'i yul/ mtshan gzhi chos thams cad do// dbye na/ gzhi shes/ lam shes/ rnam mkhyen gyi don rnam mo// gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ bsgom bya rnam pa gang zhig rang yul du gyur pa'i don rnam 'dzin byed kyi rig pa/

mtshan (253) gzhi shes pa thams cad do// dbye na mi mthun phyogs kyi dang*/ gnyen po phyogs kyi shes rnam gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ shes rnam gang zhig rnam grol don gnyer gyi gang zag gis/ mtha' gcig tu dor bar bya ba/ mtshan gzhi gang zag gi bdag 'dzin dang*/ chos kyi bdag 'dzin lta bu/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig rnam grol don gnyer gyi gang zag gi rgyud la brten par bya ba/ mtshan gzhi/ thar lam mtha' dag go /dbye na/ gzhi shes/ lam shes/ rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam dang gsum/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ bden bzhi'i gnas tshul gang zag gi bdag med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes/ dbye na/ bden pa dang po gsum gyi rnam pa bcu gnyis/ lam bden gyi rnam pa bco lnga ste/ nyer bdun no// gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ bden bzhi'i gnas tshul chos kyi bdag med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg (254) chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa/ dbye na/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i rnam pa lnga/ kun 'byung bden pa'i rnam pa brgyad/ 'gog bden gyi rnam pa bcu drug lam bden gyi rnam pa bdun dang sum cu rtsa drug gsum pa 'og tu 'chad/ don rnam dang shes rnam 'gal ba ma yin te/ shes rnam don rnam gyi bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ gal te/ phyi rol gyi don dang shes pa mi 'gal bar thal/ de gnyis mi 'gal ba'i phyir/ zhe na de gnyis mi 'gal bar thal/ yul dang yul can mi 'gal ba'i phyir dang*/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa mi 'gal ba'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ lam la de ni bco lngar bshad// ces pa'i skabs nas dngos bstan gyi lam bden gyi rnam pa bco lnga chos can/ gzhi shes kyi don rnam ma yin par thal/ de'i shes rnam yin pa'i phyir te/ gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gzhi shes kyi don rnam la rnam pa nyer bdun med par thal lo// bzhi pa la/ spyir (255) bstan pa/ so sor bshad pa/ rtsod pa spang ba dang gsum/ dang po la/ snying po'i don yid la byed pa'i bsgom rim dang*/

mngon par rtogs pa'i don yid la byed pa'i de gnyis/ dang po la/ chos thams cad bden med du gtan la phab nas bsam byung gi rigs pas tshul bzhin du bsam ste/ bsgom byung gi rnal 'byor gyis rtse gcig tu yid la byed pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ yul can mngon rtogs kyi rim pa dang*/ yul stong nyid zung 'jug gi tshul gyis nyams su len pa lta bu'o// 'di gnyis 'gal ba ma yin te/ blo gcig gis yul stong nyid dang*/ yul can mngon par rtogs pa gnyis dus mnyam lhan cig tu nyams su len par nus pa'i phyir/ bstan tshul mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yod de/ dang po rtsa ba shes rab tu gtso bor bstan/ gnyis pa rgyan 'dir gtso bor bstan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ ngo bo ji lta ba/ rjes su mthun pa/ mtshan nyid rjes su spyod pa/ smon lam gyi rnam (256) pas bsgom pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ bsgom bya'i chos de bsgom byed kyi blo'i ngor bskyed nas bsgom pa yin te/ tshogs lam du dran pa nyer bzhag bsgom pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ bsgom bya dang rjes su mthun pa'i dmigs pa dang rnam pa bsgom pa ste/ tshogs lam du sbyor lam gyi dmigs rnam yid la byed pa lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ thob bya'i chos gong ma rnams kyi mtshan nyid rjes su spyod pa ste/ tshogs lam du 'phags lam gyi rang spyi'i mtshan nyid yid la byed pa lta bu/ bzhi pa ni/ 'bras bu khyad par can thob 'dod kyi bsam pas yid la byed pa ste/ tshogs lam du rnam mkhyen bsgom pa lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ gal te/ tshogs lam du rnam mkhyen bsgom pa mi 'thad par thal/ de na de med pa'i phyir/ zhe na skyon med de/ ngo bo ji lta ba bzhin bsgom pa med kyang*/ mtshan nyid rjes su spyod pa dang*/ smon lam gyi rnam pas bsgom pa yod pa'i phyir/ lnga pa la/ mkhas pa 'dre (257) ar na re/ gzhi shes pa yi bye brag rnams// zhes sogs mdor bstan gyi skabs su/ shes rnam dngos su bstan/

don rnam shugs la bstan/ rgyas bshad du de las bzlog te bstan gsung ngo*// gzhi shes kyi rnam pa nyer bdun shes rnam ma yin pa dang*/ gzhi shes kyi rnam pa shes rnam yin pa'i khyad par 'thad par thal/ kun mkhyen nyid ni rnam gsum phyir// zhes skabs su shes rnams dngos su bstan/ med pa'i rnam pa nas bzung ste// zhes skabs su shes rnam dngos su ma bstan pa'i phyir/ de gnyis dngos kyi mdor bstan rgyas bshad ma yin par thal/ de gnyis dngos kyi bstan don mi mthun pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du lam shes dang*/ rnam mkhyen la yang sbyar/ gzhi shes pa yi bye brag rnams// zhes skabs su/ mkhyen gsum gyi rtogs byar gyur pa'i yul dngos su ma bstan par thal/ der don rnams dngos su ma bstan pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ der mkhyen gsum yang dngos su ma bstan par thal lo// bla ma mkhyen rab (258) dbang phyug na re/ 'dir bstan gyi mdo bstan bcos gnyis ka las/ don rnam dang shes rnam gnyis ka dngos su bstan te/ mdo las/ yum 'di ni ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o// zhes pas shes rnam dngos su bstan/ bka' stsal pa nam mkha' dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro// zhes pas don rnam dngos su bstan/ bstan bcos las/ gzhi yi bye brag rnams/ rnam pa zhes bya mtshan nyid de// bden pa bzhi yi bye brag gis// de ni rnam pa bzhi ru 'dod// ces pas/ don rnam dngos su bstan/ shes pa'i bye brag rnams// rnam pa zhes bya mtshan nyid de// kun mkhyen nyid ni rnam gsum phyir// de ni rnam pa gsum du 'dod// ces pas shes rnam dngos su bstan// zhes gsung ngo*// ṭī kas/ mdo dang*/ bstan bcos kyi mdor bstan rgyas bshad gnyis ka'i dngos bstan gyi rnam pa la shes rnam gyis khyab ste/ mdo bstan du/ rtsa bar/ ye shes kyi bye brag tu gsungs pa dang*/ (259) 'grel par/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gnyen por gsungs pa dang*/

rgyas bshad kyis kyang de nyid rgyas par 'chad dgos pa'i phyir/ kho na re/ sdug bsngal gyi bden pa rtag par med pa chos can/ shes rnam du thal/ med pa'i rnam pa nas bzung ste// zhes pa'i skabs nas dngos bstan gyi rnam pa yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i skabs su tshig zin la dngos su bstan pa dang*/ bsgom bya rnam pa'i gzhi mthun yin pa'i phyir/ 'gog bden chos can/ shes rnam du thal/ 'gog pa la ni go rim bzhin// zhes pa'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i rnam pa yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i skabs su tshig zin la dngos su bstan pa'i sgom bya rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ chos rnams kyi gnas lugs de bzhin nyid chos can/ shes rnam du thal/ sum cu rtsa dgu dag tu bzhed// ces skabs su dngos bstan gyi rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bshad pa'i de (260) bzhin nyid dang*/ zhes pa'i skabs nas dngos bstan gyi rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ dang po la/ gzung ba phyi rol gyi don rmi lam ltar ngo bo nyid med pa de/ gnyis pa la rmi lam dang zhes sogs kyi skabs nas dngos bstan gyi rnam par thal/ khas len rtags/ 'dod na/ shes sgrib gzung rtog gi gnyen por thal/ 'dod pa de'i phyir/ khyab ste/ spyir shes bya'i sgrib pa'i gnyen por gyur pa dag yin no// zhes pa de gzhung snga ma rnams kyi gsal byed yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod chos can/ mthong lam rtse sbyor du thal/ skad cig gcig pa'i bzod pa yis// bsdus pa de 'dir mthong ba'i lam// zhes pa'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i mthong lam yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i skabs su tshig zin la dngos su bstan pa'i mthong lam yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ de bzhin nyid chos can/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi rnam pa ni shin tu phul du byung ba'i phyir

(261) zhes sogs kyi skabs nas dngos bstan gyi rnam par thal/ khas len rtags/ 'dod na/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam par thal lo// bsdu na/ 'dir tshig zin la bstan pa'i rnam pa la yul can mkhyen pa gsum dang*/ de'i yul bden bzhi gnyis su yod cing*/ dang po dngos bstan gyi bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i shes rnam/ gnyis pa 'dir zhar byung gi tshul du bstan pa'i don rnam yin no// gnyis pa la/ gzhi shes/ lam shes/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ lam bden gyi rnam pa bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ med pa'i rnam pa nas bzung ste// zhes sogs kyis bstan no// gnyis pa ni/ theg pa chen po'i mthong lam chos can/ gnyen po phyogs kyi shes rnam yin te/ bden bzhi'i gnas lugs mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas spang bya mi mthun phyogs kyi gnyen po byed pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir (262) bstan gyi shes rnam chos can/ gsum du yod de/ gzhi shes/ lam shes/ rnam mkhyen gyi de rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa'i gnyen po nyid du/ zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po la/ dbye gzhi lam bden/ dbye ngo lam gsum/ zag bcas zag med kyi don/ spang bya sgrib pa gnyis bshad pa'o// dang po la/ kha cig 'dir bstan gyi dbye gzhi lam bden de/ theg dman gyi lam bden kho na yin te/ dbye ngo lam gsum po de theg dman gyi lam yin pa'i phyir/ zer/ lam la de ni bco lnga bshad// ces skabs kyi lam bden de theg dman gyi lam bden kho nar thal/ khas len rtags/ 'dod na/ kun mkhyen nyid ni rnam gsum phyir// zhes skabs kyi gzhi shes de theg dman gyi de kho nar thal ba dang*/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i sgom byar gyur pa'i de theg dman gyi de kho nar thal lo// rang lugs/ theg pa che chung so sor ma phye ba'i

(263) lam bden tsam mo// gnyis pa la/ 'dir bstan nyon sgrib kyi gnyen por gyur pa'i lam zag med/ shes sgrib gzung rtog gi der gyur pa'i lam zag bcas/ shes sgrib gzung rtog gi der gyur pa'i lam zag med dang gsum/ kha cig lam dang po nyan thos kyi mthong lam/ gnyis pa rang rgyal gyi sgom lam rjes thob ye shes/ gsum pa rang rgyal gyi sgom lam mnyam bzhag ye shes kho na la 'jog zer/ nyan thos sgom lam pa'i rgyud la/ nyon sgrib kyi sa bon dngos su spong bar byed pa'i bar chad med lam med par thal/ de'i rgyud la 'dir bstan nyon sgrib kyi gnyen por gyur pa'i lam zag med med pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ gnyis pa la/ byang sems kyi rgyud la 'dir bstan gyi lam zag bcas med par thal/ khas len rtags/ 'dod na/ de la thams cad shes pa nyid kyi rnam pa ni/ nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa'i bye brag gis/ go rim bzhin du zag pa med pa dang*/ zag pa dang bcas pa (264) dag kyang yin no// zhes pa'i gzhung de 'di'i dngos kyi don bsdu 'chad byed ma yin par 'gyur ro// gsum pa la/ rang rgyal mthong lam pa'i rgyud la shes sgrib gzung rtog gi sa bon dngos su spong ba'i bar chad med lam med par thal ba'i skyon gnas/ kha cig lam dang po nyan thos kyi bar chad med lam/ lam gsum pa rang rgyal gyi mthong lam yin te/ de ltar du 'grel chen gnyis las bshad pa'i phyir/ zer/ dang po la/ rang rgyal 'phags pa'i rgyud la nyon sgrib kyi sa bon dang*/ gnyis pa la/ rang rgyal sgom lam pa'i rgyud la shes sgrib gzung rtog gi sa bon dngos su spong ba'i bar chad med lam med par thal ba'i skyon gnas so// kha cig theg chen gyi mthong lam/ de'i sgom lam rjes thob/ de'i sgom lam mnyam bzhag gsum/ 'dir bstan gyi lam gsum du 'dod de/ rang byung bdag nyid rtogs pa'i phyir// zhes pa'i gzhung gis byang sems kyi lam bgrod tshul kho na bstan par thal/

(265) thams cad shes pa nyid kyis rang sangs rgyas rnams kyang bsdus pas/ zhes pa 'dis byang sems kyi lam kho na bstan pa'i phyir/ rang lugs/ lam dang po nyon sgrib spong ba'i nus pa dang ldan zhing*/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mnyam bzhag gis bsdus pa'i theg dman gyi rtogs rigs so// dbye na/ theg dman dang*/ theg chen gyi rgyud la yod pa gnyis/ lam gnyis pa shes sgrib gzung rtogs spong ba'i nus pa dang ldan zhing*/ bsgom lam rjes thob kyis bsdus pa'i rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs so// dbye na/ rang rgyal dang*/ byang sems kyi rgyud la yod pa gnyis/ lam gsum pa shes sgrib gzung rtog spong ba'i nus pa dang ldan zhing*/ gzung ba chos kyi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mnyam bzhag gis bsdus pa'i rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs so// dbye na/ rang rgyal dang*/ byang sems kyi rgyud la yod pa gnyis/ des na 'dir bstan gyi lam gsum la theg pa che chung gi (266) rgyud la yod pa gnyis gnyis su 'thad de/ don bsdu'i skabs su de ltar bshad pa'i phyir/ gal te/ 'dir rang sangs rgyas rnams kyang zhes smros pa mi 'thad par thal/ 'dir dngos bstan gyi lam la byang sems kyi lam yod pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ rten gyi bse ru lta bu'i lam// zhes smros pa mi 'thad par thal/ de'i skabs nas dngos bstan gyi lam la byang sems kyi lam yod pa'i phyir/ de rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes 'chad byed yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ kha cig 'dir bstan zag bcas zag med ni/ sgra don 'dres 'dzin gyi rtog pa dang bcas ma bcas la byed/ kha cig nyon mongs pa dang bcas ma bcas la byed zer/ dang po la/ rang rgyal gyi bsgom lam rjes thob ye shes chos can/ rnal 'byor mngon sum ma yin par thal/ sgra don 'dres 'dzin gyi rtog bcas yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ nyon mongs pa dang bcas ma bcas kyi don (267)

nyon mongs pa spangs ma spangs la byed dam yin min la byed/ dang po ltar na/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam bar chad med lam chos can/ nyon mongs pa spang bar thal/ 'dir bstan gyi lam zag med yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ltar na/ rang rgyal gyi bsgom lam rjes thob ye shes chos can/ nyon mongs pa yin par thal/ 'dir bstan gyi lam zag bcas yin pa'i phyir/ rang lugs/ 'dir bstan gyi lam thog mtha' gnyis la lam zag med zhes bya ste/ mnyam bzhag gi bsdus pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ rnam grangs kyi sgo nas zag bcas zhes bya ste/ rjes thob kyis bsdus pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa/ spang gnyen skye 'gag gis rgyas par bshad pas der blta bar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ rgyu dang las dang sdug bsngal dang*// zhes sogs kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ 'dir bstan gzhi shes kyis bsdus pa'i lam bden chos can/ khyod la dbye na (268) gsum du yod de/ khyod la dbye na nyon sgrib kyi gnyen por gyur pa'i lam zag med gcig dang*/ shes sgrib gzung rtog gi gnyen por gyur pa'i lam zag bcas gcig dang*/ de'i gnyen por gyur pa'i lam zag med gcig rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ rtsa ba dang*/ 'grel pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ dran pa nyer bzhag nas bzung ste// zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ gzhung gi bstan tshul lo// dang po ni/ bden bzhi'i gnas lugs mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i ye shes/ gal te chos nyid chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ de'i don rnam yin pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ de chos can/ thun mong pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam par thal/ de'i don rnam yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam par thal/ de'i don rnam yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na (269) 'gal lo// gnyis pa la/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa gnyis/

mtshan nyid la kha cig rang gi rigs 'dra theg dman gyi rgyud la yod pa dang*/ med pa'i mthar thug gi ye shes/ zer/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i thugs rgyud kyi theg chen sems bskyed chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ rang gi rigs 'dra byang 'phags kyi rgyud la yod pa'i mthar thug gi ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la yang de chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ khyod kyi rigs 'dra theg dman gyi rgyud la yod par thal lo// kha cig rang gi rigs 'dra slob pa 'phags pa'i rgyud la yod pa dang*/ med pa'i mthar thug gi ye shes/ zer/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi mi slob lam chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin te/ thun mong ba'i yin pa'i phyir te/ (270) rang gi rigs 'dra theg dman 'phags pa'i rgyud la yod pa'i mthar thug gi ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yang des khegs/ rang lugs/ rang gi rigs 'dra theg dman dang byang 'phags gang rung gi rgyud la yod pa'i mthar thug gi ye shes/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ rgyu lam shes dang rjes su mthun pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa dang*/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes dang rjes su mthun pa'i de gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rang gi rigs 'dra byang 'phags kyi rgyud la yod pa'i mthar thug gi ye shes/ dbye na/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i gnyen po'i lam gsum/ sprul pa'i lam gsum/ mthong chos la bder gnas kyi lnga/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam dgu/ spong lam gyi ming gis btags pa'i bden bzhi'i yul can gyi lam bzhi/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi lam bcu ste/ sum cu rtsa bzhi/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang gi rigs 'dra theg dman gyi rgyud la yod pa'i mthar thug gi ye shes/ dbye na/ byang (271) phyogs so bdun/ 'di gnyis 'gal ba ma yin te/ sangs rgyas sa'i dran pa nyer bzhag de de gnyis ka yin pa'i phyir/

yin khyab mnyam ma yin te/ sangs rgyas sa'i theg chen sems bskyed de dang po yin kyang gnyis pa ma yin/ sangs rgyas sa'i mi slob lam de gnyis pa yin kyang dang po ma yin pa'i phyir/ rang gi rigs 'dra theg dman dang byang sems gang rung gi rgyud la med pa'i mthar thug gi ye shes/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ stobs bcu mi 'jigs pa bzhi/ so so yang dag rig pa bzhi/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad/ de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa/ rang byung gi rnam pa/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi rnam pa dang po dgu/ gal te so so yang dag rigs pa bzhi thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen ma yin par thal/ de'i rigs 'dra byang sems kyi rgyud la yod pa'i phyir te/ so so yang dag rigs blo bzang*// sa de legs pa'i blo gros yin// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// zhe na/ skyon med (272) de/ so so yang dag rig pa bzhi rjes mthun pa tsam la dgongs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ 'dir mthun yul 'phags pa 'og ma'i rgyud la yod pa'i dran pa nyer bzhag dang*/ mthun pa po sangs rgyas kyi rgyud la yod pa'i dran pa nyer bzhag gang dngos su bstan zhe na/ tshig zin tsam la gnyis ka bstan mtshungs yin kyang*/ sangs rgyas sa'i dran pa nyer bzhag la sogs pa sum cu rtsa bdun dang*/ gnyen po'i lam la sogs pa sum cu rtsa bzhi/ bstan bya'i gtso bor byas nas dngos su bstan/ 'phags pa 'og ma'i rgyud la yod pa de dag ni/ zhar byung gis tshul du bstan te/ 'dir rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa gtso bor 'chad pa'i skabs yin pa'i phyir/ 'grel pa rnams la yang de bzhin du shes par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa chos can/ khyod la dbye na brgya dang bcur yod de/ khyod la dbye na/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes dang rjes su mthun pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa sum (273) cu rtsa bdun/ rgyu lam shes dang rjes su mthun pa'i de sum cu rtsa bzhi/

thun mong ma yin pa'i de sum cu rtsa dgu rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ gzhi shes dang rjes su mthun pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa/ lam shes dang rjes su mthun pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa'o// dang po la/ dngos po la yongs su rtogs pa'i/ rtsol ba las byung ba'i/ ting nge 'dzin yongs su sbyong ba'i/ mngon par rtogs par sbyor ba'i/ mngon par rtog pa dang 'brel ba'i/ bden pa mngon rtogs kyi/ rnam dag de 'byin gyi lam dang*/ bdun/ dang po ni/ de la thams cad shes pa nyid la// zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ dran pa nyer bzhag la/ dmigs pa/ ngo bo/ grogs/ sgom tshul/ bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu dang lnga/ dang po ni/ lus tshor sems chos bzhi'o// lus ni gzugs can gyi dngos po rnams so// dbye na (274) phyi'i/ nang gi phyi nang gnyis ka'i lus so// tshor ba ni tshor ba'i tshogs lnga'o// sems ni rnam shes tshogs brgyad do// chos ni chags sogs kun nas nyon mongs pa dang*/ dad sogs rnam byang gi chos so// gnyis pa la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sgra bshad/ sa mtshams so// dang po la kha cig dmigs pa lus sogs la dmigs nas rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas btags te bsgom par byed pa'i dran pa shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa zhes dang*/ gzhan 'dra ba las/ bsgom zhes pa'i tshab tu dpyod ces dang*/ dmigs pa lus sogs gang rung la dmigs nas rnam pa rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas yongs su dpyod par byed pa'i dran pa shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ zer/ dang po la/ sangs rgyas sa'i dran pa nyer bzhag gis ma nges gnyis pa la/ gzugs med khams pa'i nyan thos 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi chos dran pa nyer bzhag chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ (275) 'dod na/ lus la dmigs par thal lo// gsum pa la/ lus rang gi mtshan nyid mi gtsang ba dang*/ spyi'i mtshan nyid bdag med par bsgom par byed pa'i lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag gi rgyud kyi shes rab chos can/

mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ rang lugs/ dmigs pa lus tshor sems chos bzhi po gang rung la dmigs nas rnam pa rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas btags te/ yongs su dpyod par byed pa'i lam zhugs skyes bu'i rgyud kyi dran pa shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na/ lus dran pa nyer bzhag la sogs pa bzhi/ de yang phyin ci log bzhi 'joms pa'i gnyen po rnam pa bzhi bzhag ste/ lus la bdag gi rten/ tshor ba la bdag gi longs spyod/ sems la bdag gi ngo bo/ chos la bdag gi khyad chos su sgro 'dogs pa'i phyin ci log bzhi 'joms par bshad pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ dran pa'i stobs (276) kyis shes rab nye bar 'jog pas na dran pa nyer bzhag ces bya'o// bzhi pa/ tshogs lam nas sangs rgyas sa'i bar du'o// gsum pa ni/ dran pa nyer bzhag gi gtso bo shes rab ste/ dran pa nyer bzhag shes rab ste// brtson 'grus yang dag 'jog ces bya// rdzu 'phrul rkang pa ting 'dzin to// gtso bo smros po de dag ni// sbyor byung yon tan kun kyang yin// zhes so// des na shes rab dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems sems byung rnams ni grogs so// bzhi pa la/ theg dman gyi sgom tshul/ theg chen gyi sgom tshul/ bsgom pa'i dgos pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ lus rang gi mtshan nyid mi gtsang ba/ tshor ba rang gi mtshan nyid sdug bsngal ba/ sems rang gi mtshan nyid mi rtag pa/ chos rang gi mtshan nyid kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba'i chos can/ spyi'i mtshan nyid rnam pa thams cad kyang gang zag gi bdag med par ro// gnyis pa ni/ lus snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma

(277) lta bu/ tshor ba snang yang snang ba ltar ma grub pa rmi lam lta bu/ sems rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba nam mkha' lta bu/ chags sogs dri ma'i chos glo bur ba sprin lta bu/ gnyen po rnam byang gi chos rang bzhin gyis med par shes te bsgom/ gsum pa ni/ bden bzhi rtogs pa la 'jug pa'i ched du'o// ji ltar 'jug na/ lus dran pa nyer bzhag bsgom pas sdug bsngal bden pa rtogs par 'gyur te/ gnas ngan len gyi lus sdug bsngal gsum gyi rang bzhin can du rtogs nus pa'i phyir/ tshor ba dran pa nyer bzhag bsgoms pas kun 'byung gi bden pa rtogs par 'gyur te/ kun 'byung gi gtso bo sred pa/ tshor ba gsum gyi rgyu can du rtogs nus pa'i phyir/ sems dran pa nyer bzhag bsgom pas 'gog pa'i bden pa la 'jug par 'gyur te/ sems skad cig gis 'jig pa'i bdag med par rtogs nas zhi ba myang 'das la don gnyer gyis 'jug pa'i phyir/ chos dran pa nyer bzhag bsgom (278) pas lam bden rtogs pas 'jug par 'gyur te/ kun byang gi chos rnams la ma rmongs pa'i lam mngon du byed pa'i phyir te/ dbus mtha' las/ gnas ngan len phyir sred rgyu'i phyir// gzhi'i phyir dang ma rmongs phyir// bden pa bzhi la 'jug bya bas// dran pa nyer bar bzhag par bsgom// zhes so// lnga pa ni/ lus la gtsang ba/ tshor ba la bde ba/ sems la rtag pa/ chos la bdag tu 'dzin pa'i phyin ci log bzhi spangs nas/ zag med kyi lus tshor sems chos bzhi thob par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa ni/ tshogs lam chung ngu la gnas pa'i byang sems kyi rgyud kyi dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi chos can/ dngos po la yongs su rtog pa'i lam yin te/ dmigs pa lus tshor sems chos bzhi po gang rung la dmigs nas/ rnam pa rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas btags te/ yongs su dpyod par byed pa'i dran pa shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa gang zhig tshogs lam chung ngus bsdus pa'i mngon rtogs

(279) yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ de'i 'og tu zhugs pa la// zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ yang dag spong ba la/ snga ma ltar lnga las/ dang po ni/ dge ba skyes ma skyes gnyis/ mi dge ba skyes ma skyes gnyis te bzhi'o// gnyis pa la bzhi las/ mtshan nyid ni/ dge sdig la blang dor tshul bzhin du byed nus kyi brtson 'grus mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa gang zhig theg pa rang lugs kyi tshogs lam 'bring po yan chad kyis bsdus pa/ dbye na/ dge ba skyes pa spel ba'i/ dge ba ma skyes pa bskyed pa'i/ mi dge ba skyes pa spong ba'i/ mi dge ba ma skyes pa mi skyed pa'i yang dag spong ba dang bzhi/ sa mtshams/ tshogs lam 'bring po nas sangs rgyas sa'i bar du'o// bzhi pa sgra bshad pa ni/ dge ba 'phel zhing mi dge ba yang dag par spong ba'i don gyis na yang dag spong ba zhes bya'o// gsum pa grogs ni/ brtson 'grus dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i (280) sems sems byung rnams so// bsgom tshul ni/ dge sdig la blang dor tshul bzhin du byed pa'i phyir du 'dun pa skyed/ 'bad/ brtson 'grus brtsom/ sems rab tu 'dzin/ sems rab tu 'jog pa'i tshul gyis so// 'di dag gi don ni/ dang por don gnyer gyi 'dun pa la brten nas 'bad par byed/ de'i ngo bo ni brtson 'grus so// brtson 'grus gang la rtsom na/ sems rab tu 'dzin pa'i lhag mthong dang*/ sems rab tu 'jog pa'i zhi gnas/ zung du 'jug pa'i tshul du'o// lnga pa 'bras bu ni/ mi mthun phyogs nyams pa dang*/ gnyen po 'phel ba ste/ spangs rtogs mthar thug thob pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/ tshogs lam 'bring po la gnas pa'i byang sems kyi rgyud kyi yang dag spong ba bzhi chos can/ rtsol ba las byung ba'i lam yin te/ dge sdig la blang dor tshul bzhin du byed pa'i brtson 'grus mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ gang zhig tshogs lam (281) 'bring pos bsdus pa'i mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/

gsum pa ni/ brtson 'grus dang ldan pa ni// zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ rdzu 'phrul rkang pa la/ sngar ltar lnga las/ spyan dang mngon shes la sogs pa'i yon tan khyad par can no// gnyis pa la bzhi las/ mtshan nyid ni/ nyes pa lnga'i gnyen por spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad bstan pa las byung ba'i sems gnas pa las rung du byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa gang zhig theg pa rang lugs kyi tshogs lam chen po yan chad kyis bsdus pa/ dbye na/ 'dun pa'i/ brtson 'grus kyi/ sems kyi/ spyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang bzhi/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ dbye gzhi gang zhig gus sbyor gyi brtson 'grus la brten nas/ rtags sbyor gyi brtson 'grus la brten nas/ skye ba snga mar ting nge 'dzin rgya chen po sngon du song (282) ba la brten nas/ tshe 'dir ting nge 'dzin la sbyor ba'i shes rab la brten nas/ sems gnas pa las rung du byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ gsum pa ni/ tshogs lam chen po nas sangs rgyas sa'i bar du'o// bzhi pa ni/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rgyu yin pas na rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa zhes bya'o// gsum pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i sems sems byung rnams so// bzhi pa ni/ nyes pa lnga'i gnyen por spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad dang ldan pa'i tshul du bsgom/ nyes pa lnga ni/ ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa la mi spro ba'i le lo/ de bsgom pa'i gdams ngag brjed pa bying rgod/ nyes pa byung ba'i dus su/ gnyen po mngon du mi byed la/ ma byung ba'i dus su byed pa ste/ dbus mthar/ le lo dang ni gdams ngag rnams// brjed dang bying dang rgod pa dang*// 'du mi byed dang 'du byed de// 'di dag nyes pa lngar 'dod do// zhes so// spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad ni/ 'dun rtsol dad pa (283) shin tu sbyangs// dran shes sems pa btang snyoms so// zhes pa ltar ro// de yang*/

'dun pa/ rtsol ba/ dad pa/ shin sbyangs ni/ le lo'i gnyen po ste/ dad pa la brten nas don gnyer gyi 'dun pa/ de la brten nas le lo dngos su spong ba'i rtsol ba/ de la brten nas shin sbyangs kyi bde ba thob pa'i phyir/ dran pa/ shes bzhin/ sems pa/ btang snyoms bzhi ni/ gdams ngag brjed pa la sogs pa'i gnyen po yin te/ rim bzhin/ de de'i 'joms byed yin pa'i phyir/ lnga pa ni/ spyan mngon shes/ dbang bcu la sogs pa'i yon tan khyad par can thob ste/ rgyan las/ gnas pas rnam par brtse ba dang*// smon lam dang ni dbang dag dang*// chos thob pa ni sgrub pa'i phyir// zhes so// gnyis pa ni tshogs lam chen po la gnas pa'i byang sems kyi rgyud kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi chos can/ ting nge 'dzin yongs su sbyong ba'i lam yin te/ nyes pa lnga'i (284) gnyen por spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad bstan pa las byung ba'i sems gnas pa las rung du byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa gang zhig tshogs lam chen pos bsdus pa'i mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ sems yongs su sbyang bar byas pa la/ zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ rnam byang gi dbang po lnga las/ dang po spyi'i dmigs pa ni/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi/ so so'i de ni/ bla na med pa'i byang chub dad pa'i/ pha rol tu phyin pa brtson 'grus kyi/ theg chen gyi sde snod thos pa dran pa'i/ zhi gnas ting nge 'dzin gyi/ lhag mthong shes rab kyi dmigs pa yin te/ rgyan las/ byang chub spyod dang thos mchog dang*// zhi gnas lhag mthong dad sogs kyis// bzhi yin par ni shes bya ste// don grub byed pa'i skabs kyis so// zhes so// gnyis pa la bzhi las/ dang po'i mtshan nyid ni/ rnam byang khyad par can la dbang byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa gang (285) zhig theg pa rang lugs kyi drod yan chad kyi bsdus pa/ dbye na/
