theg chen gyi lam lnga lta bu'o// dang po dbu ma'i lta ba btags pa pa yin te/ yul la yul can gyi ming gis btags pa'i phyir/ phyi ma mtshan nyid pa yin no// gal te theg chen mthong lam pa'i don dam sems bskyed chos can/ lta bar thal/ dbu ma'i lta ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sems byung du thal/ de'i phyir/ ce na/ mos pa bsgom lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i yid kyi rnam shes chos can/ mos par thal/ mos pa bsgom lam yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sems byung du thal lo// khyab pa rnams khas/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ lam dbu ma bsgoms stobs kyis thob pa'i bla na med pa'i byang chub/ mtshan gzhi/ sangs rgyas kyi sku bzhi lta bu'o// gsum pa la/ bden 'dzin gyi log rtog (475) dgag pa'i phyir du thal 'gyur dang*/ bdag med rtogs pa'i rig shes rjes dpag bskyed pa'i phyir du gtan tshigs bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ dngos smra bas btags pa'i bden 'dzin gyi log rtog gi zhen yul sun 'byin pa'i dbu ma pa'i thal 'gyur bzhi ste/ gzhan la grags pa'i rjes dpag bskyed pa'i thal 'gyur/ rgyu mtshan mtshungs pa'i mgo snyoms kyi/ gzhan la 'gal ba brjod pa'i/ sgrub byed sgrub bya dang mtshungs par ma grub par brjod pa'i thal 'gyur ro// dang po ni/ dngos smra ba rang gi khas blangs rtags su bkod nas mi 'dod pa thal bar 'phen par byed pa'i thal 'gyur ro// dper na/ myu gu chos can/ skye ba rgyu rkyen la rag ma las par thal/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ mgo mtshungs kyi rigs pa'i sgo nas bden grub 'gog par byed pa'i thal 'gyur ro// dper na rna ba'i rnam par shes pa gzugs la (476) lta byed du thal/ mig gi rnam par shes pa gzugs la lta byed du rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu'o// gsum pa ni/ khas blangs nang 'gal gyi sgo nas bden grub 'gog par byed pa'i thal 'gyur ro// dper na dngos smra ba chos can/

sgrib pa gnyen po'i stobs kyis spong du mi rung bar thal/ de bden par grub pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu'o// bzhi pa ni/ dngos po rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i sgrub byed la skyon brjod pa'i thal 'gyur ro// dper na dngos smra bas/ gzugs kyi phung po rang bzhin gyi yod do// rnam shes kyi phung po rang bzhin gyis yod pa'i phyir/ ce na/ rnam shes kyi phung po rang bzhin gyis yod pa de gzugs phung rang bzhin gyis yod pa'i sgrub byed du mi 'thad par thal/ gzugs phung rang bzhin gyis grub pa 'gog byed kyi rigs pa des/ rnam shes kyi phung po rang bzhin gyis yod pa 'gog nus pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu/ rtsa sher las/ stong pa nyid kyis (477) rtsad byas tshe// gang zhig lan 'debs smra byed pa// de yi thams cad lan btab min// bsgrub par byed de mtshungs par 'gyur// zhes so// gnyis pa la/ ngo bo la spyod pa gcig du bral gyi gtan tshigs/ rgyu la spyod pa rdo rje gzegs ma'i gtan tshigs/ 'bras bu la spyod pa yod med skye 'gog gi gtan tshigs/ thams cad la spyod pa rten 'brel gyi gtan tshigs dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ gzugs sogs kyi snang ba chos can/ bden par med de/ bden pa'i gcig dang du ma gang rung du med pa'i phyir/ dper na/ gzugs brnyan bzhin no// dbu ma rgyan las/ bdag dang gzhan smra'i dngos 'di dag /yang dag du ni gcig pa dang*// du ma'i rang bzhin bral ba'i phyir// rang bzhin med de gzugs brnyan bzhin// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ gzugs sogs kyis snang ba chos can/ bden pa'i skye ba med de/ don dam pa bdag dang*/ gzhan dang*/ gnyis ka dang*/ (478) rgyu med las mi skye ba'i phyir/ rtsa sher las/ bdag las ma yin gzhan las min// gnyis las ma yin rgyu med min// dngos po gang dag gang na yang*// skye ba nam yang yod ma yin// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ gzugs sogs kyi snang ba chos can/

bden pa'i skye ba med de/ don dam par yod pa dang*/ med pa dang*/ gnyis ka dang*/ gnyis ka ma yin pa mi skye ba'i phyir/ stong nyid bdun cu pa las/ yod min de phyir stong pa yin// yod phyir yod pa skye min ste// med phyir med pa skye ma yin// chos mi mthun phyir yod med min// skye ba med pas gnas 'gag med// ces so// bzhi pa la/ med mtha' 'gog pa dang*/ yod mtha' 'gog pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzugs sogs kyi snang ba chos can/ tha snyad du med pa ma yin te/ rten 'brel yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ de chos can/ don dam yod pa ma yin te/ (479) rten 'brel yin pa'i phyir/ rab rtsal rnam gnon gyi zhus pa'i mdo las/ gang zhig rkyen las skyes pa de ma skyes// de la skye ba'i rang bzhin yod ma yin// rkyen la rag las gang de stong par bshad// gang gis stong nyid shes te bag yod yin// zhes dang*/ rtsa sher las/ rten cing 'brel 'byung ma gtogs pa'i// chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no// de phyir stong pa ma gtogs pa'i// chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no// zhes so// des na rnam grol don gnyer gyi gang zag rnams kyis bden 'dzin gyi log rtog bsal nas bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba la brtson pa cher skyed rigs te/ mthar thug thar pa thob pa 'di la rag las pa'i phyir/ bzhi brgya pa las/ yang dag mthong na gnas mchog la// cung zad mthong na bzang 'gro ste// de phyir nang bdag bsam pa la// mkhas pas rtag tu blo gros skyed// ces so// gnyis pa ni/ theg chen gyi (480) mthong lam chos can/ dbu ma'i lta ba yin te/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ mthong lam rtse sbyor gyi ngo bo dang*/ khyad par gyi lam gnyis/ dang po ni/ sbyin pa la sogs re rer ni// zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po mthong lam rtse sbyor la mtshan gzhi/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po la/

kha cig mthong lam rtse sbyor yin na/ mthong lam bar chad med lam yin dgos te/ de yin na mthong spangs rtogs pa'i sa bon gyi dngos gnyen yin dgos pa'i phyir te/ lus rnam bzhag tu/ rnam par rtog pa rnam bzhi yi// gnyen po rnam pa bzhi dang ni// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang de yin dgos te/ de yin na mthong lam bzod pa yin dgos pa'i phyir te/ skad cig gcig pa'i bzod pa yis// bsdus pa de 'dir mthong ba'i lam// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zer/ rtse sbyor la/ sbyor lam rtse sbyor (481) sogs bzhi ru grangs ma nges par thal/ theg chen gyi mthong lam rnam grol lam de rtse sbyor gang zhig de bzhi gang rung ma yin pa'i phyir/ rtags phyi ma khas/ dang po der thal/ de mkhyen gsum bsdus bsgom tshogs lam chen po las rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa'i phyir/ mthong spangs rtog pa'i gnyen po yin na/ de'i sa bon gyi dngos gnyen yin dgos par thal/ sgrub byed dang po de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ theg chen gyi mthong lam rnam grol lam chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir te/ de'i rten gnyen po yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ byang chub chen po yin na ye shes yin dgos par thal/ ye shes byang chub ces brjod de// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rang lugs/ theg chen gyi mthong lam dang mthong lam rtse sbyor don gcig mtshan nyid/ pha rol tu phyin pa re re yang phar phyin drug ldan du nyams (482) su len pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs/ dbye na/ bar chad med lam dang rnam grol lam gyis bsdus pa'i mthong lam rtse sbyor gnyis/ gnyis pa ni/ theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod chos can/ mthong lam rtse sbyor yin te/ sbyin sogs pha rol tu phyin pa re re yang*/ phar phyin drug ldan du nyams su len pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ de nas seng ge rnam bsgyings pa'i zhes skabs su/

rten 'brel gyi rnam bzhag skabs su bab kyang gzhan du bshad zin/ gsum pa bsgom lam rtse sbyor ni/ 'gog dang bcas pa'i snyoms 'jug dgur// zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po la/ bsgom lam rtse sbyor bshad pa dang*/ thod rgal bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la mtshan gzhi/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po sngar las dpag ste shes/ gnyis pa ni/ mkhyen gsum bsdus bsgoms rab tu gyur (483) pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ dbye na/ mnyam bzhag dang*/ rjes thob kyi bsdus pa'i bsgom lam rtse sbyor gnyis yod/ gnyis pa gzhan du bshad zin/ gnyis pa ni/ sa gnyis pa'i bar chad med lam chos can/ bsgom lam rtse sbyor yin te/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs zin bsgoms par byed pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor ni/ stong gsum skye bo nyan thos dang*// zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor la/ mtshan nyid/ dmigs rnam/ bsal bya log sgrub dang gsum/ dang po la/ kha cig rnam mkhyen gyi dngos rgyur gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ rang gi dngos 'bras rnam mkhyen skyed pa la chos gzhan gyis bar chod pa med pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor zer/ dang po la/ rnam mkhyen gyi bdag rkyen byas pa la brten nas byung ba'i rgyun mtha'i ye shes (484) chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ rnam mkhyen gyi 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ sa bcu pa'i ye shes chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir te/ rang 'bras rnam mkhyen skad cig dang po'i dngos rgyur gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa'i phyir/ rang lugs ni/ rang gi dngos 'bras rnam mkhyen skyed pa la chos gzhan gyis bar chod par mi nus pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug mtshan gzhi/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes lta bu'o// gnyis pa la/

bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor gyi dmigs pa/ de'i rnam pa/ de'i bdag rkyen dang gsum/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ des sgro 'dogs bcad par bya ba'i gzhir gyur pa'i chos/ mtshan gzhi/ bdag med kyi khyad par du byas pa'i chos thams cad do// gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ des yul rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi bye brag mtshan gzhi/ bar chad med (485) pa'i rtse sbyor gyis stong nyid rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs lta bu/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ de rang dbang du gtso bor skyed byed/ mtshan gzhi/ rgyun mtha'i snga logs kyi bden gnyis kyi dmigs rnam mi brjed pa'i dran pa lta bu'o// gal te/ rnam mkhyen bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor gyi dmigs par thal/ bdag med kyi khyad par du byas pa'i chos thams cad de'i dmigs pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor chos can/ de la mngon sum du dmigs par thal/ de la dmigs pa gang zhig rnal 'byor mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ ce na/ chos thams cad theg chen sgrub pa'i dmigs pa ma yin par thal/ de theg chen 'phags pa'i sgrub pa'i dmigs pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ rnam mkhyen de'i dmigs par thal/ 'dod na/ sngar bzhin bya ste 'khor gsum byed/ des na rnam mkhyen gyis dmigs pa'i tshul de la gsum ste/ rnam mkhyen don spyi'i tshul du dmigs pa/ dngos su (486) dmigs pa/ mngon sum du ji lta ba bzhin du dmigs pa'o// dang po ni/ theg chen tshogs sbyor ba'i lam gyis rnam mkhyen la dmigs pa lta bu'o// dper na/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mthong ma myong ba la/ zla ba'i kha dog dang dbyibs sogs bshad pa la brten nas zla ba'i don spyi snang ba lta bu'o// gnyis pa ni/ byang 'phags kyi mkhyen pas rnam mkhyen la dmigs pa lta bu'o// dper na/ chu nang du shar ba'i zla ba'i kha dog dang dbyibs sogs mig shes la snang ba lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi rnam mkhyen dmigs pa lta bu/

dper na/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi pa'i gang zag gis mig shes la nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor snang ba lta bu'o// gsum pa la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sel byed kyi lam dang gsum/ dang po ni/ bden gnyis gang rung rgyu mtshan du byas nas gcig shos sun 'byin par byed pa'i log rtog dang*/ log shes des kun nas bslangs ba'i thal dag (487) gang rung*/ dbye na/ bsal bya log rtog dang*/ bsal bya klan ka gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ bden gnyis gang rung rgyu mtshan du byas nas gcig shos sun 'byin par byed pa'i log shes/ mtshan gzhi/ kun rdzob tu chos thams cad yod pa dang*/ don dam par chos thams cad med pa gnyis 'gal bar 'dzin pa'i rtog pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ bden gnyis gang rung rgyu mtshan du byas nas gcig shos sun 'byin par byed pa'i thal dag dbye na/ dmigs pa 'thad dang de yi ni// zhes sogs kyi skabs nas bsal bya klan ka bcu drug bsdu na/ kun rdzob sgo can gyi bsal bya klan ka dang*/ don dam sgo can gyi bsal bya klan ka gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ bsal bya klan ka gang zhig kun rdzob kyi khas blangs gtso bor rtags su bkod pa/ dbye na/ kun rdzob kyi khas blangs rtags su bkod nas don dam sun 'byin pa dang*/ de de rtags su bkod nas kun rdzob sun 'byin pa'i

(488) bsal bya klan ka gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi chos rang bzhin gyis yod par thal/ rnam mkhyen gyi dmigs pa 'thad pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa ni/ 'dus byas rtag par 'dzin pa'i blo phyin ci log ste med par thal/ 'dus byas mi rtag pa nyid du rnam par bzhag pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig don dam gyi khas blangs rtags su bkod nas gcig shos sun 'byin pa byed pa'i thal dag mtshan gzhi/ rnam mkhyen gyi dmigs pa mi 'thad par thal/ 'dus byas dang*/ 'dus ma byas rang bzhin gyis med pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ kun rdzob tu chos thams cad yod pa dang*/ don dam par chos thams cad med par 'dzin pa'i bden gnyis rnam 'byed kyi shes rab dang*/ shes rab des kun nas bslangs pa'i rigs pa rnam dag gis sel bar byed de/ bden gnyis rnam 'byed kyi shes rab kyis (489) bsal bya log rtog sa bon dang bcas pa 'joms par bshad pa'i phyir te/ des kun nas bslangs pa'i rigs pas bsal bya klan ka yul dang bcas pa sel bar bshad pa'i phyir/ mdo las/ kun rdzob tu ni thams cad yod// dam pa'i don du yod ma yin// des na dngos po gcig nyid la// yod dang med pa ci ltar 'gal// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes chos can/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor yin te/ rang 'bras rnam mkhyen gyi dngos rgyur gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ legs par bshad pa lung rigs kyi rgya mtsho las rtse sbyor bshad pa'i skabs te lnga pa'o// // (490) gnyis pa brtan pa rgyu 'bras la/ brtan pa thob pa'i don du bsgom pa mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ brtan pa thob nas gcig char du bsgoms pa skad cig ma'i sbyor ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ sbyin pa shes rab bar dag dang*// zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba la/

mtshan gzhi/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ bsdu ba dang bzhi/ dang po la/ 'phags pa dang*/ slob dpon gyi lugs gnyis/ dang po ni/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam yang mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba yin te/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa rim bzhin du bsgom par byed pa'i sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsung ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ tshogs lam dang*/ drod skad cig dang po na mthar gyis sbyor med de/ mthar gyis sbyor yin na rang rgyu rtse sbyor las byung dgos pa'i phyir te/ 'dir bstan sbyor ba bzhi'i go rim ni rgyu 'bras don gyi go rim yin pa'i phyir/ rgyun mtha' (491) na mthar gyis sbyor med de/ der mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa rim can du bsgom pa med pa'i phyir te/ der mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa dus skad cig ma gcig la bsgom pa'i phyir te/ thub pa'i skad cig gcig pa yi// rtogs pa 'di ni shes par bya// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod skad cig gnyis pa nas/ rgyun mtha'i snga logs kyi mkhyen pa rnams ni de'i mtshan gzhi'o// de yang mdo las mthar gyis pa'i bya ba/ de'i bslab pa/ de'i sgrub pa gsum bshad cing*/ dang po ni sbyor lam/ gnyis pa mthong lam/ gsum pa bsgom lam gyis bsdus pa yin no// gnyis pa la kha cig mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa rim can du bsgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor gang zhig drod skad cig gnyis pa'i rtog pa thob pa dang*/ rang rgyu rtse sbyor las byung zhing mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa rim can du bsgom par byed pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ (492) mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa rim can du bsgom pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam skad cig gnyis pa yan chad kyi sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ zer/ dang po la/ dgra bcom gyi rtogs pa sngon du song ba'i theg chen gyi tshogs lam chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ 'dod na theg chen gyi sbyor lam thob par thal lo// gnyis pa la/

rnam mkhyen gyis bdag rkyen byas pa la brten nas byung ba'i theg chen gyi tshogs lam chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir te/ rang rgyu rnam mkhyen las byung zhing mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa rim can du bsgom par byed pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes yin na/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam gyi rtogs pa sngon song yin pas ma khyab par thal/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes de khyod yan chad kyi sems dpa'i rnal 'byor du thal/ khyod theg chen gyi sbyor lam yin pa'i phyir/ (493) zhes pa'i thal 'gyur la khyab pa med pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa rim can du bsgom pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod skad cig gnyis pa chos can rgyun mtha'i ye shes de/ khyod yan chod kyi sems dpa'i rnal 'byor du thal/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam yin pa'i phyir/ rang lugs ni/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa rim can du bsgoms pa dang*/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod skad cig gnyis pa'i rtogs pa thob pa'i gzhi mthun du gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ gsum pa la/ phar phyin drug rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba drug sangs rgyas/ chos/ dge 'dun/ tshul khrims/ gtong ba/ lha rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba drug dngos med ngo bo nyid du rtogs pa'i mthar gyis sbyor dang bcu gsum/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ mthar gyis sbyor gang zhig sbyin pa'i (494) phar phyin gyi yon tan don dam par dran pa med cing*/ kun rdzob tu rjes su dran nas rim can du sgom par byed pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ des phyi ma lnga la yang rigs bsgre/ mthar gyis sbyor gang zhig sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi yon tan don dam par rjes su dran pa med cing*/ kun rdzob tu rjes su dran nas rim can du sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/

sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ des phyi ma lnga la yang rigs bsgre/ de gang zhig chos thams cad bden pa'i dngos po med par rtogs nas rim can du sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ dngos med ngo bo nyid du rtogs pa'i mthar gyis sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ bzhi pa ni/ chos bcu gsum po bsdu na/ sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa/ bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa/ de gnyis ka rnam par dag par byed pa'i chos gsum du 'dus te/ dang po'i dbang du byas nas phar phyin drug rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba/ gnyis pa'i dbang du (495) byas nas rjes dran drug rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba/ gsum pa'i dbang du byas nas/ dngos med ngo bo nyid rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba bzhag pa'i phyir/ yang na/ lam gyi dngos po/ lam la 'jug pa'i rten/ lam gyi yan lag lam nyams su len pa'i dbang po/ lam rnam par dag pa'i chos lngar 'dus te/ dang po'i dbang du byas nas phar phyin drug gnyis pa'i dbang du byas nas dkon mchog gsum/ gsum pa'i dbang du byas nas tshul khrims dang gtong ba/ bzhi pa'i dbang du byas nas/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha/ lnga pa'i dbang du byas nas dngos med ngo bo nyid du rtogs pa'i mthar gyis sbyor bzhag pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba chos can/ khyod la dbye na bcu gsum du yod de/ khyod la dbye na phar phyin drug rjes su dran pa'i de drug rjes dran drug rjes su dran pa'i de drug dngos med ngo bo nyid du rtogs pa'i mthar gyis sbyor rnams su yod pa'i (496) phyir/ legs par bshad pa lung rigs kyi rgya mtsho las/ mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba bshad pa'i skabs te drug pa'o// //gnyis pa ni/ sbyin pa la sogs re res kyang*// zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po skad cig ma'i sbyor ba la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ bsdu ba/

sa mtshams so// dang po ni/ chos thams cad bden med du rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zag med kyi yon tan khyad par can dus skad cig ma gcig la mngon du byed par nus pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug 'di'i skad cig ma bya rdzogs dang*/ dus mtha'i skad cig ma gang yin/ ce na/ mkhan chen pa na re/ bya rdzogs kyi skad cig ma yin zhing*/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba thob nas bskal pa'i bar du yang gnas pa yod de/ dus la mnga' brnyes pas skad cig kyang bskal par byin gyis rlob nus pa'i phyir/ ces gsungs/ rang lugs ni/ dus mtha'i skad (497) cig ma yin te/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba bzhi po 'di rgyun mtha'i ye shes gcig nyid la ldog pa'i sgo nas phye ba tsam yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na/ rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i/ rnam par smin pa'i/ mtshan nyid med pa'i/ gnyis su med pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba dang bzhi/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ zag med kyi yon tan bsdus tshul lo// dang po la/ kha cig rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i zag med kyi chos gcig mngon du byas pa na/ de dang rigs mthun pa'i zag med kyi chos thams cad mngon du byed nus pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug zer/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i zag med kyi yon tan mngon du byed par thal/ 'dod na/ sa bdun pa man chad kyi zag med kyi yon tan mngon du byed par thal lo// (498) rang lugs ni/ rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i zag med kyi rtogs rigs gcig mngon du byas pa na/ de dang rigs mthun pa'i zag med kyi yon tan rnams mngon du byed nus kyi sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug gnyis pa la/ sdud byed/ bsdu bya/ bsdus tshul lo// dang po ni/ rgyun mtha'i gnas skabs kyi rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i zag med kyi yon tan gyi rtogs rigs so// gnyis pa ni/

sbyin pa la sogs pa nas dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i bar gyi zag med kyi yon tan rnams so// gsum pa ni/ rgyun mthar rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i zag med kyi rtogs rigs gcig mngon du byas pa na/ de dang rigs mthun pa'i zag med kyi yon tan rnams mngon du byed pa'o// des ni/ bzo bo mkhas pas sngon 'gro legs par byas pa'i mthu las/ zo chun gyi rgyud thams cad gcig char dus gcig tu 'gul bar lta bu'o// gnyis pa'i mtshan (499) nyid/ rnam par smin pa'i zag med kyi chos gcig mngon du byas pa na/ de dang rigs mthun pa'i zag med kyi chos kun mngon du byed nus kyi sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug rnam par smin ma smin gyi zag med kyi yon tan gang zhe na/ kha cig mi slob pa'i yon tan ni rnam par smin pa'i yon tan/ slob pa'i zag med kyi yon tan ni ma smin pa'i yin zer/ bla ma na re/ 'bad rtsol gyi mtshan ma zhi ba'i yon tan dang*/ las nyon gyi rnam smin gyi yon tan la rim bzhin bzhed/ rang lugs ni/ sa brgyad pa yan chad kyi yon tan ni rnam par smin pa'i yon tan te/ mngal sbubs kyi dri ma dang 'dra ba'i 'bad rtsol gyi mtshan ma nye bar zhi ba'i yon tan yin pa'i phyir/ rgyud blar/ mngal sbubs bral 'dra mi rtog pa'i// ye shes rnam par smin pa yin// zhes dang*/ rgyan las/ dag pa'i sems bskyed la rnam par smin pa'i sems (500) bskyed du bshad pa'i phyir te/ rnam par smin pa'ang gzhan du 'dod// ces so// sa bdun pa man chad kyi zag med kyi yon tan ni/ rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i zag med kyi yon tan te/ 'bad rtsol gyi mtshan ma dang bcas pa'i zag med kyi yon tan yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ chos gcig bden pa'i mtshan nyid med par rtogs pa na de dang rigs mthun pa'i chos kun bden pa'i mtshan nyid med par rtogs nus kyi sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/

chos gcig gzung 'dzin bden pa ba med par rtogs pa na de dang rigs mthun pa'i chos kun gzung 'dzin bden pa ba gnyis su med par rtogs nus kyi sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug gsum pa ni/ bzhi po bsdu na/ yon tan mngon du byed pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ shes rab kyi shes bya shes pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis su 'dus te/ dang po'i dbang du byas nas dang po gnyis/ gnyis pa'i dbang du (501) byas nas phyi ma gnyis bzhag pa'i phyir/ dang po yin te/ mngon du bya rgyu'i yon tan de la/ rnam par smin pa ma yin pa dang*/ rnam par smin pa'i zag med kyi yon tan gnyis yod cing*/ dang po mngon du byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa'i cha nas dang po/ gnyis pa mngon du byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa'i cha nas gnyis pa bzhag pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yin te/ shes rab kyi shes bya shes pa'i tshul la/ bden pa'i mtshan nyid med par shes pa dang*/ gzung 'dzin bden pa ba gnyis su med par shes pa'i tshul gnyis yod cing*/ dang po'i dbang du byas nas gsum pa/ gnyis pa'i dbang du byas nas bzhi pa bzhag pa'i phyir/ de yang dang po ni/ sbyin pa la sogs re res kyang*// zhes pas bstan/ de'i dpe ni/ ji ltar skyes bu zo chun rgyu// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ gang tshe chos dkar thams cad kyi// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ sbyin pa la sogs sbyor ba (502) yis// zhes so// bzhi pa ni/ rmi lam dang ni de mthong nyid// ces sogs kyis bstan/ bzhi pa la/ lo chen na re/ sbyor ba bzhi rim pa bzhin/ sa bdun pa nas bcu pa'i bar du yod/ zer/ sa bdun pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba chos can/ rang 'bras 'bras bu chos sku'i dngos rgyur thal/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ skad cig ma gcig pa'i mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa rnam par bsgoms pa'i skad cig ma gnyis pa la chos kyi sku mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par yin te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/

yang de chos can/ mkhyen gsum bsgom par byed pa'i sbyor ba mthar thug tu thal/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ de mtha' de yi rnam smin ni// zhes pa'i 'grel par/ de nas khyad par du 'gror med pas yang dag par skad cig ma gcig pa'i mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa ni/ thams cad mkhyen (503) pa nyid gsum gyi mthar thug pa'i gnas skabs yin no// zhes so// rang lugs ni/ bzhi ka rgyun mtha' kho na na yod do// gnyis pa ni/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes chos can/ rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba yin te rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i zag med kyi rtogs rigs rnams dus skad cig ma gcig la mngon du byed nus kyi sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ legs par bshad pa lung rigs kyi rgya mtsho las/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba bshad pa'i skabs te bdun pa'o// // (504) gsum pa 'bras bu chos sku la/ 'brel bkod pa'i sgo nas 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ mtshon byed kyi chos rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ skad cig ma gcig pa'i mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa/ zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po 'bras bu chos sku la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ kha cig sbyor bzhi bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu mthar thug zhes dang*/ de gang zhig zag med chos kyi yan lag du ma dang ldan pa/ zer/ dang po la/ longs sku'i dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag pa chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir te/ sangs rgyas la ldan pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sangs rgyas su thal lo// gnyis pa la yang de chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ rtags phyi ma der thal/ zag med kyi cha shas du ma dang ldan pa'i yon tan

(505) yin pa'i phyir te/ zag med gang zhig cha shas tsam gyi dngos po yin pa'i phyir/ rang lugs/ sbyor bzhi bsgom stobs kyis thob pa'i bla na med pa'i byang chub/ dbye na/ sku bzhi/ gnyis pa ni/ rje btsun byams pa mgon po chos can/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba'i 'og tu 'bras bu chos sku bshad pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba'i mjug thog de ma thag 'bras bu chos sku 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ltar du bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ bsdu ba spyir bstan pa dang*/ dka' gnas bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ chos sku mtshon byed kyi chos rnam pa bzhi gsungs pa de yang bsdu na/ rang don chos sku dang*/ gzhan don gzugs sku gnyis su 'dus/ dang po la/ spangs ba dang rtogs pa gnyis las/ dang po'i dbang du byas nas ngo bo nyid sku/ gnyis pa'i dbang du byas nas rtogs ye chos sku bzhag dang po/ thub pa'i ngo bo nyid sku ni// zhes (506) sogs kyi bstan/ gnyis pa la/ chos sku'i rang bzhin/ yon tan gyi khyad par/ rtsod pa spang pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ byang chub phyogs mthun tshad med dang*// zhes sogs so// gnyis pa la/ nyon mongs pa med pa dang*/ smon nas mkhyen pa'i yon tan gnyis/ dang po ni/ nyan thos nyon mongs zhes sogs so// gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas smon nas zhes sogs so// gsum pa la/ chos sku khyab pa la rtsod pa spang ba dang*/ khyab rtag gnyis ga la rtsod pa spang ba gnyis/ dang po la/ rtsod lan gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rtogs ye chos sku des sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi sku snang ba'i bdag rkyen byed par thal/ de sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i brtse ba snying rje chen po dang dus rtag tu ldan pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ lan la skal ldan la snang ba'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ skal med la mi snang ba'i dpe gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgyu ni yongs su zhes sogs so// gnyis pa ni/ lha yi rgyal (507) pos zhes sogs so// gnyis pa la/

rtsod lan gnyis/ dang po ni/ chos sku chos can/ khyab pa zhes brjod mi rigs par thal/ shākya seng ge la sogs pa rnal 'byor pa so sor nges pa'i rgyud la yod pa'i phyir/ rtag pa zhes brjod mi rigs par thal/ skad cig gis 'jig pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ lan ni de ltar mdzad pa zhes sogs so// gnyis pa gzugs sku la/ gdul bya dag pa 'ba' zhig la snang ba'i cha dang dag ma dag sna tshogs la snang ba'i sku gnyis su yod cing*/ dang po'i dbang du byas nas longs sku dang*/ gnyis pa'i dbang du byas nas sprul sku bzhag dang po la ngo bo mdor bstan pa dang*/ yon tan rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ mtshan ni sum cu zhes sogs so// gnyis pa la/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyi yon tan gnyis/ dang po la/ ngo bo dang*/ rgyu gnyis/ dang po ni/ phyag zhabs 'khor lo'i zhes sogs so// gnyis pa la/ bstan bshad (508) gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'di la mtshan ni zhes sogs so// gnyis pa ni/ bla ma skyel la zhes sogs so// gnyis pa ni/ thub pa'i sen mo zhes sogs so// gnyis pa/ sprul sku ni/ gang gi srid pa zhes sogs so// sku de dag gi mdzad pa 'phrin las thun mong du 'chad pa ni/ de bzhin 'khor ba zhes sogs kyi bstan/ sku gsum du grangs nges pa 'phags pa grol sde la sogs pa ltar na/ 'bras bu chos sku la/ rang don chos sku/ longs sku/ sprul sku gsum yod cing*/ ngo bo mdor bstan pa'i tshul gyis 'chad pa ni/ thub pa'i ngo bo zhes sogs so// de'i yon tan rgyas par bshad pa ni/ byang chub phyogs zhes sogs so// gnyis pa ngo bo mdor bstan 'chad pa ni/ mtshan ni sum cu zhes sogs so// de'i yon tan rgyas par bshad pa ni/ phyag zhabs 'khor lo'i zhes sogs so// gsum pa'i ngo bo mdor bstan 'chad pa ni/ gang gi srid pa zhes sogs so// de'i yon tan rgyas par bshad pa ni/ de bzhin 'khor ba zhes sogs (509) kyis bstan par bzhed de/ de dag gis gdul bya dbang rtul rjes su bzung ba'i phyir du mngon par rtogs pa brgyad kyi lam rim rgyas par bshad pa yin la/

dbang 'bring rjes su bzung ba'i phyir du mngon par rtogs pa drug gi lam rim ni/ mtshan nyid de'i sbyor ba dang*// zhes sogs so// mngon par rtogs pa gsum gyi lam rim ni/ yul gyi rnam pa zhes sogs kyis bstan/ bshad pa mthar phyin pa'i bya ba ni/ la la las don zhes sogs kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ mchod rten brgyad kyi bstod par/ dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed de// bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags shing*// bar du gcod pa'i bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad pa'i// bcom ldan seng ge de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa ltar/ dang por byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i tshul/ bar du tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i tshul/ mthar sangs rgyas pa'i tshul/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi rnam par bzhag (510) pa/ mdzad pa 'phrin las kyi rnam par bzhag pa'o// dang po la/ theg dman gyi lugs dang*/ theg chen gyi lugs gnyis/ dang po ni/ ston pa 'di sngon rgyal po gsal grags zhes bya bar gyur pa'i tshe/ 'jigs pas nyen pa'i mi 'ga' zhig la mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa byin te/ sbyin pa 'di yi shākya'i rigs skyes nas// yon tan rigs rus mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas 'gyur// tshangs pa'i bar gyi nyams thag 'ching ba rnams// zhi ba rgya chen 'jigs med thob par shog /ces smon lam btab te sems bskyed/ gnyis pa la/ snying rje pad dkar las/ ston pa 'di sngon rgyal po rtsibs kyi mu khyud kyi 'dun na 'don bram ze rgya mtsho rngul du gyur pa'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying po'i drung du smon lam rnam pa lnga btab ste sems bskyed pa'ang bshad/ bskal bzang du/ nga ni sngon tshe dman par gyur pa'i tshe// de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub de la// 'jam gang zhig (511) ni dbul ba byas nas kyang*// dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do// zhes bshad/ drin lan bsab pa ltar na/ ston pa 'di lcags sreg gi sa gzhi la dmyal ba'i shing rta 'dren pa'i gyad du 'khrungs pa'i tshe/

grogs la snying rje skyes nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par bshad/ mdo kha cig tu/ rdza mkhan gyi khye'u snang byed du gyur pa'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa chen po la/ rdza'i bum pa cig mgron bu lnga/ mchil lh+wam zung cig gdugs gcig rnams phul nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa khyed sku ci 'dra dang*// 'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams dang*// zhes sogs smon lam btab ste sems bskyed par bshad/ gnyis pa la/ gang bsag par bya ba'i tshogs kyi ngo bo/ ci tsam du bsags pa'i dus/ ji ltar bsags pa'i tshul lo// dang po la/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzugs (512) sku'i rgyur gyur pa'i sbyin sogs kyi dge rtsa yin cing*/ gnyis pa ni/ chos sku'i rgyur gyur pa'i stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes yin te/ rin chen phreng bar/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzugs sku 'dir// bsod nams tshogs las byung ba ste// chos kyi sku ni mdor bsdu na// rgyal po ye shes tshogs las byung*// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// de yang sbyin sogs dang po gsum bsod nams kyi tshogs/ bsam gtan dang shes rab ni ye shes kyi tshogs/ brtson 'grus de gnyis ka mthar phyin pa'i grogs yin te/ 'jug par/ sbyin sogs chos gsum 'di dag phal mo cher// bde bar gshegs pas khyim pa rnams la bsngags// bsod nams zhes bya'i tshogs kyang de dag nyid// sangs rgyas gzugs kyi bdag nyid sku'i rgyu// zhes pa'i shugs la/ bsam gtan chos gnyis 'di dag phal mo che// bde bar gshegs pas rab byung rnams la bsngags// ye shes zhes bya'i tshogs kyang de dag nyid// sangs rgyas (513) chos kyi bdag nyid sku yi rgyu// zhes pa thob pa'i phyir ro// de gnyis 'gal ba ma yin te/ rgyan las/ sbyin dang tshul khrims bsod nams kyi// tshogs yin shes rab ye shes kyi// gsum po gzhan ni gnyis ka'i ste// lnga char yang ni ye shes tshogs// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa la/ theg dman dang*/ theg chen gyi lugs gnyis/ dang po ni/ bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs gnyis bsag par bzhed de/ grangs med dang po la/ sangs rgyas bdun khri lnga stong*/ gnyis pa la bdun khri drug stong*/ gsum pa la bdun khri bdun stong la bsnyen bkur byas pa'i sgo nas tshogs gnyis bsags par bshad pa'i phyir/ 'dul ba lung las/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa nas// 'dren pa yul 'khor skyong gi bar// bdun khri lnga stong tshang ba yi// sangs rgyas rnams ni des mchod do// sangs rgyas legs mdzad nas bzung ste// dbang po rgyal mtshan thub pa'i bar// (514) bdun khri drug stong tshang ba yi// sangs rgyas rnams ni des mchod do// sangs rgyas mar me mdzad nas ni// sangs rgyas 'od srungs bar dag tu// bdun khri bdun stong tshang ba yi// sangs rgyas rnams ni des mchod do// zhes so// gnyis pa la/ bshad tshul spyir bstan pa/ de dag gi dgongs pa dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ mdo bstan bcos phal che ba las/ grangs med gsum du tshogs bsog par bshad de/ tshogs lam nas sa dang po'i bar grangs med gcig gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar grangs med gcig dag pa sa gsum la grangs med gcig tshogs bsog par bshad pa'i phyir te/ rgyan las/ sa ni dang po yin par 'dod// 'di de bskal pa dpag med kyis// zhes dang*/ grangs med gnyis ni rdzogs pa yis// sgom pa yi ni mthar phyin te// zhes dang*/ theg bsdus las/ byang chub sems dpa'i grangs med gsum// kun tu brtson par mdzad pa yin// zhes sogs (515) mdo bstan bcos kyi lung mtha' yas pa yod do// rgya cher rol pa las/ grangs med bdun du tshogs bsog par bshad de bskal pa grangs med pa bdun du dag pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yang dag par bsgrubs pa/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bskal pa grangs med pa bcur bshad pa yang yod de/ du ba lha yi sde pa tha dad klog pa las de ltar du bshad pa'i phyir/

mdo kha cig las/ grangs med bcu gsum du bshad pa yod/ 'grel chen las/ grangs med sum cu rtsa gsum du bshad de/ tshor sbyor la grangs med gsum/ sa bcu re re la yang grangs med gsum gsum du tshogs gnyis bsog dgos pa'i phyir/ des na mdo las/ grangs med gsum du bshad pa ni/ gsum tshan du chos mtshungs pa tsam la dgongs pa yin zhes bzhed/ gnyis pa la kha cig mtha' cig tu brgyad stong 'grel chen gyi de nyid 'thad zer/ kha cig grangs med gsum du bshad pa ltar 'thad (516) zer/ rang lugs/ tshogs bsags tshul de dag kyang gang zag so so'i dbang po'i rim la dgongs te/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa gzhir bzhag la/ dbang po rno zhing*/ brtson 'grus drag pos grangs med gsum la lam mtha' dag bgrod nus/ 'bring pos bdun dang bcu la sogs pa la bgrod nus/ shin tu dbang rtul gyis sum cu rtsa gsum 'gor srid pa la dgongs pa'i phyir te/ tshigs gsal du/ de ltar na mthong ba'i lam la dus ji srid cig thogs zhe na/ zhes pa nas/ de bzhin du ci'i dus bskal pa grangs med pa zhes sogs dang*/ de dang mthun par/ dbu ma pa chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis kyang bshad/ gsum pa la/ theg dman dang*/ theg chen gyi lugs gnyis/ dang po ni/ ston pa 'di la mtshon na/ phyin drug rdzogs pa'i sgo nas tshogs gnyis bsags par bzhed de/ rgyal po thams cad sgrol du gyur pa'i tshe/ phyi nang gi dngos po thams cad ma chags (517) par btang bas sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs/ drang srong bzod pa can du gyur pa'i tshe/ yan lag sogs bcad kyang gnod 'tshe'i sems ma skyes pas tshul khrims dang bzod pa'i phar phyin rdzogs/ sangs rgyas skar rgyal zad par me'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa la bstod pa brjod cing skor ba byas pas brtson 'grus kyis phar phyin rdzogs cing bskal pa dgu'i tshogs 'dum par bshad/ byang chub kyi shing drung du byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pas bsam gtan dang shes rab kyi phar phyin rdzogs te/

de ma thag tu byang chub mngon du byas par bzhed pa'i phyir te/ mdzod las/ kun la thams cad snying rje yis// sbyin par byas pas sbyin pa rdzogs// chags bcas yan lag bcas kyang ni// mi 'khrugs bzod dang tshul khrims kyi// skar rgyal bstod pas brtson 'grus kyi// de ma thag la ting 'dzin blo'i// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ ston pa 'di la mtshon na/ byang (518) chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/ ston pa 'di sngon gzhon nu brtson 'grus spyod ces bya bar gyur pa'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa phung po chen po 'jig rten du byon pa la bsnyen bkur zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa nas brtsam ste/ bskal pa grangs med gcig tu tshogs bsags pas sa dang po thob par bshad/ de'i rjes su tshong dpon shes rab bzang por gyur pa'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa dkon mchog yan lag 'jig rten du byon pa la bsnyen bkur zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa nas brtsams te/ bskal pa grangs med cig tu tshogs bsags pas sa bdun pa'i bar du thob par bshad/ de'i rjes su bram ze'i khye'u chos kyi sprin zhes bya bar gyur pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas mar me mdzad 'jig rten du byon pa la bsnyen bkur zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa nas brtsams te/ bskal pa grangs med gcig tu tshogs bsags pas sa brgyad pa la sogs pa'i rtogs pa thob par bshad de/ lung las/ gang tshe mar (519) me mdzad kyis nga*// lung bstan gyur pa de yi tshe// sa brgyad pa ni thob gyur te// dbang bcu dag kyang thob par gyur// zhes so// gsum pa la/ dang por byang chub brnyes pa'i tshul dang*/ sprul sku 'jig rten du byon tshul lo// dang po ni/ bskal pa grangs med pa gsum la sogs par bslab pa gsum/ phar phyin drug byang phyogs so bdun la sogs pa tshogs gnyis rgya chen po bsags te/ sa bcu rim gyis bgrod nas 'og min stug po bkod par chos sku mngon du byas te/

longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur sangs rgyas de'i skad cig gnyis pa la gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgyar sprul nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa yin te/ lang gshegs las/ gtsang ma'i gnas rnams spangs pa yi// 'og min gnas mchog nyams dga' bar// yang dag sangs rgyas der sangs rgyas// sprul pa po gcig 'dir sangs rgya// zhes dang*/ stug po bkod pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas thams (520) cad 'og min du// sangs rgyas ma gyur 'dod khams su// sangs rgyas mdzad pa mi mdzad do// zhes dang*/ rab dbye las/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni// stug po bkod par sangs rgyas pa'i// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku nyid yin// de yi sprul pa'i sku nyid ni// zas gtsang sras su 'khrungs pa yi// shākya seng ge 'di yin no// zhes so// gnyis pa la/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ bye brag ston pa 'di byon tshul lo// dang po la grangs du zhig 'byon pa/ dus nam gyi tshe 'byon pa/ de dag gi khyad chos so// dang po ni/ bskal pa bzang po 'di la mtshon na/ snying rje pad dkar las/ sangs rgyas stong dang lnga 'byung bar bshad/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas stong dang sems dpa' gnyis ste stong rtsa gnyis 'byung bar bshad/ gnyis pa ni/ bskal pa chen po 'di la/ dad par 'chags pa'i bar bskal nyi shu/ de'i rjes su gnas pa'i bar bskal

(521) nyi shu/ de'i rjes su stong pa'i bar bskal nyi shu dang brgyad cu yod pa'i nang nas gnas bskal la 'byon/ de la yang*/ yar 'phel dang*/ mar 'grib gnyis yod pa'i nang nas mar 'grib dus su 'byon pa yin te/ dang po/ tshe lo bzhi khri pa'i dus su 'khor ba 'jig gsum khri pa la gser thub/ nyi khri pa la 'od srungs/ brgya pa la/ ston pa shākya thub pa/ byon par bshad/ tshe lo brgya pa man chad nas/ bcu pa'i bar la sangs rgyas mi 'byon te/ snyigs ma lnga shas che bas sangs rgyas kyi dngos kyi don bya yul du mi rung ba'i phyir/ tshe lo bcu yan nas brgyad khri'i bar 'phel te/ 'grib pa'i mgo rtsom pa'i tshe/ 'phags pa byams pa la sogs 'byon par bshad/ gsum pa ni/ bskal bzang las/ sangs rgyas re re yang khyad chos bcu gsum bcu gsum dang ldan par bshad/ de dag gi sdoms ni/ yul rigs 'od dang yab yum sras// rim gro shes rab rdzu 'phrul (522) 'khor// sku tshe sku gdung dam chos gnas// bcu gsum dag gis shes par bya// zhes so// de yang ston pa 'di la mtshon na/ sku 'khrungs pa'i yul ni grong khyer ser skya/ rigs rgyal rigs/ gdung shākya/ 'od 'dom gang*/ yab zas gtsang*/ yum sgyu ma lha mdzes/ sras sgra gcan 'dzin/ rim gro pa kun dga'o// shes rab can gyi mchog kun tu nye rgyal/ rdzu 'phrul can gyi mchog kun tu rgyu dpang nas skyes/ 'khor 'dus pa dang po la stong nyis brgya lnga bcu/ sku tshe'i tshad tshe lo brgya/ sku gdung cha brgyad kyi sgo nas sems can gyi don mdzad/ dam pa'i chos kyi gnas tshad/ mdo de'i dngos bstan la stong du bshad kyang*/ don gnas tshad la lnga stong du gnas/ 'dir 'khor 'dus pa dang po la/ 'khor nyis brgya lnga bcu 'chad pa mi 'thad de/ mdo gzhan nas 'khor lnga stong du bshad pa'i phyir zhe na/ skyon med de/ lnga stong du bshad pa gang zag gi dbang du byas la/ (523) 'dir bshad pa ni/

dge slong bzhi tshogs la dge 'dun du byas pa'i dge 'dun gyi grangs kyi dbang du byas pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ ston pa 'dis 'dzam bu'i gling du mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul ston pa'i sgo nas 'byon pa yin te/ rgyud blar/ thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten mkhyen// 'jig rten kun la gzigs nas ni// chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par// sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis// skye ba mngon par skye ba dang*// dga' ldan nas ni 'pho ba dang*// lhums su 'jug dang bltams pa dang*// bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang*// btsun mo'i 'khor dgyes rol pa dang*// nges 'byung dka' ba spyod pa dang*// byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang*// bdud sde 'joms dang rdzogs par ni// byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo dang*// mya ngan 'das par gshegs mdzad rnams// yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su// srid pa ji srid gnas par ston// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa la/ sku'i bsdu (524) ba/ so so'i rang bzhin/ grangs nges kyi rnam bzhag dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rang don chos sku dang*/ gzhan don gzugs sku gnyis su yang 'dus/ chos nyid kyi sku dang*/ chos can gyi sku gnyis su yang 'dus te/ rgyud blar/ rang don gzhan don don dam sku dang ni// de la brten pa kun rdzob sku nyid de// zhes dang*/ bdag nyid kyi ni 'byor pa'i gnas// dam pa'i don gyi sku yin te// drang srong rnams kyi brda yi sku// pha rol phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas// zhes dang*/ rigs pa drug cu pa las/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun// bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsags shing*// bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i// dam pa gnyis ni thob par shog /ces so// gnyis pa la/ bzhi las/ dang po ngo bo nyid sku ni// thub pa'i ngo bo nyid sku ni// zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ ngo bo nyid sku la dgag bzhag gnyis/ dang po la/ kha cig dri ma ma lus pa dang bral ba'i sems rig gsal ngo bo nyid sku yin te/

chos mchog gis/ (525) nges par legs pa'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i sems ni 'gog pa'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zer/ dri bral gyi sems chos can/ rang bzhin gyi rtag par thal/ ngo bo nyid sku yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rang bzhin dang ni rgyun mi 'chad// rgyun gyi de dag rtag pa nyid// ces so// rgyu rkyen gyi bcos ma ma yin par thal/ rtag pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ 'grel par/ bcos ma ma yin pa'i don gyis 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam gyis thob kyi/ byas pa ni ma yin pas zhes so// kha cig dri ma dang bral ba'i sems bden pas stong pa'i stong nyid ngo bo nyid sku yin te/ de dag gi rang gi ngo bo nyid skye ba med pa'i ngo bo nyid ni 'di yin te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ lam bsgoms stobs kyis gsar du thob pa'i yon tan du thal/ de'i phyir/ khyab ste/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam gyis 'thob kyi/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ theg chen gyi (526) mthong lam des khyod mngon sum du rtogs par thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ theg chen gyi mthong lam chos can/ khyod kyis de mngon sum du rtogs par thal/ chos dbyings kun 'gro'i tshul du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsang phu ba gzhon nu blo ldan na re/ rgyu'i dus su rang bzhin gnas rigs de rigs btags pa pa dang*/ 'bras bu'i dus su ngo bo nyid sku de sku btags pa pa yin/ gal te mtshan nyid pa yin na/ de chos can/ sems can thams cad kyi don byed par thal/ khas len rtags/ 'dod na/ de cig char du byed par thal/ de byed pa gang zhig rim can du mi byed pa'i phyir/ khyod la skad cig snga phyi'i rim pa med pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sems can thams cad cig char du smin par thal lo// yang de chos can/ don byed nus par thal/ gdul bya'i don byed nus pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rang 'bras skyed byed du thal/ de'i phyir/

khyab ste/ chos mchog gi don ni (527) 'bras bu yin la/ byed pa ni skyed pa/ nus pa ni mthu'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zer na/ de chos can/ chos sku ma yin par thal/ sangs rgyas ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mthar thug gi myang 'das ma yin par thal/ de'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rgyud blar/ gang phyir de ni chos sku de ni de bzhin gshegs// de ni 'phags pa'i bden pa don dam mya ngan 'das// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sgrub byed dang po la dus gsum po cig char du grub par thal/ rnam mkhyen gyis dus gsum po cig char du 'jal ba'i phyir te/ 'das pa mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen gyis ma 'ongs pa dang da lta ba yang mkhyen pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ 'gog bden chos can/ rang rgyu las skyes par thal/ 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir te/ bral 'bras yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa rnams khas/ kha cig ngo bo nyid sku sangs rgyas ma yin te/ rgyas pa'i don ma tshang ba'i phyir/ zer/ (528) rgyas pa'i don ma tshang ba'i don mkhyen pa'i ngo bo ma yin pa la byed dam/ mkhyen pa dang mi ldan pa la byed/ dang po ltar na rnam mkhyen yang sangs rgyas ma yin par thal/ de la sangs pa'i don ma tshang ba'i phyir te/ spangs pa'i ngo bo ma yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ltar na/ de la rgyas pa'i don tshang bar thal/ stobs sogs mi 'jigs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i phyir/ rgyud blar/ dang po'i sku ni stobs la sogs// bral ba'i yon tan rnams dang ldan// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha cig spangs pa dang mthar thug gi yon tan tshogs pa ngo bo nyid sku yin gyi/ spangs pa rkyang pa ngo bo nyid sku ma yin te/ shes bya mi shes pa'i phyir te/ dngos med yin pa'i phyir/ zer/ mthar thug gi spangs rtogs tshogs pa chos can/ chos nyid du thal/ ngo bo nyid sku yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rgyud blar/ ngo bo nyid sku'i mtshan nyid 'chad pa ni/ chos dbyings ngo bo nyid (529) kyis ni// dag pa'i phyir na 'od gsal ba// zhes dang*/

de nyid kyang chos nyid kyi sku yin pa la/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rang lugs/ khyad chos spyir bstan pa dang*/ mtshan nyid bsdus te bstan pa gnyis/ dang po la/ 'dus ma byas pa/ tha dad med pa/ mtha' gnyis su 'dzin pa med pa/ rnam par dag pa/ 'od gsal ba'i khyad chos lnga dang ldan/ dang po ni/ rang don don dam pa'i sku la/ thog mar skye ba/ bar du gnas pa/ mthar 'gag pa dang bral ba'o// gnyis pa ni/ dbyings dang ye shes dbyer mi phyed pa'i tshul gyis ldan pa'o// gsum pa ni/ bdag dang bdag med kyi spros pa'i mtha' gnyis 'dzin spangs pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ sgrib pa gsum dang bral ba'i glo bur rnam dag gi yon tan no// lnga pa ni/ dri ma med cing rnam rtog med pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin no// rgyud blar/ de la sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni// ngo bo nyid sku mtshan nyid lnga// mdor na (530) yon tan lnga dang ni// ldan pa nyid du rig par bya// zhes pa'i rgyas bshad du/ 'dus ma byas pa'i rnam dbyer med// mtha' gnyis dag ni rnam par spangs// nyon mongs shes bya snyoms 'jug gis// sgrib gsum las ni nges grol te// dri med rnam par rtog med dang*// rnal 'byor rnams kyi yul yin phyir// chos dbyings ngo bo nyid kyis ni// dag pa'i phyir na 'od gsal ba// zhes so// 'o na/ ṭī ka las/ des na chos kyi dbyings zag med kyi chos rnams dang lhan cig tshogs pa ni sku dngos yin no// zhes bshad pa ma yin nam zhe na/ de'i don ni/ byang chub phyogs mthun tshad med dang*// zhes sogs/ ngo bo nyid sku las logs su gyur pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku ston byed ma yin na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid dang*// chos nyid sku zhes brjod pa yin// zhes 'byung rigs kyi/ chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin// zhes brjod mi rigs so// zhe na/ skyon med de/ dharmā (531) ta ka ya zhes brjod na/ chos nyid kyi sku dang*/

dharmā ka ya zhes brjod na/ chos kyi sku zhes 'byung ba yin cing*/ nyid kyi rkyen ta mi mngon par byas nas chos kyi sku'i ming gis btags nas bstan pa'i phyir/ ngo bo nyid sku la ye shes chos sku'i ming gis 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ ngo bo nyid sku ni zag med chos kyi dbyings yin la/ de dang zag med kyi ye shes ngo bo tha mi dad pa'i phyir/ dper na/ sngon slob pa'i gnas skabs su sems sems byung gi tshogs pa la lus zhes 'dogs pa bzhin no// des na zag med kyi ye shes tshogs pa dang lhan cig tu 'jug pa'i zag med kyi chos dbyings ni ngo bo nyid sku dngos yin no// zhes pa ni/ ṭī ka'i dgongs pa yin/ sa'i yongs spyod kyi skabs dang*/ rgyud bla'i ṭī ka sogs su chos nyid du bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rang don chos sku gang zhig bskal pa grangs med par lam bsgom stobs kyi thob pa'i (532) bral 'bras/ mtshan gzhi/ sangs rgyas sa'i sgrib gnyis spangs pa'i spangs pa lta bu'o// rgyud bla'i ṭī kar/ mthar thug gi spangs rtogs dbyer med ces pa'i don ni/ mthar thug gi rtogs pa glo bur gyi dri ma ma lus pa dang bral ba'i bral cha de nyid mthar thug gi spangs pa yin la/ de dang mthar thug gi spangs pa gnyis blos tha dad du phye ba ma gtogs/ don la ngo bo tha dad med ces pa'i don no// gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas sa'i dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos dbyings chos can/ ngo bo nyid sku yin te/ stobs sogs mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa yon tan du ldan pa'i dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos nyid kyi sku yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa chos sku la/ rang bzhin dang yon tan gyi khyad par gnyis/ dang po ni/ de ltar sku dang po bstan nas gnyis pa chos kyi sku/ zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po rtogs pa ye shes chos sku la/ ngo bo/ dbye ba/ so so'i rang bzhin/ shes bya mkhyen tshul (533) lo// dang po la/

dgag bzhag gnyis/ dang po la/ kha cig sangs rgyas kyi ye shes yin na/ rtog pa ye shes chos sku yin pas ma khyab ste/ gal te khyab na/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i mig gi rnam par shes pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rnal 'byor mngon sum du thal/ 'dod na/ rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen ting nge 'dzin las skyes par thal/ 'dod na/ rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen dbang po gzugs can pa las dngos su skyes pa ma yin par thal lo// byang sems 'phags pa'i mig gi rnam par shes pa lam shes su thal/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i mig gi rnam par shes pa rnam mkhyen yin pa'i phyir/ zer/ thal 'gyur dang po la/ de chos can/ rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen ting nge 'dzin las skyes par thal/ bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa la sgrib byed kyi dri ma zad par spangs (534) pa'i shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ gnyis pa la/ byang sems 'phags pa'i mig gi rnam par shes pa de lam gsum bden med du mngon sum du rtogs pa la sgrib byed kyi dri ma zad par spangs pa'i shes par thal/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i mig gi rnam par shes pa de ngo bo rgyu 'bras kyis bsdus pa'i chos ma lus pa mngon sum du rtogs pa la sgrib byed kyi dri ma zad par spangs pa'i shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ rang lugs la/ khyad chos spyir bstan pa dang*/ mtshan nyid bsdus te bstan pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ khyad chos lnga dang ldan te/ ngo bo'i khyad par/ gnas gyur gyi/ mdzad pa'i/ yul can gyi/ rgyu'i khyad par lnga dang ldan pa'i phyir/ dang po ni/ gzung 'dzin gnyis su med pa'i sems sems byung gis bsdus pa ste/ gnyis su med pa'i sems dang sems las byung ba/ zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ spang byas bsdus pa'i zag bcas ma lus pa gnyen po'i stobs kyis zad par spangs pa ste/ gnas gyur pas (535) gyur pa thams cad kyang chos kyi skur mngon par brjod pa yin no// zhes so// gsum pa ni/

gzugs sku gnyis su snang ba bskyed pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa yin/ kun rdzob tu ye shes kho na longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la sogs par snang ba bskyed pa'i sgo nas zhes so// bzhi pa ni/ sangs rgyas nang phan tshun kho na'i mngon sum gyi spyod yul du gyur pa ste/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos la sogs pa'i spyod yul du rnam par bzhag pa yin no// zhes so// lnga pa la/ spyi'i rgyu dang*/ so so'i rgyu gnyis/ dang po ni/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa las byung ste/ chos kyi sku ni mdor bsdu na// rgyal po ye shes tshogs las byung*// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ slob lam du chos rnams kyi tshig don 'dzin pa/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid du bsgoms pa/ gdul bya la chos yang dag par ston pa/ sems can (536) gi don bsgrub pa bzhi las/ ye shes bzhi rim can du 'byung ste/ rgyan las/ 'dzin pa'i phyir dang sems mnyam phyir// yang dag chos rab bstan phyir dang*// bya ba sgrub pa nyid kyi phyir// ye shes bzhi po yang dag 'byung*// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ shes bya thams cad mngon sum du rtogs pa la gegs byed kyi dri ma zad par spangs pa'i mthar thug gi ye shes de dang rnam mkhyen/ kun mkhyen ye shes/ sangs rgyas kyi shes pa rnams don gcig ming gis rnam grangs so// gnyis pa la/ me long lta bu'i/ mnyam pa nyid kyi/ so sor rtogs pa'i/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes dang bzhi ste/ rgyan las/ me long ye shes mi g.yo ste// ye shes gsum ni de la brten// mnyam pa nyid dang so sor rtogs// bya ba grub pa kho na'o// gsum pa la/ dgag bzhag gnyis/ dang po la/ kha cig mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ kun gzhi gnas gyur pa'i mthar thug gi ye shes/ nyon

(537) yid gnas gyur pa'i/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa gnas gyur pa'i/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes gnas gyur pa'i mthar thug gi ye shes/ ye shes bzhi po nang phan tshun 'gal te/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad gnas gyur pa las ye shes bzhi po thob dgos pa gang zhig tshogs brgyad nang phan tshun 'gal ba'i phyir/ zer/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na/ rnam shes tshogs drug las ma rtogs pa'i kun gzhi dang nyon yid kyi rigs rgyun du gyur pa'i gtso sems don gzhan pa yod par thal/ tshogs brgyad gnas gyur pa'i stobs kyis ye shes bzhi thob pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi de bzhi 'gal bar 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na kun gzhi dang nyon yid gang rung yod par thal lo// rnam mkhyen chos can/ me long lta bu'i ye shes ma yin par thal/ ye shes phyi ma gsum pa yin pa'i phyir/ mnyam nyid ye shes su thal/ chos thams cad bden med mnyam pa nyid du (538) mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes su thal/ ji snyed pa'i chos rnams ma 'dres par so sor mngon sum du rtogs pa'i de yin pa'i phyir/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes su thal/ gdul bya ma lus pa'i don sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa'i de yin pa'i phyir/ des na 'di dag ngo bo gcig la ldog pa'i sgo nas so sor phye ba shes par gyis shig rang lugs/ chos thams cad me long du 'char ba'i gzugs brnyan ltar snang la rang bzhin med par 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad bden med mnyam pa nyid du/ ji snyed pa'i chos rnams ma 'dres par so sor mngon sum du rtog pa mthar thug pa'i ye shes/ sems can ma lus pa'i don sgrub pa'i mthar thug gi ye shes/ rim bzhin mtshan nyid yin/ bzhi pa la/ dgag bzhag gnyis/ dang po/ nyan thos sde pa kha cig shes bya thams cad rim gyis mkhyen pa'i sgo nas thams cad (539) mkhyen par bzhag pa yin gyi/ gcig char mkhyen pa ma yin par 'dod de/

rgyun gyi spyod pa'i phyir na dper// me yis thams cad bsreg 'dod ltar// de bzhin thams cad mkhyen 'dod kyi// thams cad cig char mkhyen min no// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bod kha cig kyang*/ de ltar du khas len pa ni mi 'thad de/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i mkhyen pas sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa ma spangs par thal/ des shes bya thams cad mngon sum du cig char du rtogs pa la sgrib byed kyi dri ma zad par ma spangs pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ lo chen na re/ sangs rgyas sa'i shes pa yin na/ shes bya thams cad mngon sum du rtogs pas ma khyab ste/ sangs rgyas sa'i gzhi shes kyi gzhi kho na shes kyang*/ lam dang rnam pa mi shes/ lam shes kyi gzhi lam gnyis shes kyang rnam pa mi shes pa'i phyir dang*/ mig gi rnam par shes pas gzugs kho na shes kyi/ dri ro sogs mi shes pa'i phyir/ (540) dbang po lnga rnams gzhan gyur na// don kun 'jug dang*/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ bskal ma bskal gyi gzugs thams cad mngon sum du mthong ba la dgongs gsungs/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na nyon sgrib tsam spangs pa'i spangs pa nyi 'tshe ba yod par thal/ de na gzhi gang zag gi bdag med pa tsam mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rtogs pa nyi 'tshe ba yod pa'i phyir/ kha cig sangs rgyas sa'i ye shes kyis lkog gyur mi mkhyen te/ de'i gzigs ngo na lkog gyur med pa'i phyir te/ de la shes bya thams cad mngon gyur du snang ba'i phyir/ zer/ de la lkog gyur mngon gyur du snang bar thal/ de la shes bya thams cad mngon gyur du snang ba'i phyir/ 'dod na/ des lkog gyur mkhyen par thal lo// rang lugs/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes yin na/ ji lta ji snyed 'das ma 'ongs kyi chos thams cad cig char du mngon sum du mkhyen pas khyab ste/ mdo las/ 'dod chags dang bcas pa'i sems la 'dod chags dang bcas pa'i sems so// zhes yang dag par ji lta (541) ba bzhin du rab tu shes so// 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sems la 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sems so// zhes yang dag par ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so// zhes dang*/

rgyan las/ sangs rgyas rnams ni mngon sum mkhyen// dus la ye shes ma bsgribs so// zhes dang*/ mkhyen pa'i skad cig gcig gis ni// shes bya'i dkyil 'khor kun khyab can// zhes dang*/ nyi ma'i 'od zer gcig btang bas// 'gro ba snang bar byed par ltar// de bzhin shes bya thams cad la// sangs rgyas ye shes cig char snang*// zhes dang*/ rma bya'i mdongs ni gcig po la// rgyu yi dbye ba ji snyed pa// kun mkhyen min pas shes bya min// de mkhyen pas na kun mkhyen to// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas sa'i zag med kyi ye shes sde tshan nyer gcig chos can/ rtogs pa ye shes chos sku yin te/ zag bcas ma lus pa zag med du gnas gyur pa'i mthar thug sa'i ye shes yin pa'i (542) phyir/ gnyis pa la/ zad par/ zil gnon/ nyon mongs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ zad par bcu yi bdag nyid dang*// zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ zad par gyi ting nge 'dzin la/ lus rten/ sems rten/ brten pa zad par gyi ting nge 'dzin dang gsum/ dang po ni/ dang po brgyad sngar med gsar du skye ba 'dod pa'i rten la skye dgos te/ gtso bor thos bsam gyi mthu las skye dgos pa'i phyir/ thob zin gnas pa gzugs kyi rten la yang yod/ phyi ma gnyis khams gsum gyi rten la dngos su skye ba yod de/ gzugs med ces bya khams gsum gyi// rten bcas lhag ma mi las skye// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ kun btus las/ thams cad kyang bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la rten par bshad/ mdzod ltar na/ dang po brgyad bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi/ phyi ma gnyis gzugs med kyi sems la rten par bshad/ gsum pa la/ mtshan nyid/ (543) sgra bshad/ dbye ba/ khyad chos dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan dang gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi gang rung la brten nas rang gi dmigs yul gyi gtso bo des shes bya thams cad la khyab par spro nus pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/

gnyis pa ni/ dmigs pa rgyun mi chad par khyab par spro nus pas na zad par zhes bya'o// gsum pa la/ zad par sa'i/ chu/ me/ rlung*/ sngon po/ ser po/ dmar po/ dkar po/ nam mkha'/ zad par rnam shes kyi ting nge 'dzin dang bcu/ dang po'i mtshan nyid la/ kha cig bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas shes bya thams cad sar snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ zer/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i zad par sa'i ting nge 'dzin chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rang gi snang yul la 'khrul shes su thal/ 'dod na/ 'khrul pa thams cad zad (544) par spangs pa ma yin par thal lo// gal te/ zad par gyi ting nge 'dzin yin na snang yul la 'khrul shes yin dgos te/ rnam 'grel las/ lhag ma nye bar bslang pa yin// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bar chad med lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i byams pa tshad med kyi ting nge 'dzin chos can/ spang bya dngos su mi spong bar thal/ byams pa tshad med kyi ting nge 'dzin yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rnam 'grel las/ byams sogs rmongs dang 'gal med phyir// shin tu nyes pa tshar gcod min// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ rang lugs/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas rang gi dmigs yul gyur pa'i sa de/ shes bya thams cad la khyab par spro nus pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ des bar sa bdun la rigs bsgre/ phyi ma gnyis kyi mtshan nyid/ bdag rkyen gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas rang gi dmigs yul du gyur pa'i (545) nam mkha' de/ rnam shes de/ thams cad la khyab par spro nus pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ bzhi pa la bsdu ba dang*/ sbyong ba'i tshul/ bsgom pa'i byed las dang gsum/ dang po ni/ bcu po bsdu na/ reg bya'i skye mched/ gzugs kyi skye mched/ chos kyi skye mched/ rnam shes kyi skye mched la dmigs pa'i zad par bzhir 'dus te/

dang po bzhi reg bya'i skye mched kyi yul can/ bar pa bzhi gzugs kyi skye mched kyi yul can/ tha ma gnyis chos kyi skye mched dang rnam shes kyi skye mched kyi yul can yin pa'i phyir/ de yang reg bya dang*/ gzugs kyi skye mched la zad par 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de gnyis rang bzhin thams cad la khyab pa dang*/ gzugs can gyi khams kun tu spro nus pa'i phyir/ khyad par du 'byung ba la zad par 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rten 'byung ba med par/ rten pa 'byung 'gyur spro mi nus pa'i phyir/ (546) chos kyi skye mched kyi nang nas nam mkha' dang rnam shes la zad par 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ nam mkha' ni brtan g.yo kun la khyab pa dang*/ rnam shes ni shes bya thams cad kyi yul can dang*/ rgyun dang bcas pa'i shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ dbang po lnga la zad par mi 'jog ste/ phyi rol du spro bar mi nus pa dang*/ chos gzhan 'dzin nus kyi yul can ma yin pa'i phyir/ dri ro gnyis la der mi 'jog ste/ khams gong du khyab par spro mi nus pa'i phyir te/ 'dod pa'i sas bsdus pa'i phyir/ sgra dang sems byung la der mi 'jog ste/ rgyun med pa'i phyir te/ don bzang mkhan po'i theg bsdus kyi 'grel pa las/ sems byung rnams ni rang gi rigs 'dra snga ma las phyi ma 'byung ba'i rgyun med kyi/ gtso sems las 'phral 'phral du 'byung ba yin te/ mar me'i 'od bzhin no// de bzhin du sgra rnams kyang skad cig snga ma las phyi ma skye ba'i rgyun med pas rang dang rigs mi gcig pa'i (547) rgyu tshogs las skad cig re re bzhin gsar du skye ba bzhed pa bzhin/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ sbyang ba byas pa'i sbyong tshul dang*/ de ma byas pa'i sbyong tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ sngar goms par byas pa'i stobs kyis so so'i dmigs pa cung zad tsam mthong ba las de dang de'i ting nge 'dzin mngon du 'gyur ba ste/

dper na/ 'phags pa legs 'ongs kyis/ sngon zad par sngon po'i ting nge 'dzin la goms par byas pa'i stobs kyis utpal sngon po mthong ba tsam gyis zad par sngon po'i ting nge 'dzin skyes par bshad pa bzhin no// gnyis pa la/ dmigs pa'i rten ngos bzung*/ sems gtong ba'i tshul/ mtshan ma'i khyad par ro// dang po ni/ zad par bcu'i dmigs pa'i rten ni rim bzhin rgya mtsho'i steng du zam pa lta bu dang*/ snod gtsang ma dri ma med pa chus bkang pa lta bu dang*/ thab khung gru bzhi par 'og tu bud shing steng du me 'bar ba lta bu dang*/ (548) rang gi lugs kyi yan lag la reg par gyur pa'i skar khung las byung ba'i rlung lta bu dang*/ sngon po/ ser po/ dkar po/ dmar po rnams zlum por byas te tshon gzhan gyis bcad pa dang*/ mtho gang sor bzhi tsam gyi bu ga nam mkha'i mthongs btod pa dang*/ bum nang gi mar me'i 'od bu ga nas rtsig ngos la phog pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa ni/ dmigs rten de dag la yid gtad de ma yengs par rtse gcig tu bsgoms pa'o// gsum pa la/ 'dzin pa'i mtshan ma dang*/ snang ba'i mtshan ma gnyis/ dang po ni/ dmigs rkyen de dag yid la byas te/ bsgoms pa'i tshe bar chad kyi mtshan ma byung tshul rim bzhin/ sa dum bu dum bur chad de spror mi nus pa dang*/ chu chu bur 'dres pa'i g.yo ba'i rnam pa can dang*/ me lce chad cing gzhan du g.yo ba dang*/ rlung la 'o ma bskol ba sa la phog ma thag pa'i rlangs pa 'thul ba dang*/ sngo sogs bzhi la phan tshun dum bur (549) chad de me tog sdong bu med pa lta bu dang*/ nam mkha' la rtsig pa'i bu ga lta bur gyur te skyed kyang mi 'phel ba dang*/ rnam shes la sa la byas pa'i dkyil 'khor dang 'dra bar thogs bcas su snang ba'o// gnyis pa ni/ dmigs rten de dag la yid gtad de bsgoms pas grub pa'i mtshan ma byung tshul ni/ dang po'i skabs su dmigs yul sa de 'brel chags su ji ltar 'dod bzhin du spro nus pa dang*/

gnyis pa la/ chu mi g.yo zhing gzhan la khyab par spro nus pa dang*/ gsum pa la/ me nam mkha' la gnas pa'i zla ba dmar po zlum po lta bu gzhan la khyab par spro nus pa dang*/ bzhi pa la/ rlung ji ltar gnas pa ltar 'dug cing gzhan la khyab par spro nus pa dang*/ sngo sogs bzhi la dmigs rten nor bu'i rnga yab ltar snang la des khyab par spro nus pa dang*/ dgu pa la/ nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor ltar thams cad la khyab par spro nus pa dang*/ bcu pa la/ snang ba'i tshogs (550) rgya chen pos gzugs can thams cad gsal bar byed pa lta bu'o// gsum pa ni/ zad par gyi ting nge 'dzin de dag grub pa'i byed pa rim bzhin/ gzugs can gyi dngos po rnams gcig mang po dang*/ mang po gcig tu sgyur bar nus pa dang*/ chu la yang bying ba med par goms pa 'dor nus pa dang*/ bdud kyi gzhal yas khang bsreg pa'i me sbor nus pa dang*/ rlung ltar myur du 'gro ba dang*/ gzugs sogs sngon por sprul zhing mun pa'i rang bzhin can du byed pa dang*/ ser por sprul zhing gser du sgyur ba dang*/ de bzhin du dmar po dang*/ dkar por sprul zhing ji ltar 'dod pa ltar sprul nus pa dang*/ rtsig pa sogs la thogs med du 'gro ba dang*/ gzugs ldang bar yang bar byed cing gnyid dang rmugs pa rgyang ring du byed pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas sa'i zad par gyi skye mched bcu chos can/ rtogs pa ye shes chos sku yin te/ gtan tshigs gong dang 'dra/ gnyis pa ni/ zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched (551) ni/ zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ zil gnon gyi ting nge 'dzin la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ dogs gcod dang gsum/ dang po ni/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas gzugs can gyi rnam thar sngon du song ba'i stobs kyis rang gi dmigs yul du gyur pa'i gzugs des chos gzhan zil gyis gnon par nus pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/

dbye na/ dbyibs dang kha dog zil gnon gyi skye mched gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ zil gnon gyi skye mched gang zhig rang gi dmigs yul du gyur pa'i dbyibs kyi gzugs des chos gzhan zil gyis gnon par nus pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'o// dbye na/ gzugs can/ gzugs chen po/ chung ngu*/ gzugs can ma yin pa'i gzugs chen po/ chung ngu*/ zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched dang bzhi/ dang po gnyis (552) kyi mtshan nyid/ dbyibs zil gyi non gyi skye mched gang zhig rnal 'byor pa rang nyid gdul bya gzhan ngor snang ba dang bcas pa'i sgo nas rang gi dmigs yul du gyur pa'i gzugs chen po des/ gzugs chung ngu des chos gzhan sogs gong dang 'dra/ phyi ma gnyis kyi mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig rnal 'byor pa rang nyid gdul bya gzhan ngor mi snang ba'i sgo nas rang gi dmigs yul sogs 'gre/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye gzhi gang zhig rnal 'byor pa rang la nang gzugs can ma yin par 'du shes pa'i sgo nas rang gi dmigs yul du gyur pa'i kha dog gi gzugs des chos gzhan sogs 'gre/ dbye na/ sngon po/ ser po/ dmar po/ dkar po/ zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched bzhi/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin kha dog zil gnon gyi skye mched gang zhig rang gi dmigs yul du gyur pa'i sngon po/ ser po/ dmar po/ dkar po des chos gzhan sogs 'gre/

(553) de yang mdo las/ nang gzugs med par 'du shes shing*/ phyi rol gyi gzugs sngon po/ kha dog sngon po/ sngon por snang ba/ mdog sngon po 'di lta ste/ dper na me tog o ma ke lta bu'am/ yul bā ra nā ser byas pa'i gos ltar sngo ba/ kha dog sngo ba sngo bar snang ba/ mdog sngo bar mthong yang gzugs de dag zil gyis mnan te 'du shes zil gyis mnan te mthong zhing de ltar 'du shes pa 'di ni zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched lnga pa'o// de bzhin du ser po la shing kar shi ka ra'i me tog dang*/ dmar po la man tu 'dzin pa ka'i me tog dang*/ dkar po la skar ma pa ba sangs dang sbyar nas gzhan gsum la yang gsungs so// de la sngon po zhes pas ni mdor bstan/ kha dog sngon po zhes pas lhan skyes dang*/ sngon po snang ba zhes pas sbyar byung dang*/ mdog sngon po 'byung ba zhes pas gnyis ka'i mdangs gsal ba'i cha bstan/ me tog ni lhan (554) skyes kyi dpe/ gos ni sbyar byung gi dpe yin no// des lhag ma rnams la rigs bsgre/ de yang dbyibs zil gnon gyi skye mched dang po gnyis/ gzugs can gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar gyi rgyu las byung*/ phyi ma gnyis/ gzugs can ma yin pa gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar gyi rgyu las byung*/ kha dog zil gnon gyi skye mched bzhi ni/ sdug pa'i rnam thar gyi rgyu las byung ba yin no// gsum pa ni/ rnam thar zil gnon/ zad par gsum la khyad par ci yod zhe na/ dang po'i skabs su rang gi dmigs yul de mdzes mi mdzes sna tshogs su lta bar byed/ gnyis pa'i skabs su/ de'i steng du chos gzhan zil gyis gnon par nus pa yin/ gsum pa'i skabs su/ rang gi dmigs pa gcig nyid kyis chos thams cad la khyab par spro nus pa yin no// des na gsum po 'di snga ma las phyi ma 'byung ba yin te/ mdzod 'grel las/ zil gyis gnon (555) pa'i skye mched rnams ni rnam par thar pa 'jug par byed pa can yin la/

zad par gyi skye mched rnams ni zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched 'jug par byed pa can yin te/ gong nas gong du khyad par 'phags pa'i phyir ro// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas sa'i zil gnon gyi skye mched brgyad chos can/ rtogs pa ye shes chos sku yin te/ gtan tshigs gong dang 'dra/ gsum pa ni/ nyan thos nyon mongs med pa'i lta// zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ nyon mongs pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas nyon sgrib spangs pa'i mi slob pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'o// dbye na/ nyan thos dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi nyon mongs pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid de gang zhig nyan thos mi slob pa'i rgyud kyi ting nge 'dzin (556) mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ mtshan gzhi/ gnyis ka'i cha las rnam par grol ba'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa lta bu/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa zad par spangs pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ mtshan gzhi/ rnam mkhyen lta bu/ gal te/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i ting nge 'dzin chos can/ dang po'i mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir te/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pa'i ting nge 'dzin yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi ting nge 'dzin chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir te/ sangs rgyas kyi nyon mongs pa gzhi ma grub pa'i ting nge 'dzin yin pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i yid kyi rnam par shes pa chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ting nge 'dzin du thal/ de'i phyir/ zhe na/ dang po la/ sangs rgyas (557) 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog bden chos can/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi myang 'das su thal/ de'i rgyud kyi nyon sgrib spangs pa'i myang 'das yin pa'i phyir te/

nyon sgrib thams cad spangs pa'i myang 'das yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam chos can/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i thugs rgyud kyi zag med kyi lam yin par thal/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i thugs rgyud kyi zag pa gzhi ma grub pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ byang 'phags kyi gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs chos can/ nyan thos kyi lam du thal/ shes bya nyan thos kyi lam yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi nyon mongs pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin chos can/ nyan thos kyi nyon mongs pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin las khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ gdul bya gzhan rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa drung nas 'byin par byed pa'i mthar (558) thug gi ting nge 'dzin yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa longs sku ni/ mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*// zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po longs sku la/ khyad chos spyir bstan pa/ mtshan nyid bsdus te bstan pa/ yon tan gyi khyad par ro// dang po ni/ khyad chos lnga dang ldan te/ gsung*/ sku/ thugs/ mdzad pa/ snang tshul gyi khyad chos so// dang po ni/ theg chen gyi chos sna tshogs la longs spyod pa/ gnyis pa ni/ mtshan dpe'i 'od zer gyi sku mnga' ba/ gsum pa ni/ gzhan don la brtson pa'i rnam grol gyi thugs rje mnga' ba/ bzhi pa ni/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar mdzad pa lhun gyis grub pa/ lnga pa ni/ gdul bya'i blo ngor kha dog dang dbyibs sna tshogs su snang yang rang bzhin du ma grub pa ste/ rgyud blar/ sna tshogs dam chos 'od zer mnga' ba'i skus// 'gro ba'i rnam grol don grub la brtson pa// mdzad pa yid bzhin nor bu'i (559) rgyal bzhin te// sna tshogs dngos dang de yi rang bzhin min// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa sna tshogs kyi sprul gzhir gyur pa'i mthar thug gi gzugs sku gang zhig theg pa chen po'i chos kyis gdul bya dag pa 'ba' zhig gi don dngos su mdzad pa/

yang na nges pa lnga ldan gyi mthar thug gi gzugs sku/ nges pa lnga ni/ ngo bo nges pa mtshan dpes brgyan pa/ chos nges pa theg chen gyi chos kho na gsung pa/ 'khor nges pa byang 'phags kho nas bskor ba/ gnas nges pa 'og min stug po bkod pa kho nar bzhugs pa/ dus nges pa 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du sku'i snang ba mi sdud par bzhugs pa'o// de la dbye na/ sar gnas kyi byang sems 'phags pa mtha' dag la snang ba'i longs sku tsam dang*/ sa bcu pa yan chod kyi spyod yul du gyur pa'i longs sku gnyis yod/ ces dbu ma pa chos kyi bshes gnyen bzhed/ dang po ni/ skyabs (560) gsum bdun cu pa las/ bsod nams tshogs ni dpag med las// 'khrungs pa de ni rgyal ba'i sras// mthong bar gyur pa'i sku de yi// chos kyi tshogs la spyod 'di ni// rgyal sras rnams kyi spyod pa yin// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ rin chen phreng bar/ bsam yas ye shes yul gyi bdag /dbang phyug chen po'i mchog yin no// zhes so// gsum pa la/ mtshan dpe'i yon tan dang*/ gnas nges pa bye brag tu bshad pa'o// dang po la mtshan dpe byed/ de dag gi khyad par ro// dang po la/ rgyu/ ngo bo/ dbye ba'o// dang po ni/ sbyin pa dang tshul khrims kyis bsdus pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po ni mtshan dpe'i rgyur spyir bshad cing*/ nye ba'i rgyu ni/ chos smra ba'i gang zag la bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa byed pa ste/ mdo las/ gdan rgyu sna tshogs chos kyi gdan du bting*/ gzhan la sti stang byed la skyo ngal med// chos smra ba la 'thab mo ngor mi rgol// 'di (561) dag mtshan rnams phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ rang mtshan du 'grub byed kyi rgyu phun tshogs las byung zhing*/ rang gang la ldan pa'i rten gyi gang zag sangs rgyas su mtshon par byed pa'i gzugs can yon tan te/ rgyan las/ lus can kun gyi khyod mthong na// skyes bu dam pa legs par 'tshal// zhes so// dbye na/

phyag zhabs 'khor lo'i mtshan dang ldan pa la sogs pa sum cu rtsa gnyis so// gnyis pa la/ rgyu sngar bzhin/ ngo bo/ rang dpe byad du 'grub byed kyi rgyu phun tshogs la rten nas/ mthong ba tsam gyis gzhan dwang ba 'dren par byed pa'i byed chos dang ldan pa'i gzugs can gyi yon tan te/ mthong ba tsam gyis rab dang bar// mdzad pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// dbye na/ sen mo zangs kyi mdog ltar dmar ba la sogs pa'i dpe byad brgyad cu/ gsum pa ni/ mtshan ni sku mdzes par byed pa'i (562) gtso bo yin la/ dpe byad ni de'i cha shas ste 'khor yin/ dper na/ 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa'i phyag ni mtshan/ phyag de la ldan pa'i sen mo zangs kyi mdog ltar dmar ba dang*/ zlum po la sogs pa ni dpe byad do// gnyis pa la/ dgag bzhag gnyis/ dang po la/ kha cig longs sku bzhugs pa'i gnas 'og min ni/ gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun gyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i 'og min te/ lang gshegs las/ gzugs kyi khams kyi 'og min du// 'dod chags bral bar khyod 'tshang rgya'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zer/ longs sku'i sku dngos kyi gdul byar gyur pa'i nyan thos yod par thal/ khas len rtags/ gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun gyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i 'og min chos can rang rgyu las nyon gyi dbang gis byung ba'i zag bcas ma yin par thal/ longs sku bzhugs pa'i gnas 'og min de yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ kun (563) btus las/ yongs su dag pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams de dag ni sdug bsngal gyi bden pa ma yin par blta ste/ de dag las dang nyon mongs pas bskyed pa ma yin/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis byung ba ma yin gyi/ smon lam dang dge ba'i rtsa ba'i dbang gis byung ba dag go /zhes so// rang lugs tha snyad rnam 'jog dang*/ don gnas tshod kyi dbang du byas pa gnyis// dang po ni/ gzugs khams kyi gnas 'og min gyi steng na dbang phyug chen po'i gnas de zhes bya ba yod cing de nyid la longs sku'i gnas su bshad pa yod de/

lang gshegs las/ rin chen sna tshogs mdzes pa yis// 'og min gnas ni nyams dga' bar// gtsang ma'i gnas kyi steng bzhugs nas// zhes dang*/ kā ma la shi las/ 'og min zhes bya ba ni lha dag ste/ de dag gi phyogs gcig na gtsang ma'i lha rnams yod do// der 'phags pa nyid 'ba' zhig gnas so// de dag (564) gi steng na dbang phyug chen po'i gnas zhes bya ba yod de/ der sa bcu pa la bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' srid pa tha ma pa kho na skye ba bzhes pa yin la/ 'di ni de lta bu'i sprul pa dmigs pa yin no// zhes bshad/ gnyis pa ni/ srid pa tha ma pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gang du sangs rgyas pa'i gnas de la 'og min stug po bkod pa'i tha snyad 'dogs pa yin te/ srid pa tha ma pa'i byang sems kyi dang por longs sku mngon du byas pa'i tshe/ ma dag sa'i 'khrul snang 'di dag 'gags nas sngon gyi smon lam dang dge ba'i rtsa ba'i dbang gis khyad par du byas pa'i zhing 'ba' zhig 'grub pa'i phyir te/ ye shes bla na med pa'i rgyud las/ sems nyid bde ster lhan cig skyes// 'og min gtsang ma'i gnas mchog go /zhes so// de yang ston pa 'di'i longs sku ni rnam snang gangs chen mtsho yin zhing*/ de'i zhing khams ni gzhi dang snying po me tog gis rgyan pa yin la/ de dag gi tshad ni/ gling (565) bzhi bye ba phrag brgya la stong gsum/ de bye ba phrag brgya la rab 'byams kyi 'tshams sbyar cig de bye ba phrag brgya la rab 'byams kyi rgyud dang po/ de bye ba phrag brgya la rab 'byams kyi rgyud bar pa/ de bye ba phrag brgya ni gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa'i tshad do// de yang longs sku'i zhing khams dag pa'i 'jig rten la skad cig gcig gis 'jig pa'i drwa ba'i mi rtag pa yod kyang*/ me chu rlung gsum gyi rkyen gyis 'jig pa med de/ de dag rkyen gyis 'jig pa ni ma dag pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten gyi khyad chos yin pa'i phyir/

rdo rje rtse mo las/ 'og min stug po nyams dga' zhing*// sdug pa'i zhing khams 'jig med pa// de na sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos// rdzogs par longs spyod tshul 'di 'byung*// zhes so// gal te 'dod pa'i rten can gyi longs sku yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i rten can gyi byang sems kyi longs sku mngon du byed pa yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ longs (566) sku yin na/ 'og min gyi rten can yin pas ma khyab par thal lo// zhe na/ sems can gyi lus rten can gyi longs sku yod par thal/ sems can gyi lus rten can gyi byang sems kyi longs sku mngon du byed pa yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ longs sku yin na sangs rgyas kyi lus rten can yin pas ma khyab par thal lo// gal te skyon med de/ byang sems kyi longs sku mngon du byas pa'i tshe/ sems can gyi lus rten gyi rigs 'dra dor nas mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi skur 'gyur ba'i phyir zhe na/ snga ma la skyon med de/ 'dod pa'i rten can gyi byang sems kyis longs sku mngon du byas pa'i tshe/ sngar gyi 'dod pa'i rten can yin pa dor nas dag sa'i rten 'og min gyi rten can du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rnam snang gangs chen mtsho chos can/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin te/ nges pa lnga ldan gyi mthar thug gi gzugs sku yin pa'i phyir/ (567) bzhi pa sprul sku ni/ gang gis srid pa ji srid par// zhes skabs su/ gnyis kyi dang po/ sprul sku la/ ngo bo/ dbye ba/ dogs gcod dang gsum/ dang po la/ dgag bzhag gnyis/ dang po la/ kha cig sangs rgyas kyi sprul sku sangs rgyas mtshan nyid pa ma yin te/ gal te yin na/ bai ḍūrya'i sa gzhi la shar ba'i lha dbang gis gzugs brnyan de lha dbang mtshan nyid par thal/ khas len rtags/ khyab ste/ rgyud blar/ ji ltar baiḍūr sa gzhi gtsang ma la// lha dbang lus kyi gzugs brnyan snang ba ltar// de bzhin 'gro sems sa gzhi gtsang ma la// thub pa'i dbang po'i sku yi gzugs brnyan 'char// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/

chu nang du shar ba'i zla ba'i gzugs brnyan de zla bar thal/ khas len rtags/ khyab ste/ rgyud blar/ dag las nye dang ring rnams la// 'jig rten rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du// chu dang (568) nam mkha' zla gzugs bzhin// de mthong ba ni rnam pa gnyis// zhes so// sgyu ma mkhan gyis sprul pa'i rta glang de rta glang mtshan nyid par thal/ khas len rtags/ khyab ste/ rab dbye las/ gal te sangs rgyas dngos la ni// las ngan smin par 'dod na yang*// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku nyid la// smin par rigs kyi sprul pa'i sku// shākya thub pa la sogs la// smin par 'dod pa mun sprul yin// dper na sgyu ma'i mkhan po la// las ngan 'byung gi ngos sprul pa'i// sgyu ma la ni mi 'byung bzhin// des na dgongs pa shes dgos so// zhes zer/ gdul bya rigs can gsum la chos 'khor bskor ba po'i sangs rgyas gzhi ma grub par thal/ sangs rgyas kyi sprul sku sangs rgyas ma yin pa gang zhig longs sku dang chos sku de ma yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa la ngan sems kyi khrag 'byin pa'i mtshams med kyi las gzhi ma grub par thal/ sprul sku sangs rgyas ma yin
